coveo:metadata.title: Latest News from Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Latest news, product launches and content from Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine

coveo:metadata.title: CarClad Macropoxy HS 4200 Press Release
coveo:metadata.sw_description: CarClad Macropoxy HS 4200 extended weathering epoxy – delivers the same long-term corrosion protection and abrasion resistance as its predecessor, and now solves a long-standing aesthetic challenge related to epoxies and UV exposure.

coveo:metadata.title: Nova-Plate 360 Press Release
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Easy-to-Apply Nova-Plate® 360 tank lining offers single-leg lining applications for high-temperature, high-pressure tanks.

coveo:metadata.title: DURA-PLATE® 6000 Press Release
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine Coatings has launched DURA-PLATE® 6000, a new 100% solids, high-build, high-strength, reinforced epoxy lining for concrete and steel in severe wastewater service environments. The durable lining material offers asset owners and applicators a variety of time and cost efficiencies due to its fast return-to-service times and the option for single-leg application.

coveo:metadata.title: Mark Schultz Wins SSPC Award
coveo:metadata.sw_description: SSPC (The Society for Protective Coatings) has named Mark Schultz, Government Marine Project Development Manager for Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine Coatings, winner of the 2018-2019 John D. Keane Award of Merit.

coveo:metadata.title: 2018 Impact Award Winners
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 2018 Sherwin-Williams Impact Award, which recognizes outstanding water and wastewater projects, goes to a 3-million-gallon water storage tank restoration project performed under difficult conditions.

coveo:metadata.title: Sherwin-Williams Earns SSPC Award
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams earns SSPC Military Coatings Project Award of Excellence for exceptional coatings work.

coveo:metadata.title: Sherwin-Williams Hosts Under Secretary of the Navy
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Sherwin-Williams Company hosted The Honorable Thomas Modly, Under Secretary of the Navyto demonstrate its innovative protective coatings solutions for combating corrosion in harsh marine environments.

coveo:metadata.title: Zinc Clad® 4100 Press Release
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine Coatings has launched Zinc Clad® 4100, a new high-solids coating featuring recoat times as short as 30 minutes, which allows for accelerated shop throughput, enhanced project schedules, and fast field project turnarounds.

coveo:metadata.title: EnviroLastic 940 LV Press Release
coveo:metadata.sw_description: EnviroLastic 940 LV offers enhanced throughput, direct-to-metal application, and fast-drying properties.

coveo:metadata.title: 2017 Impact Award Winners
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 2017 Sherwin-Williams Impact Award recognizing outstanding water and wastewater projects goes to an infrastructure rehabilitation contractor with a big heart and a rural community in desperate need of infrastructure repairs. For the winning project, Carolina Management Team (CMT) rehabilitated the chlorine contact chamber at the St. Pauls, North Carolina, wastewater treatment plant at no cost – a donation topping $46,000 in estimated value.

coveo:metadata.title: AquArmor™ WBU Press Release
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine Coatings has launched new water-based floor coatings offering no hot-tire pickup and improved hot-tire staining resistance. AquArmor™ WBU Water-Based Urethane Floor Coatings are the next generation of high-performance, water-based, aliphatic urethane coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: Elladur 4850 Polyaspartic Press Release
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Giving flooring applicators greater flexibility with an extended open time, Sherwin-Williams introduces its Elladur 4850 Polyaspartic Floor Coating. The product is specifically designed to meet the needs of those looking for a coating that dries fast for quick return to service, but that also has a longer working time and recoat window for increased application ease and flexibility.

coveo:metadata.title: Bob Murphy Wins SSPC Award
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Bob Murphy, Project Development Manager for Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine Coatings, has been awarded the 2017 John D. Keane Award of Merit by the Society for Protective Coatings (SSPC).

coveo:metadata.title: Sherwin-Williams Wins Three SSPC Awards
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams wins SSPC Awards for exceptional coatings work.

coveo:metadata.title: 2019 Impact Award Winners
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The intricate, colorful restoration of a long-standing elevated water tank serving the city of Fort Lauderdale, Florida, earned the city and project team the 2019 Sherwin-Williams Impact Award.

coveo:metadata.title: FIRETEX M90/03 Press Release
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine has expanded its line of time-tested FIRETEX® passive fire protection coatings with a solution that optimizes applications and reduces costs by enabling precise coating thickness specifications for onshore assets.

coveo:metadata.title: Water and Wastewater Impact Awards
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine is now accepting entry submissions for its annual Impact Award, which recognizes outstanding water and wastewater projects completed in North America.

coveo:metadata.title: PaintSquare Prestige Awards Press Release
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine won two important awards in this year’s PaintSquare Prestige Awards program – Top Innovation and Top Product – for new coatings that enable faster applications, reduce costs and improve durability.

coveo:metadata.title: 2020 Impact Award Winners
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Challenging membrane bioreactor basin lining project earns first place honors for the South Valley Sewer District, CDC Restoration & Construction, and Bowen, Collins & Associates.

coveo:metadata.title: FasTop™ Multi Flooring Systems Press Release

coveo:metadata.title: Contractor Series® Striped Woven Mini Rollers

coveo:metadata.title: Contractor Series® Gallon Screen Grid

coveo:metadata.title: Trimaco SuperTuff® Regular Mesh Plain Top Bag Strainers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Ensure your paint has a smooth finish by removing debris and impurities with Trimaco SuperTuff® Regular Mesh Plain Top Bag Strainers. Bag strainers have double stitched edges and are made of polyester.

coveo:metadata.sw_description: Trimaco SuperTuff® EZ-Strainer quickly strains paint or stain with or without airless intake. Allows for the paint sprayer to access clean paint while the strainer continues to filter the rest of the paint in the bucket. The elastic provides a tight fit on any size pick-up tube. Eliminates impurities in all paints and all environments. Available in 5 gallon size.

coveo:metadata.title: Trimaco SuperTuff® Regular Mesh Plain Top Bag Strainers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Ensure your paint has a smooth finish by removing debris and impurities with Trimaco SuperTuff® Regular Mesh Plain Top Bag Strainers. Perfect for straining all types of paints, stains and liquids. Remove dried flakes, lumps, filaments and other dust particles from paint. Bag strainers have double stitched edges and are made of polyester.

coveo:metadata.sw_description: Heavy duty 2 mil plastic contractor bags hold 42 gallons

coveo:metadata.title: ScotchBlue Sharp Lines Multi-Surface Painter's Tape (2093)
coveo:metadata.sw_description: ScotchBlue™ Sharp Lines Painter's Tape features Edge Lock™ Technology seals out paint to deliver sharp paint lines. Whether you're protecting your wood trim, painted walls, tile floor, or glass windows, this versatile multi surface tape can stay on surfaces for up to 21 days, then removes easily without leaving any sticky residue behind. Help keep your wainscoting paint free or shield your built in shelves with the powerful protection of ScotchBlue™ Sharp Lines Painter's Tape.

coveo:metadata.title: Trimaco SuperTuff® Painter Spray Socks and Painter's Hoods
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Painter's spray socks and hoods

coveo:metadata.title: Buffalo Industries Painter's Rags
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Painter's Rags are premium, all white, recycled, cotton knit t-shirt wipers. These wipers are suitable for many cloth rag needs such as paint spills, staining, finishing, surface prep, tool and general jobsite cleanup. Absorbent, soft, economical, and durable. Colorfast, will not bleed when used with solvents. Cloth rags are more durable than paper.

coveo:metadata.title: Trimaco X-Board® Pro Heavy Duty Temporary Surface Protection, 38 in. x 100 ft.
coveo:metadata.sw_description: FloorShell is now X-Board Pro®- a new name and look with the same trusted protection. Built for the toughest jobsites, X-Board Pro delivers contractor-strength surface protection in a durable, breathable roll made from 100% recycled fibers. At 40 mils thick, it's 5X thicker than standard builder's paper, providing superior impact and leak resistance that stands up to forklifts, scaffolding, and heavy foot traffic. Breathable by design, X-Board Pro allows floors to continue curing while you work, while enhanced Spill-Block® Technology protects against major spills and extended jobs. Eco-friendly, reusable, and built to perform job after job, X-Board Pro helps protect new and existing wood, concrete, stone, tile, linoleum, epoxy, VCT, and most other floor surfaces- working like a pro when protection matters most.

coveo:metadata.title: Purdy® NEST™ Dual Roll-Off Bucket
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Durable black polypropylene that resists warping. Dual roll off inside grid pattern that allows for multiple painters and increased efficiency. Side pour spout for added convenience. The bucket is easily carried with the ergonomic handle or rolled (caster wheel compatible).

coveo:metadata.title: Purdy® Revolution™ Premium Adjustable Frame
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Purdy's roller cover frames give the smoothest rolling action and all day comfort. Good quality paints and applicators need good quality frames in order to make the entire job go as planned. Achieve greater coverage with less fatigue with Purdy frames.

coveo:metadata.title: Warner Knee Pads
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Warner Knee Pads come as a pair and are very soft. These knee pads offer all the comfort needed at a reasonable price. One size fits all in these knee pads. The soft velcro closure is easily adjustable for comfort. Like most knee pads, they irritate the back of your leg behind the knee. The Warner Super Soft Knee pad closure does not irritate behind the knee. Can be worn all day!

coveo:metadata.title: Mauser Packaging Can with Lid
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Pails are sold in quantities of 1.

coveo:metadata.title: T-REX Ferociously Strong Duct Tape

Unlike ordinary duct tapes, this ferociously strong tape is built for intense holding power. Its aggressive double-thick adhesive is what gives this tape the ability to stick to rough, dirty surfaces through all-weather types and temperatures. T-Rex Tape will hold longer and stronger than regular duct tape making it ideal for any project big or small.

coveo:metadata.title: Seymour Midwest Rake CAM Sets

coveo:metadata.title: Midwest Rake Squeegee Blade

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Disposable Ear Plugs

When properly selected and used, the ultra-soft foam of the earplugs conform comfortably to your ear canal and offer exceptional noise reduction. Don't let yourself and your crew get stuck on a noisy job without hearing protection-load up on 3M™ Disposable Earplugs to help protect your hearing.

Features a smooth turning 4-point ratchet suspension system and provides optimized comfort with 3 levels of height adjustment. Part of the 3M™ Pro Series Safety Products line, this hard hat was designed for the way pros think, the way they shop, and the way they work.

Green masking can handle a variety of heavy industrial applications and is used heavily in automotive body shops.

coveo:metadata.title: Midwest Rake CAM Gauge Rake

coveo:metadata.title: Heavy Equipment Products & Platforms
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our product development process starts with you, our customer. Based on your needs and specifications, Sherwin-Williams engineers innovative heavy equipment coating solutions that protect your assets against the harsh operating environments they endure.

coveo:metadata.title: Global Trends in the Heavy Equipment Market
coveo:metadata.sw_description: From product development to distribution, businesses across the globe are taking initiative to reduce their environmental footprint. Whether your organization aims to decrease energy consumption or specify environmentally-conscious materials, customers in every market – including heavy equipment – are paying attention to sustainability efforts.

coveo:metadata.title: Bringing Value to Heavy Equipment Customers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: With guidance from our technical service and support teams, we can help you identify opportunities to improve your finishing process. From gaining efficiencies in your post-painting steps to reducing your overall paint usage, our value extends beyond supplying products.

coveo:metadata.title: Gain Quality and Consistency with Our Heavy Equipment Coatings
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Starting with the highest quality products and formulas, we challenge ourselves to set the industry standard for excellence in performance and color to preserve, protect and beautify your heavy equipment assets.

coveo:metadata.title: Discover Innovative Solutions for Your Heavy Equipment
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Whether you’re seeking custom color, exceptional corrosion protection or both, our heavy equipment coating systems are constantly evolving to meet your needs.

coveo:metadata.title: Total Cost Savings for Heavy Equipment
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Asset protection is non-negotiable for our heavy equipment coatings, and at Sherwin-Williams, lower total cost is a built-in bonus for you. We bring our products and services to life in the field with custom coatings and on-site support.

coveo:metadata.title: Customized Solutions for Heavy Equipment Customers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Whether we’re providing customized coatings or putting boots on the ground to make sure our products are doing their job, we are constantly committed to service and support. Learn more about our distinct approach to field service while bringing value and lowering total cost.

coveo:metadata.title: Driving Value and Cost Savings in the Heavy Equipment Market

coveo:metadata.title: Supporting Heavy Equipment Customers with Design Engineering Services

coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tough, fast drying, paintable, rubberized undercoating material that effectively protects and sound deadens door skins, quarter panels, wheel wells, frame rails, trunks and fenders.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Multi Purpose Spray Lubricant
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Multi-Purpose Spray Lubricant is an ideal choice for general or all-around use.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ No Cleanup Waterbased Undercoating
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M No Cleanup Waterbased Undercoating delivers what you need in a vehicle undercoat - including corrosion and abrasion resistance, high-build capabilities, sound deadening qualities and fast direct-to-metal spray application - without the time and expense of cleanup.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ White Grease
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ White Grease is a heavy-bodied, lithium-grease based aerosol lubricant. It provides good performance under high friction loads, rubbing, and wiping action. It is excellent for general applications on all metal moving parts.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Spray Silicone Lubricant
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Silicone Lubricant eliminates rubber squeaks, prevents sticking and seals out moisture. This lubricant contains no petroleum oils to stain fabrics. Formulated for extreme conditions, it will not freeze at -28°F nor degrade at 350°F. Silicone lubricant is available in both wet and dry formulas.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ High Power Spray Gun Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M High Power Spray Gun Cleaner is a low VOC aerosol specifically formulated for removing waterborne and solvent-based coatings from metals, plastic and composite surfaces. This spray gun cleaner meets SCAQMD Rule 1171 requirements.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 413Q
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 413Q is best suited for metal sanding and finishing.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Hand Pad 7448
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Ultra Fine Hand Pad 7448 combines durability for long life, flexibility for reaching tight areas, and can be used in place of steel wool for conditioning metal surfaces and paint prep. Unlike fine steel wool, Scotch-Brite pads will not shred during use, rust after use, or leave fine metal splinters.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Hand Pad 7447
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ General Purpose Hand Pad 7447 combines flexibility with effective cutting action and precise hand control to accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results, use after use. Very fine grade aluminum oxide abrasives cut fast and fine, leaving a smooth, finished surface. Suitable for use on a wide variety of materials and for many different tasks.

coveo:metadata.title: Aerogreen 4110 Paint Prep Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Aerogreen 4110 Paint Prep Cleaner is a concentrated, water based environmentally friendly cleaner that outperforms traditional hazardous solvents used to clean and prepare surfaces for paint.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Durable Flex Belt
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Durable Flex Belt is engineered to perform tough detail work such as deburring, blending, and finishing, on a variety of metals.

coveo:metadata.title: A275 OP NorGrip Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Norton Dry Ice A975 NorGrip hook and loop discs with patented Norton SG ceramic grain are ideal for hard-to-sand and self-healing clears.

coveo:metadata.title: A275 OP PSA Disc Roll
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Champagne Magnum is sandpaper technology at its finest. It cuts faster, runs cooler, resists loading better and last longer than any conventional sandpaper.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Roloc™ Fibre Discs 786C
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Roloc Fibre Discs are engineered to cut faster, cooler and with less grinding pressure than conventional abrasives

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Red Abrasive Disc 316U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Red Abrasive Disc 316U is an economical disc that delivers reliable performance.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Fibre Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Green Corps Fibre Disc is designed for grinding door skins, MIG welds and other applications on metal, plastic or fiberglass.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Soft Hand Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Soft Hand Block helps level repair areas with greater ease.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Brite™ Roloc Clean and Strip Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Clean and Strip Disc is designed to help operators tackle tough metalworking challenges: think paint prep and coating and corrosion removal.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Abrasive Disc Roll 236U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Gold Disc Roll 236U features a tear-off disc format in a single roll, making them exceptionally fast and easy to use. Aluminum oxide mineral abrasive delivers an aggressive cut.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Clear Blend Prep Scuff
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ Clear Blend Prep Scuff was designed to help you prep color blend areas. It's the third pad in a three-part Scuffing System. When used together, our Scuffing System helps operators achieve optimum color prep adhesion.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Soft Hand Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Hookit Soft Hand Block attaches to corresponding Hookit abrasive sheets to give users a more nimble, precise way to tackle sanding jobs. This can be used by professionals or individuals looking to increase the speed and ease of jobs on flat surfaces or contours.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Paint Prep Scuff Hand Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Ultra Fine Hand Pad 7448 combines durability for long life, flexibility for reaching tight areas, and can be used in place of steel wool for conditioning metal surfaces and paint prep. Unlike fine steel wool, Scotch-Brite pads will not shred during use, rust after use, or leave fine metal splinters.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Universal Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Universal Adhesive is a two-part, urethane adhesive designed to bond metal, glass and plastic substrates to each other and themselves.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ No Cleanup Applicator Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M No Cleanup Applicator Gun is a high-performance applicator gun designed for use with 3M No Cleanup products (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ No Cleanup Replacement Nozzle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M No Cleanup Replacement Nozzles are high-performance disposable siphon-feed tubes to be used with the 3M No Cleanup Applicator Gun and Coatings (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Welding and Spark Deflection Paper
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Welding and Spark Deflection Paper helps protect vertical surfaces from damage caused by welding spatter and grinding sparks. The flame-retardant paper comes with adhesive backing for easy application to vertical surfaces. The adhesive backing allows for easy repositioning of the spark deflection paper as needs change at a work site.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Spray Trigger Nozzle Head
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Spray Trigger Nozzle Head is an easy-to-use nozzle head designed for use with 3M™ Detailing Spray Bottle (Part Number: 37716) and cleaning products.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Solvent Spray Nozzle Trigger Head
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Solvent Spray Nozzle Trigger Head helps you apply solvent or water-based detailing chemicals with greater control and convenience.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Organic Vapor Cartridge
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Organic Vapor Cartridge

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ P95 Particulate Filters

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Vinyl Tape 471+
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Designed for fine line and critical paint masking, our 3M Vinyl Tape 471+ is a conformable tape with a semi-translucent backing.

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE™ Commercial Grade PSA Abrasive Disc/Roll
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Available in multiple sizes and in grits from P40 to P800

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Durable Flex Hand Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ Durable Flex Hand Pad combines ultra flexibility with effective cutting action and precise hand control to accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Roloc™ Bristle Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Roloc Bristle Disc provides more surface contact than wire brushes and retain abrasive properties throughout the life of the disc.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork® Advanced Soft Centerfeed Hand Towel

coveo:metadata.sw_description: Designed to be used for sanding, grinding, and buffing applications

coveo:metadata.title: Titan® Impact 440 Electric Airless Sprayer
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
The Titan® Impact™ 440 electric airless sprayer is ideally suited for residential, property maintenance and small commercial applications. This sprayer will apply all standard architectural primers, paints and coatings efficiently.

Not all products may be available online. Please contact your store or rep for questions on availability.

coveo:metadata.title: Titan® Impact 640 Electric Airless Sprayer
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
The Titan® Impact® 640 electric airless sprayer is a mid-range unit that is perfect for residential, property maintenance, rental and light commercial applications. This sprayer comes equipped with digital technology for improved efficiency and an anti-theft lock to protect your investment.

Not all products may be available online. Please contact your store or rep for questions on availability.

coveo:metadata.title: Aerogreen 4035 Runway Rubber Remover
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Aerogreen 4035 Runway Rubber Remover is a biodegradable, eco-friendly cleaning solution designed to quickly and safely emulsify rubber from the runway surface, dissolving the rubber residue into the solution.

coveo:metadata.title: Goof Off Heavy Duty Remover
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Removes adhesives, glue, stickers, decals and more for a variety of hard surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: Klean-Strip Naked Gun® Spray Gun Paint Remover
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Naked Gun® Spray Gun Paint Remover provides a powerful aerosol spray stream that removes both solvent and waterborne paints from hard to reach areas. There is no need for special equipment or time-consuming dipping, thereby reducing cost. Removes paint from spray gun bodies, tips, and cups, as well as many other shop surfaces. Not for sale or use in California.

coveo:metadata.title: Mirka® DEROS 550 Dust-Free Sanding System
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Mirka® is the pioneer of dust-free sanding. Innovating Abranet Abrasives 20 years ago has lead Mirka® to create healthier and cleaner work environments and better efficiency while providing a high-quality finish to help improve your business.

coveo:metadata.title: Sames Kremlin FPro Lock Airspray Manual Spray Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: FPro Lock P spray gun gives you the brand new FPro finishing technology and consistent production whatever the operator's skills. Sames Kremlin brings you solutions for high level use in demanding environments.

coveo:metadata.title: Sames Kremlin FPro Pressure Spray Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Exceptionally balanced, the FPro paint spray gun provides a superior finish for all painters. Sames Kremlin offers an extensive range of spray guns and accessories for all FPro applications in the high finishing markets.

coveo:metadata.title: Sames Kremlin Rexson Airmix® EOS 10-C 18 Pump & Xcite
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 10C18 Airmix® professional paint sprayer is only available as a complete spraying package. It ensures constant and pulse-free delivery for a superior finish.

coveo:metadata.title: Sames Kremlin Airmix® PU3000 Plural Component Mixing & Dosing Paint Pump
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Electronic dosing and mixing equipment includes pumping, metering and electronic functions in low and medium pressure. Available in 2 versions: 2 liters and 4 liters. Also available in Airspray and Airless ranges.

coveo:metadata.title: Sames Kremlin Airmix® 20C50 Paint Pump
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Introducing the 20C50 Airmix® Paint Pump-the ultimate solution for high-demand industrial applications. Built for durability and precision, the 20C50 delivers consistent, high-quality finishes for a variety of coatings, from low to high viscosity. Whether you're in the wood, metal, or plastic industries, this pump ensures maximum efficiency with minimal waste.

coveo:metadata.title: Sames Kremlin Xcite Airmix Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Xcite™ Airmix™ manual paint spray gun delivers outstanding performance with unsurpassed finish quality for a quick payback. It is available in 3 pressure ranges: 120, 200 & amp; 400 bar (1740-2900-5400 psi) to meet every application. The Xcite™ is HVLP paint sprayer compliant.

coveo:metadata.title: Sames Kremlin AVX Automatic Airmix® Spray Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Introducing the AVX Automatic Airmix® Spray Gun, designed for unmatched precision and efficiency in automated coating applications. Built with Airmix® technology, the AVX offers superior atomization, delivering flawless finishes while reducing paint consumption and overspray. Perfect for industries like automotive, wood, and metal, this spray gun ensures consistent, high-quality results with every use.

coveo:metadata.title: Sames Kremlin PMP 150 Diaphragm Pump
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sames Kremlin PMP 150 Airspray Diaphragm Paint Pump is their easiest pumping solution. It is a diaphragm pump (for application requiring a 1:1 ratio) and can be used with adhesive, medium viscosity, or harsh coating.

coveo:metadata.title: Sames Kremlin 02C85 Airspray Piston Pump
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Sames Kremlin 02C85 Airspray Piston Pump is designed for professionals who demand the highest quality and efficiency in their coating operations. Whether you are working with wood, metal, plastic, or any other surface, this advanced piston pump ensures a flawless, consistent finish every time. Thanks to its compacity, the Sames Kremlin 02C85 Airspray Paint Pump saves waste during flushing and quick color changes. The special design of the fluid section combined with GT seals allows priming at very low pressure for a large range of viscosities.

coveo:metadata.title: Vectrocoat®
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Anodic Acrylic Electrocoat
coveo:metadata.sw_industry: Appliances; Energy; Electronics; Furniture; General Finishing

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Lids
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Lids are designed for the next generation 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System. A ¼-turn locking system replaces our traditional PPS collar, letting you attach the lid to the hard cup with a quick twist. A domed design allows up to 3 oz of fluid below the filter, reducing inconsistent spray and sputter. Full-diameter filters and a wider fluid spout improve flow and filtration.

coveo:metadata.title: V-shield
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Cathodic Acrylic Electrocoat
coveo:metadata.sw_industry: Appliances; Electronics; Energy; Commercial Vehicle; Furniture; Heavy Equipment; General Finishing

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Mix Ratio Inserts
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Mix Ratio Inserts help mix paint according to manufacturer guidelines for the 3M™ PPS™ (Legacy) paint preparation system. Mix ratio inserts are available for various cup sizes and manufacturers. 3M™ PPS™ is a complete painting system that allows the painter to measure, mix, filter and spray paint materials.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Abrasive Fibre Discs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™'s Cubitron™ II Abrasive Fibre Discs is built for faster cutting of welds as well as grinding, weld blending, deburring and other tough metal finishing jobs. 3M™ Precision Shaped Grain - a tough, sharp ceramic abrasive - is resin-bonded to a stiff fiber backing. This disc lasts significantly longer than conventional ceramic grain discs, delivering a lower cost per grind with fewer disc changes.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Abrasive Disc 216U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Disc 216U is precision-coated for long life and exceptionally smooth auto body finishing. It features light A-weight paper backing with sharp, durable aluminum oxide abrasive - a fast, aggressive cut, yet a uniform finish, ideal for featheredging, primer sanding and scuffing. The disc roll features easy tear-off Stikit™ discs with adhesive backing for fast, easy change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Purple Clean Sanding Sheet Roll
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Purple Clean Sanding Abrasive Sheet Roll 334U combines excellent dust removal, easy snap-off sheet sizing and our fast cutting, long lasting abrasive for higher productivity and lower cycle times. A chevron hole pattern keeps particulates off of the sheet face, and our Kiss-cut Underscore Technology lets technicians easily convert the roll into multiple sheet configurations.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Black Super Silicone Seal
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
3M™ Black Super Silicone Seal is formulated for fast and effective repairs. It cures to a tough, rubbery solid when exposed to moisture in the air. This paste-like, one-component silicone rubber adheres to clean metal, glass, wood, ceramic, natural and synthetic fiber, painted surfaces and some plastics.

NOTE: May cause crazing or hazing on optically clear plastics. May cause softening or weakening of plastic parts. Will cause accelerated rusting (oxidation) on bare metal surfaces. Test for compatibility with materials being repaired to determine whether product is suitable for use and method of application.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun for 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun for 3M™ PPS Series 2.0 combines the simplicity and easy maintenance of our Accuspray™ spray gun with the material-saving, rapid clean-up convenience of PPS™ Series 2.0, our next generation, highest performing disposable spray cup system. Replaceable atomizing heads afford the performance of a new gun, on demand and at a fraction of the cost.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 213Q
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 213Q is an abrasive sanding paper constructed on a light, A-weight paper backing and features a waterproof resin bonding to help prevent heat buildup. The aluminum oxide abrasive and waterproof backing make this paper an ideal product for sanding applications such as paint prep, sanding, sealer sanding, and solid surface finishing.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Clean Sand Painter's Pad with Hookit™
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Clean Sand Painter's Pad with Hookit™ allows sanding in a dust-controlled environment when using 5-inch 3M Clean Sand abrasives or other 6-hole or 5-inch dust-free abrasive products. The 31-hole pad pattern is a proprietary 3M design that helps maximize dust extraction for a cleaner work surface.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Rubber Sanding Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Rubber Sanding Block provides a firm attachment for sanding jobs that demand a hands on approach. The tough rubber material evenly applies pressure to the sanding surface, while the rounded design provides a comfortable grip to help reduce user fatigue.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Abrasive Hand Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Hand Pad allows you to use our Hookit discs with the precise control that only hand sanding can offer. Featuring our Hookit attachment system, abrasive discs can be easily swapped without coming loose during sanding, finishing or other hands-on applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Lid & Liner Dispenser
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Lid & Liner Dispenser is a wall-mountable unit that makes supplies such as lids and liners for the 3M™ PPS™ (legacy) paint preparation system readily available. This storage accessory conveniently dispenses supplies one at a time, while keeping the remaining supply clean and safe from contamination.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ File Belt Sander Contact Arm Assemblies
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ File Belt Sander Contact Arm Assemblies is an efficient way to maintain your sanding and grinding capabilities, without spending on additional sanders. Each contact arm assembly arrives ready to install onto your 3M™ File Belt Sander (PN 33573 and 33575).

coveo:metadata.title: New Pig Grippy Floor Protection Mat
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The New Pig Grippy Floor Protection Mat prevents slips, trips and falls and creates a safe walking surface with the adhesive-backed commercial floor mat. Perfect for entrances and aisle-ways in retail, manufacturing, education, healthcare, hospitality and office environments.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Metal Restorer and Polish
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Metal Restorer and Polish restores the sparkle and shine on metals throughout boats. This polish rejuvenates the beauty of metals by removing surface rust, oxidation, corrosion and tarnish. This easy-to-use paste brings back the original luster to make metals look new again.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Grippy Adhesive-Backed Floor Mat - 36"x100'
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Adhesive-backed floor mat stays exactly where you put it with no shifting, bunching up or ripples that cause slips and trips.

coveo:metadata.title: New Pig Aerosol Can Recycler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Puncture your aerosol cans for easy, legal recycling to avoid the hassle, regulation and expense of hazardous waste handling.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Magnetic Roll Holder
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Keep your PIG Mat within an arm's reach for easy access and hassle-free dispensing. The PIG Magnetic Roll Holder attaches to any metal surface to keep mat off the floor and close at hand.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Orbital Air File Shoe
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Orbital Air File Shoe allows you to use 3M abrasive sheets with a full range of orbital air file sanders. It features a hole configuration that helps channel dust away from the sheet surface for longer abrasive life. This file shoe also lets you instantly upgrade to the Hookit™ hook-and-loop attachment system for quick, easy changeouts when using Hookit™ abrasive sheets.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 12-Pack Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 12-Pack Refill Kit is a simple, cost-effective way to keep the PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System stocked and ready. Kits are available in Midi (13.5 oz, 400 mL) and Standard (22 oz, 650 mL) sizes, excellent for most mid-range repairs. Kit contains 12 PPS™ Series 2.0 Lids with ¼-turn locking systems and full diameter 200 micron filters, 12 disposable liners and 16 sealing plugs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Sealing Plugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Sealing Plugs are designed specifically for the 3M™ PPS™ 2.0 Spray Cup System. Sealing plugs fit into PPS™ Series 2.0 Lids of all sizes, and feature a wide, flat design that creates a stable base for supporting lid and cup assemblies when turned upside down. This lets you keep the lid filters wet, preserving them during temporary sealing and protection of paint and coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Adapter
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Adapter provides four points of connection from lid-to-gun and converts typical spray guns into ones that work with the 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System. Specifically designed adapters allow painters to use PPS™ with virtually any spray gun model. To use this adapter, remove the existing spray gun cup. Then simply thread the correct PPS™ Adapter into the spray gun.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cartridge Applicator Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Cartridge Applicator Gun 08992 is designed to smoothly dispense a range of 3M™ seam sealers and adhesives from 1/10 gallon cartridges. This lightweight applicator gun allows operators to easily dispense a range of single component products.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 H/O Pressure Cup
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System is our next generation, highest-performing 3M™ Paint Preparation System (PPS) on the disposable spray cup market. This product contains a pressurized hard cup, collar, shroud, and hose, and enables the user to efficiently spray thick, high viscosity liquids.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Liners
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Liners come in cases containing 100 liners each for use with the 3M™ PPS™ paint preparation system. Liners are available for a range of jobs large and small. PPS™ is an all-in-one system that allows painters to mix/measure, filter, spray and temporarily seal and protect coating materials.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Spray Gun Holder
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Spray Gun Holder works with the 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 and 3M™ PPS™ (Legacy) paint preparation system. Holders are available in single gun, double gun and quad gun designs. 3M™ PPS™ is a complete painting system that allows the painter to measure, mix, filter, spray and temporarily store paint materials.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8576
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
This disposable P95 particulate respirator helps provide reliable respiratory protection against certain oil and non-oil-based particles. The respirator features a carbon layer to remove nuisance levels of acid gases.

The respirator incorporates 3M™'s proprietary technology with advanced electrostatically charged microfiber filter media designed for ease of breathing. Braided headbands are designed to help enhance comfort and increase wearability. Recommended applications may include glass etching, chemical processing, paper processing, aluminum smelting, and brewing operations in which particles and nuisance levels of acid gases such as sulphur dioxide, hydrogen fluoride, and/or chlorine may be present. Additional applications include grinding, sanding, sweeping, bagging, and other dusty/oily operations.
Note: This respirator is not intended to act as a face shield or to give benefits beyond helping to improve respiratory protection. Fitted with a 3M™ Cool Flow™ Exhalation Valve, this respirator is suited for work situations involving heat, humidity, or long periods of wear. The proprietary 3M™ Cool Flow valve is designed to release hot, humid exhaled breath quickly, helping to prevent an unpleasant build-up of heat inside the facepiece a significant cause of discomfort to respirator wearers. This particulate respirator is a NIOSH (National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health) approved P95 respirator for environments containing certain oil and non-oil-based particles and provides 95% filter efficiency.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ SUN GUN™ II Accessories
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ SUN GUN™ II Accessories are components and replacement parts for the 3M™ PPS™ SUN GUN™ II, a device used to provide a light source that replicates natural sunlight. This tool allows technicians to better match paint colors, identify pre-painting defects such as pin holes and scratches and locate post-painting defects such as swirls marks, burn through, sand scratches and dirt nibs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ SecureFit™ 400 Series Safety Glasses
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Take the next step in comfort with 3M SecureFit 400 Series Protective Eyewear, featuring 3M Pressure Diffusion Temple Technology, a soft one-piece nose bridge, dual-injected temples and a range of options, including lens colors, premium coatings, readers and more.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo™ Peel-Off Visor Cover M-925 Standard Visor
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Used with the 3M™ Versaflo™ M 925 Standard Visor. The M 926 Visor Cover fits over the standard visor and protects it from scratching or overspray of paint and chemicals.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite SE Surface Conditioning Belt
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ SE Surface Conditioning Belt was built to last, resisting both wear and sharp edges when used for cleaning, blending, deburring and finishing on a variety of metals.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fibre Disc Back-up Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Fibre Disc Backup Pad is built tough to support 5" DA. fiber discs on right angle sanders. Compatible with a range of 3M™ face plates, this hard rubber disc pad maximizes your abrasive discs - it is designed to reduce the vibration and chunking that degrades their effectiveness. The pad fastens securely to grinding tools with a disc retainer nut (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ 8210 Particulate Respirator
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Recommended for sanding, sawing, grinding and sweeping.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Multi-Purpose Duct Tape 3900
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Constructed of polyethylene film laminated to cloth with a rubber adhesive, this durable tape resists curling and tears off the roll cleanly for easy application in MRO/construction. Our Multi-Purpose Duct Tape 3900 has a unique construction that allows for permanent and temporary applications.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Clean and Finish Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ Clean and Finish Discs combine conformable material and abrasive mineral to effectively blend, clean, and polish surfaces on a wide variety materials such as aluminum, stainless steel, plastics, wood, and fiberglass; producing a clean, consistent finish without undercutting or damaging the base material.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Adflo Particulate Filters
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Replacement high-efficiency particulate filter for 3M™ Adflo Powered Air Purifying Respirator (PAPR) .

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo Organic Vapor/HEPA Cartridge TR-600 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The TR-6510N is a filter is a combination High Efficiency (HE) particulate filter and Organic Vapor (OV) cartridge for use with TR-600 series PAPRs. 3M recommends the use of the TR-6500FC filter cover to help protect the filter from physcial damage.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun System with PPS™ Series 2.0
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun System with PPS™ Series 2.0 combines the simplicity and easy maintenance of our Accuspray™ spray gun with the material-saving, rapid clean-up convenience of PPS™ Series 2.0.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Clear Polycarbonate Faceshield WP96
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Clear Polycarbonate Faceshield WP96, Face Protection 82701, uses the 3M Easy-Change™ system to mount quickly and easily to 3M headgear (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Ratchet Headgear H8A
coveo:metadata.sw_description: A combination headgear and faceshield safety system. Includes H8A ratchet headgear and WP96 polycarbonate faceshield. Adjustable ratchet suspension. Molded faceshield provides impact protection. Requires protective eyewear, sold separately.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun System with Standard PPS™
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Accuspray™ Spray Gun System with Standard PPS™ combines the simplicity and easy maintenance of Accuspray™ spray guns and with the material-saving, rapid clean-up convenience of PPS™. Replaceable atomizing heads afford the performance of a new gun, on demand and at a fraction of the cost.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Flexible Abrasive Interface Foam Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ HookIt™ Flexible Abrasive Interface Foam Pad contains one rectangular interface foam pad with hook-in attachment on one side and loop-in attachment on the other.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Diamond Cloth Belt 651WY
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Diamond Cloth Belt 651WY is designed for grinding and polishing ceramics, carbide, and cast iron. It uses micron-graded diamond particles affixed to a durable, x-weight waterproof cloth backing with heat-resistant resin bond.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Disc 984F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Disc 984F is an abrasive cloth disc built with 3M Precision Shaped Grain (PSG) on a durable, YF-weight, polyester backing. This ceramic grain continuously fractures into sharp points that are capable of cutting exceptionally fast. The YF-weight backing is tough and ideal for medium-to-high pressure applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Accuspray™ Fluid Needle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Accuspray™ Fluid Needle is designed specifically for the Accuspray™ spray gun and helps keep it operating like new.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Paper Disc 466UZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Paper Disc 466UZ is a general purpose abrasive disc constructed on a heavy F-weight backing. It features an anti-static treatment that helps prevent loading and helps with dust management. The silicon carbide abrasive and thick backing make this paper disc an ideal product for sanding applications where better finishes are desired.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cloth Roll 370DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cloth Roll 370DZ is an abrasive sanding cloth constructed on a heavy, y-weight cloth backing that features open coat construction for consistent sanding action. The aluminum oxide abrasive and stiff backing make this roll an ideal product for dry applications such as sanding on wood or metal surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cloth Roll 384F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cloth Roll 384F is an abrasive sanding roll constructed on a durable, polyester cloth backing that features closed coat construction for consistent sanding action. The aluminum oxide abrasive and waterproof polyester construction make this cloth an ideal product for both wet and dry applications such as surface dimensioning and defect removal.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cloth Belt 970DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cloth Belt 970DZ is a best-in-class heavy cloth belt constructed of high-performing 3M Ceramic Abrasive Grain and designed for medium grade operations on wide belt or edge sanders. Applications include dimensioning and stock removal. The exceptionally fast cut and long life of ceramic grain make it ideal for high production environments.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cloth Belt 370DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cloth Belt 370DZ is an open coat product using a premium grade aluminum oxide mineral. The cloth backing of the belt makes it suitable for both rough sanding and final finishing on wide belt and edge sanding applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Belt 967F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 967F features high-performing 3M precision shaped grain on a resilient polyester backing to give you outstanding durability and cutting efficiency in high pressure applications on carbon steel, nickel alloys and tool steels.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Belt 966F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 966F is designed to provide efficient surface finishing on a variety of metals including stainless steel, titanium and other high nickel alloys. Made with 3M precision shaped ceramic grain attached to a water resistant polyester cloth backing, this belt can aggressively sand and finish surface without discoloring the metal in either wet or dry applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Belt 399F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 399F is an abrasive belt that is designed for metal deburring, centerless and cylindrical grinding and flat finishing. It features our new shaped aluminum oxide agglomerates constructed on a durable Y-weight cloth backing for high performance on a wide range of metals.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Belt 984F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 984F offers revolutionary performance with 3M Precision-Shaped Grain on a YF-weight polyester cloth backing. This high-performing belt contains a grinding aid, making it ideal for medium to high pressure applications on stainless steel and other exotic alloys, along with carbon steel, cobalt chrome, and nickel alloys.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Belt 981F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 981F is an abrasive sanding belt for grinding, weld removal, finishing and blending on softer metals. It is constructed on a tough, Y-weight backing with fast-cutting 3M Precision-Shaped Grain. The water-resistant material and cutting aide allow for use with liquid coolants to prevent loading when used on aluminum, bronze and brass.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Belt 990FZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 990FZ offers revolutionary performance with 3M Precision-Shaped Grain on a tough polyester cloth backing. This high-performing belt is constructed with an open coat and an additional antistatic treatment to further prevent loading during use on wood. It can also be used in either wet or dry applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Belt 991FZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 991FZ offers revolutionary performance with 3M Precision Shaped Grain on a polyester cloth backing. This high-performing belt is constructed with a closed coat and an additional anti-static treatment to further prevent loading during use on wood. It can be used in either wet or dry applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Belt 994F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 994F features 3M Precision Shaped Ceramic Grain which cuts fast and self-renews during grinding. These high-performing products are ideal for medium to high pressure applications on carbon steel.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Belt 997F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 997F was designed to tackle your toughest, high-pressure applications on metals like stainless steel, cobalt chrome and nickel alloys.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cloth Roll 947A
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron ll Cloth Roll 947A offers revolutionary performance with 3M Precision Shaped Grain on an X-weight polycotton cloth backing. This high-performing roll contains a grinding aid, making it ideal for low to medium pressure applications on stainless steel and other nickel alloys, along with carbon steel and cobalt chrome. Can be used in either dry applications only.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Depressed Center Grinding Wheel

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cut and Grind Wheel

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Fibre Disc 987C

This disc achieves a higher cut-rate, greater durability, and longer life than other fiber discs - all with less grinding pressure.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Fibre Disc 982C
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Fibre Disc 982C uses 3M Precision-Shaped Grain to generate up to twice the cut-rate, durability, and life of other fiber discs when grinding carbon steel - all with less grinding pressure required by the operator. coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 784F features 3M Precision-Shaped Grain for longer life and a faster, more consistent cut than conventional ceramic aluminum oxide belts. A precise mix of shaped ceramic and premium aluminum oxide delivers optimal cut in medium-pressure grinding and blending applications. The belt also features a waterproof backing and grinding aid.

coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Cubitron II Abrasive Belt 947A built with 3M Precision-Shaped Grain cuts metal dramatically faster and cooler, and stays sharp longer than conventional ceramic belts. Its X-weight poly-cotton backing is flexible. This belt is optimized for low and medium pressure applications on stainless steel, mild steels, and aluminum.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ ll Cloth Belt 723D
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cubitron II Cloth Belt 723D features 3M Precision Shaped Grain to deliver longer life and a faster, more consistent cut than aluminum oxide belts. This product can be used in either wet or dry applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cut & Grind Wheel
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Cut & Grind Wheels are engineered to help you get more work done for your dollar. These versatile wheels serve as both a depressed center grinding wheel and a cut-off wheel, allowing you to seamlessly switch from cutting applications like back gouging to grinding a bevel without taking the time to switch out your wheel.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cut-Off Wheel Tool
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Cut-Off Wheel Tool is designed to deliver exceptional cutting action and optimize the performance of 3M Cut-Off Wheels (sold separately). Numerous upgrades have been added to enhance the strength and durability of the tool, while maintenance and compatibility improvements make this tool easy to use and maintain.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Diamond Cloth Belt 641WY
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Diamond Cloth Belt 641WY is engineered with micron-graded diamond, a long-lasting resin bond and a durable, water-resistant X-weight cloth backing, making it ideal for grinding and polishing ceramics, carbide, cast iron and other hard-to-grind materials.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Diamond Cloth Roll 651WY

coveo:metadata.sw_description: Genuine 3M Electric Random Orbital Sander replacement parts keep your 3M Electric Random Orbital Sander in top working condition. coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Diamond Cloth Sheet 651WY
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Diamond Cloth Sheet 651WY adheres diamond particles to a durable cloth backing with a tough resin bond, helping operators achieve a smooth finish on thermal sprays, ceramics, glass and composites.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Electric Variable Speed Polisher

It is engineered around a balance of speed, power, and comfort to help operators achieve desired results for compounding, buffing, and polishing.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Elite Mini Orbital Sander
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Elite Series Mini Orbital Sander packs the performance of our air-powered orbital hand sanders into a small tool that's ideal for sanding small defects in painted surfaces. Added features for durability, comfort and control, plus twist-on, twist-off Roloc disc attachment, give this mini sander big benefits - now, you can sand small areas instead of entire panels, saving time and cost.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fibre Disc 787C

Constructed with a grinding aid, it is an excellent choice for weld removal, blending, and finish refinement on stainless steel and high nickel alloys.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fibre Disc 782C

Advanced abrasive technology makes it an excellent choice for tough applications including weld removal, blending and finish refinement.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ File Belt Sander

coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed our 3M Finesse-it Buffing Pad - Gray Foam has moderately aggressive foam pads, designed to be used in conjunction with specially developed 3M Finesse-it polishes to achieve satin, semi-gloss or high gloss finishes on wood, automotive, marine, and aerospace coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Finesse-it™ Buffing Pad - Green Foam
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed our 3M Finesse-it Buffing Pad - Green Foam as moderately aggressive foam pads with a convoluted or flat buffing surface, designed to be used in conjunction with specially developed 3M Finesse-it polishes to achieve satin, semi-gloss or high gloss finishes on wood, automotive, marine, and aerospace coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Finesse-it™ Buffing Pad - Orange Foam Black Loop
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We developed our 3M Finesse-it Buffing Pad - Orange Foam Black Loop as moderately aggressive for use with 3M Finesse-it polishes, which are specially designed to achieve satin, semi-gloss or high gloss finishes on wood, automotive, marine, and aerospace coatings. These buffing pads are manufactured with black loop and a deep waffle face.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Film Sheet 375L
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We engineered 3M Film Sheet 375L to deliver outstanding tear resistance, flexibility and consistent finish on a variety of substrates. The film backing conforms to contours and delivers a super smooth application that produces a highly uniform finish. Premium aluminum oxide grain offers a faster cut and extended product life over standard A/O mineral for greater productivity.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Finesse-it™ Buffing Pad - Orange Foam White Loop
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We manufacture our 3M Finesse-it Buffing Pad - Orange Foam White Loop for use with our 3M Finesse-it polishes, which are specially designed to achieve satin, semi-gloss or high gloss finishes on wood, automotive, marine, and aerospace coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Finesse-it™ Buffing Pad - Red Foam
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed our 3M Finesse-it Buffing Pad - Red Foam as moderately aggressive foam pads with a convoluted or flat buffing surface, designed to be used in conjunction with specially developed 3M Finesse-it polishes to achieve satin, semi-gloss or high gloss finishes on wood, automotive, marine, and aerospace coatings.

coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Flap Disc 769F is a high-performance abrasive disc built for versatility and value. Powered by 3M Precision-Shaped Grain, it lasts longer and cuts faster than conventional aluminum oxide and alumina zirconia flap discs - and it's priced for affordability and everyday use. This unbeatable combination of performance and value can increase productivity while also lowering your abrasive spend.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Finesse-it™ Buffing Pad - White Foam

This white buffing pad has a convoluted buffing surface designed to be used in conjunction with Finesse-it polishes, specially developed to achieve satin, semi-gloss or high gloss finishes on wood, automotive, marine, and aerospace coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hook and Loop Disc Pad Holder
