The disc pad holder provides firm support so that heavy-duty and super-duty LGB discs can weld grind and blend with faster and more efficient productivity. 3M Disc Pad Holders allow you to quickly and easily change abrasive discs during multi-step projects.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Grinder
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Having the right tool system for the job is an essential part of any application. We engineered our 3M Grinders to power abrasives and accessories - making your cutting, grinding, blending or finishing jobs fast, easy and efficient.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hook and Loop Disc Face Plate
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hook and Loop Disc Face Plate backs a 7" Hook and Loop disc (sold separately) to provide support required for surface conditioning or finishing applications. It is used in conjunction with a disc pad hub (sold separately), which attaches to the power tool and is held into place along with the appropriate disc using a disc retainer nut (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Clean Sanding Disc 735U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Clean Sanding Disc 735U features a 3M multi-hole design that offers superior dust extraction, and features a ceramic aluminum oxide grain blend on a strong paper backing for an exceptional combination of durability and cutting efficiency.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hook and Loop Pad Holder
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hook-and-Loop Pad Holders allow you to quickly and easily change Scotch-Brite abrasive pads during multi-step projects. Holder has a swivel attachment which accepts a threaded broom handle, and the tough plastic backing distributes pressure evenly over pad surface for efficient cleaning action and improved pad life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Clean Sanding Disc 900DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Get a fast cut and long disc life with our 3M Hookit Clean Sanding Disc 900DZ. Resin-bonded to a light and flexible J-weight cloth backing, 900DZ's premium ceramic grain slices through steel and resists loading on soft woods and metals. An anti-static treatment and our proprietary clean sanding design help to provide exceptional dust management tools, backed up by our clean sanding accessories.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Paper Disc 426U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Paper Disc 426U is constructed of silicon carbide mineral on a light-weight paper backing for a fine finish on random orbital sander applications such as paint prep, whitewood sanding, sealer sanding, and solid surface finishing.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Paper Sheet 426U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Paper Sheet 426U is a general purpose abrasive sanding sheet constructed on a light, A-weight paper backing and features an anti-load coating to help prevent loading of the abrasive sheet. The silicon carbide abrasive and light backing make this paper an ideal product for sanding applications like paint prep, white wood sanding, sealer sanding and solid surface finishing.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Clean Sanding Film Disc 375L
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Hookit Clean Sanding Film Disc 375L delivers outstanding tear resistance, flexibility and a consistent, uniform finish on a variety of substrates. The premium aluminum oxide abrasive grain offers a fast cut-rate and extended product life for greater productivity.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Film Disc 375L
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Film Disc 375L delivers outstanding tear resistance, flexibility, and a consistent, uniform finish on a variety of substrates. Premium aluminum oxide abrasive grain offers a fast cut-rate and extended product life for greater productivity.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Paper Belt 366UZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Paper Belt 366UZ is constructed with our premium aluminum oxide mineral in closed coat format. It is an anti-static product that resists loading, and is coated on a heavy F-weight paper backing to efficiently sand and finish flat surfaces in woodworking applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Paper Belt 364UZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Paper Belt 346UZ is constructed with a premium aluminum oxide mineral. It is an open coat construction for loading resistance and is coated on an F-weight paper backing to efficiently sand and finish. F-weight is one of the heaviest, most rigid paper backings available and will achieve finer finishes than cloth backed belts in the same grade.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Paper Belt 966UZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Paper Belt 966UZ uses a proprietary 3M Ceramic Abrasive Grain to give you more sanding power than conventional abrasives. It is coated on an F-weight paper backing for effective sanding and finishing flat surfaces in woodworking applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Paper Roll 966UZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Paper Roll 966UZ uses a proprietary 3M Ceramic Abrasive Grain to give you more sanding power than conventional abrasives. It is coated on an F-weight paper backing for effective sanding and finishing flat surfaces in woodworking applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Paper Disc 426U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Paper Disc 426U is made for use in high-production environments and ideal for white wood sanding, sealer and solid surface sanding, or whenever a fine finish is critical. Its open coat silicon carbide abrasive mineral and anti-load coating work together to minimize loading, promote a fine finish and extend abrasive life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Random Orbital Buffer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Random Orbital Buffer 28392 is designed for use in automotive manufacturing (AOEM) paint shop applications for buffing or polishing medium-size defects on clear coat, powder coat, acrylic, solid surface and polyurethane. It features a powerful yet quiet 0.45 HP precision-balanced air-powered motor and numerous ergonomic features for expert handling and superior comfort during prolonged use.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Random Orbital Buffer 28392 Replacement Parts
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Genuine 3M Random Orbital Buffer 28392 Replacement Parts keep your 3M Random Orbital Buffer 28392 in top working condition. Every part is available to order, and finding the part you need is easy using the schematic and parts list found in the tool instruction manual.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Random Orbital Pistol Grip Sander
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our pneumatic 3M Pistol Grip Tools are designed with operator comfort in mind and are ideal for intermittent use on non-production spot sanding and finishing applications as well as paint prep and weld burn clean-up.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Random Orbital Sander - Replacement Parts
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Random Orbital Sander Replacement Parts keep your 3M Random Orbital Sander running strong. Refer to your owner's manual for detailed parts list and tool schematic to identify the part you need.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Random Orbital Sander - 2-Hand
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Random Orbital Sander two-handed design gives you extra leverage and power - with less effort. Handles are made from 3M Gripping Material for comfort and secure grip, providing improved control with reduced effort. This sander features a powerful 0.45 hp motor with a 3/8-inch orbit.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Roloc™ Fibre Disc 782C
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Engineered for ultra-rapid cut on carbon steel, 3M Roloc Fibre Disc 782C features 3M Precision Shaped Grain. With its outstanding cut, durability, and ease of use, this disc offers a major step up in performance over conventional fiber discs. Advanced abrasive technology makes it an excellent choice for tough applications including weld removal, blending, and finish refinement.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Silver Cut-Off Wheel
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Silver Cut-Off Wheel is designed to deliver an unbeatable combination of performance and value in metal cutting applications. This long-lasting wheel uses 3M Precision-Shaped Grains to deliver a fast and consistent cut through pipes, tubes or flat sheets of stainless steel, mild steel, aerospace alloys and more.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Silver Depressed Center Grinding Wheel
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Silver Depressed Center Grinding Wheel is a type 27 wheel designed to deliver an unbeatable combination of performance and value. This long-lasting wheel uses 3M Precision-Shaped Grains to deliver a fast and consistent cut during grinding and heavy stock removal on stainless steel, mild steel, aerospace alloys and more.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Cloth Disc 900DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Cloth Disc 900DZ features high-performing 3M Ceramic Abrasive Grain with a static-resistant, open coat on a flexible adhesive backing for exceptional sanding performance on both contoured and flat surfaces. The open coat abrasive provides a more aggressive cut than a comparable closed coat abrasive of the same grade and is well-suited when loading is a problem, prolonging disc

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Cloth Disc 202DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Cloth Disc 202DZ offers the convenience of a Stikit attachment combined with the durability of aluminum oxide on a flexible cloth backing, along with static resistant coating and other load resistant features for applications where dust is a concern. Our 3M Stikit pressure sensitive adhesive provides ease of attachment to a random orbital sander and a clean removal.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Cloth Roll 900DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed 3M Stikit Cloth Roll 900DZ with premium 3M Ceramic Abrasive Grain resin-bonded to a flexible J-weight cloth backing. Open coat construction resists loading. Our 3M Stikit pressure sensitive attachment system is quick, preserving operator's time.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Cloth Disc Roll 202DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Cloth Disc Roll 202DZ offers the convenience of a Stikit attachment combined with the durability of aluminum oxide on a flexible cloth backing, along with static resistant coating and other anti-loading features for applications where dust is a concern.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Cloth Roll 202DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Cloth Roll 202DZ offers the convenience of a Stikit attachment combined with the durability of aluminum oxide on a flexible cloth backing. Plus the static-resistant coating and other anti-loading features improve performance in applications where dust is a concern.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Cloth Sheet 900DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed 3M Stikit Cloth Sheet 900DZ with premium 3M Ceramic Abrasive Grain resin-bonded to a flexible J-weight cloth backing. Open coat construction resists loading. It features a Stikit pressure sensitive attachment system.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Cloth Sheet 202DZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Cloth Sheet 202DZ offers the convenience of a Stikit attachment combined with the durability of aluminum oxide on a flexible J-weight cloth backing, along with static resistant coating and other load resistant features for applications where dust is a concern.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Paper Sheet Roll 735U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Paper Sheet Roll 735U is a premium product composed of a blend of aluminum oxide and ceramic grain mineral coated on a C-weight backing. It features a load-resistant coating and offers an excellent cut-rate and life. It is ideal for a broad range of applications on a variety of substrates.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Sanding Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Stikit Sanding Block makes everyday sanding jobs easier. Comfortable to grip, it distributes pressure evenly. Sharpen corners with the flat edge, sand contours with the rounded end. 3M Stikit abrasives adhere to the backup pad, feeds from a roll and shears off when used.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Trizact™ Finesse-it™ Film Disc Roll 468LA
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Trizact Finesse-it Film Disc Roll 468LA contains all the benefits operators have come to expect from Trizact Finesse-it products: sharp, consistent cutting action balanced by uniform finishing. These discs help remove surface imperfections from automotive paint without changing the surface topography, and the Microreplication design provides consistent finishes and longer life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Wood Machine Kit 966UZ
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Wood Machine Kit 966UZ contains five wide sanding belts in different grades, ranging from P80F to P180F. Each kit has belts of varying lengths and widths. The kit provides an efficient and economical solution for multi-step projects. It's also a great solution for testing various grades and uncovering the ideal grade for a substrate or application.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ 7447 PRO Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Scotch-Brite 7447 PRO Disc combines flexible fibers with outstanding cut to help you accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results, use after use. It is a superior alternative to steel wool, wire brushes, sandpaper, and other non-woven products for cleaning or finishing tasks.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ 7447 PRO Roll
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Scotch-Brite 7447 PRO Roll combines flexible fibers with outstanding cut to help you accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results, use after use. It is an excellent alternative to steel wool, wire brushes, sandpaper, and other non-woven products for cleaning or finishing tasks.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ 7448 PRO Roll
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Scotch-Brite 7448 PRO Roll features durable, precision coated fibers that produce a fast cut and consistent finishes. The unique design of ultra-fine mineral and coated, flexible fibers is ideal for prepping surfaces for paint and primer, general scuffing and hand blending. It is an excellent alternative to steel wool, wire brushes, and sandpaper for cleaning or finishing tasks.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ 7448 PRO Sheet
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Scotch-Brite 7448 PRO Sheet features durable, precision coated fibers that produce a fast cut and consistent finishes. The unique design of ultra-fine mineral and coated, flexible fibers is ideal for prepping surfaces for paint and primer, general scuffing and hand blending. It is an excellent alternative to steel wool, wire brushes, and sandpaper for cleaning or finishing tasks.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ 7448 PRO Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Scotch-Brite 7448 PRO Disc combines flexible fibers with outstanding cut to help you accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results. This ultra fine grade disc is ideal for prepping surfaces for paint and primer, general scuffing and hand blending. It is an excellent alternative to steel wool, wire brushes and other non-woven products for cleaning or finishing tasks.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Clean and Finish Bonded Cleaning Brush
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Scotch-Brite Clean and Finish Bonded Cleaning Brush is designed for light-duty finishing and oxide or stain removal. This product is made of discs bonded to a steel core, a superior design that makes work safer, quicker and more efficient.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ 7447 PRO Sheet Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Scotch-Brite 7447 PRO Sheet Pad combines flexible fibers with outstanding cut to help you accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results, use after use. It is a superior alternative to steel wool, wire brushes, sandpaper and other non-woven products for cleaning or finishing tasks.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Clean and Finish Flap Brush
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Scotch-Brite Clean and Finish Flap Brush was engineered to perform a variety of aesthetic finishing applications on wood and metals. Whether primer scuffing and wood defuzzing or removing metal burrs and imperfections, the flaps effectively clean up the workpiece while still delivering a consistent finish.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Hookit™ Clean and Finish Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Clean and Finish Discs combine conformable material and abrasive mineral to effectively blend, clean, and polish surfaces on a wide variety materials such as aluminum, stainless steel, plastics, wood, and fiberglass; producing a clean, consistent finish without undercutting or damaging the base material.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Clean and Strip XT Pro Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Clean and Strip XT Pro Disc features silicon carbide abrasive mineral incorporated into an open nylon web. It effectively removes rust, paint, mill scale, coatings and adhesives from surfaces without significantly altering the base material. The high-strength fibers are highly conformable, resist chunking and loading, and perform well on the edges of a workpiece.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Hookit™ 7447 PRO Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Scotch-Brite Hookit 7447 PRO Disc combines flexible fibers with outstanding cut to help you accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results, use after use. It is an excellent alternative to steel wool, wire brushes, sandpaper, and other non-woven products for cleaning or finishing tasks. The Hookit backing enables convenient attachment on a random orbital sander.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4004
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4004 is an off-white, 0.250 in. (6.4 mm) thick, double coated, open cell urethane foam tape that offers high shear strength. It is ideal for applications such as mounting interior signs and nameplates.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4008
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4008 is an off-white, 0.125 in. (3.2 mm) thick, double coated, open cell urethane foam tape that offers high shear strength. It is ideal for applications such as mounting interior signage and nameplates and areas where 1/8 in. thick foam is needed for gap filling applications.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Light Grinding and Blending Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Light Grinding and Blending Disc uses a ceramic abrasive grain blend to achieve a high cut-rate for optimal weld grinding and blending in mild-steel applications. In these instances, Light Grinding and Blending discs are designed to effectively blend and refine a grade 36 scratch or finer.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4016
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4016 is an off-white, 0.0625 in. (1.6 mm) thick, double coated, open cell urethane foam tape that offers high shear strength. It is ideal for applications such as mounting interior signage and nameplates along with soap dispensers and air fresheners.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4026
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4026 is an off-white, 0.0625 in. (1.6 mm) thick, double coated, open cell urethane foam tape that offers high shear strength. It is ideal for applications such as mounting interior signage and nameplates along with soap dispensers and air fresheners.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Electroplating Tape 470
coveo:metadata.sw_description: For tape applications requiring resistance to most chemicals used in electroplating and anodizing processes, use our 3M Electroplating Tape 470. This tan, conformable tape features an abrasion resistant backing ideal for use with plating chemicals, anodizing chemicals, milling, etching and peening operations.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4056
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4056 is a black, 0.0625 in. (1.6 mm) thick, double coated, open cell urethane foam tape that offers high shear strength. It is ideal for applications such as mounting interior signage and nameplates along with soap dispensers and air fresheners.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4032
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Double Coated Urethane Foam Tape 4032 is an off-white, 0.031 in. (0.8 mm) thick, double coated, open cell urethane foam tape that offers high shear strength. It is ideal for applications such as mounting interior signage and nameplates along with soap dispensers and air fresheners.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Extreme Sealing Tape 4411G
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Extreme Sealing Tape 4411G is a gray, highly conformable, single-sided, pressure sensitive acrylic adhesive tape with a high performance ionomer backing. It is an ideal solution for creating a water tight seal. It conforms over fasteners, seams, joints, holes and gaps to ensure a long-lasting seal on a variety of substrates.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Extreme Sealing Tape 4411B
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Extreme Sealing Tape 4411B is a black, highly conformable, single-sided, pressure sensitive acrylic adhesive tape with a high performance ionomer backing. It is an ideal solution for creating a water tight seal. It conforms over fasteners, seams, joints, holes and gaps to ensure a long-lasting seal on a variety of substrates.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Extreme Sealing Tape 4411N
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Extreme Sealing Tape 4411N is a translucent, highly conformable, single-sided, pressure sensitive acrylic adhesive tape with a high performance ionomer backing. It is an ideal solution for creating a water tight seal. It conforms over fasteners, seams, joints, holes and gaps to ensure a long-lasting seal on a variety of substrates.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Extreme Sealing Tape 4412N
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Extreme Sealing Tape 4412N is a translucent, highly conformable, single-sided, pressure sensitive acrylic adhesive tape with a high performance ionomer backing. It is an ideal solution for creating a water tight seal. It conforms over fasteners, seams, joints, holes and gaps to ensure a long-lasting seal on a variety of substrates.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Extreme Sealing Tape 4412G
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Extreme Sealing Tape 4412G is a gray, highly conformable, single-sided, pressure sensitive acrylic adhesive tape with a high performance ionomer backing. It is an ideal solution for creating a water tight seal. It conforms over fasteners, seams, joints, holes and gaps to ensure a long-lasting seal on a variety of substrates.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ High Temperature Aluminum Foil Glass Cloth Tape 363
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Strong and flexible, our 3M High Temperature Aluminum Foil/Glass Cloth Tape 363 consists of an aluminum foil, glass cloth backing combined with a pressure sensitive silicone adhesive. Ideal for use as a protective wrap for heat sensitive cables and other instruments exposed to movement and vibration. Commonly used in aerospace, automotive and general industrial applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hot Melt Applicator Tips
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hot Melt Applicator Tips offer versatility when dispensing hot melt adhesives. Uniquely designed for our 3M Hot Melt Applicators, these tips can help maximize the use of our hot melt adhesives by improving productivity, optimizing precision, and reducing waste in your assembly process.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Polyurethane Adhesive Sealant 550 Fast Cure
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Polyurethane Adhesive Sealant 550 Fast Cure is our low viscosity adhesive that has a fast set time and creates a permanently elastic bond. It is ideal for bonding a variety of similar and dissimilar materials. This one-component polyurethane adhesive provides fast cure time. The low viscosity formula is ideal for creating very thin bond lines.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Polyurethane Adhesive Sealant 560
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Polyurethane Adhesive Sealant 560 is a high-strength, single-component, moisture-curing, gap-filling polyurethane adhesive that creates high strength bonds on a wide variety of materials including plastics, metals, fiberglass and wood.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Polyurethane Multi-Purpose Adhesive 5010
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Polyurethane Multi-Purpose Adhesive 5010 is a one component, fast curing adhesive which forms a rigid permanent bond. It is designed to bond wood to a wide variety of materials including wood, foam panels, metal and steel, some plastics, glass and fiberglass.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Polyurethane Sealant 540
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Polyurethane Sealant 540 is an all-purpose, single-component, moisture-curing, gap-filling polyurethane that creates permanently elastic seals and bonds in a wide variety of service environments.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Polyurethane Glass Adhesive Sealant 590
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Polyurethane Glass Adhesive Sealant 590 is a one-part, high viscosity polyurethane sealant for bonding windshields and other glass, acrylic, polycarbonate and many other materials. This high strength adhesive stays flexible after cure, resulting in a durable, long-lasting bond that helps joints or bonded areas resist vibration fatigue.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Preservation Sealing Tape 4811
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Preservation Sealing Tape 4811 is a white, polyethylene tape with a unique rubber adhesive. With excellent stain resistance and weatherability, this tape helps preserve, seal and protect equipment for long-term storage applications in a variety of weather conditions.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PTFE Film Tape 5491
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M PTFE Film Tape 5491 uses an extruded polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) film backing. This tape offers an extremely low coefficient of friction which, in combination with a pressure sensitive silicone adhesive, creates a smooth, non-stick surface over a variety of substrates to assist in the movement of materials in many types of lay-flat applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PTFE Glass Cloth Tape 5453
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our premium performance 3M PTFE Glass Cloth Tape 5453 has a brown woven glass cloth backing impregnated with PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene). This tape provides a slick surface on process machinery and offers an extremely low coefficient of friction which, in combination with a pressure sensitive silicone adhesive, creates a non-stick surface that performs at elevated temperatures.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PTFE Film Tape 5490
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M PTFE Film Tape 5490 uses an extruded polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) film backing. This tape offers an extremely low coefficient of friction which, in combination with a pressure sensitive silicone adhesive, creates a smooth, non-stick surface over a variety of substrates to assist in the movement of materials in many types of lay-flat applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Weld™ EPX Manual Applicators
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Scotch-Weld EPX Manual Applicators are used to dispense two-component 3M Scotch-Weld Structural Adhesives packaged in Duo-Pak (DP) cartridges. There are a variety of applicators available to match the needs of your manufacturing process.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Weld™ EPX Mixing Nozzle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Choose 3M Scotch-Weld EPX Mixing Nozzles for efficient application of 3M Scotch-Weld Structural Adhesives in Duo-Pak (DP) cartridges. Each nozzle provide thorough mixing and precise placement of two part adhesives and potting compounds.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Weld™ EPX Pneumatic Applicators
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Scotch-Weld EPX Pneumatic Applicators are used to dispense two-component 3M Scotch-Weld Structural Adhesives packaged in Duo-Pak (DP) cartridges. There are a variety of pneumatic applicators available to match the needs of your manufacturing process.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Weld™ EPX Plunger
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Scotch-Weld EPX Plungers for Manual Applicators drive a precise mix and smooth flow for 1:1, 2:1. 3:2 and 10:1 3M Scotch-Weld Duo-Pak Cartridges in 43mL, 45mL and 200mL sizes

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Weld™ PUR Adhesive Applicator Accessory
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Scotch-Weld PUR Adhesive Applicator Accessories are designed to help maintain and add functionality to your 3M Scotch-Weld PUR System. Choose from a variety of applicator tips, nozzle assemblies and air valve kits to find the right accessories for your stringent project requirements.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Weld™ PUR Easy 250 Applicator
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Scotch-Weld PUR Easy 250 Applicator is a self-contained, hand held pneumatic applicator designed to dispense cartridges of 3M Scotch-Weld PUR Adhesives. These adhesives are applied warm and can bond a wide variety of substrates such as wood, fiber reinforced plastic (FRP) and many other plastics to themselves, to metal and to glass. The proprietary nozzle makes clean up a breeze.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Super 77™ CA Multi-Purpose Spray Adhesive - Low VOC <25%
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Super 77 CA Multi-Purpose Spray Adhesive - Low VOC <25% is an extremely versatile, fast-drying adhesive that bonds a wide range of lightweight materials quickly, without soaking through. Its fast, aggressive tack makes it ideal for a wide variety of projects.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Weld™ PUR Easy 250 Preheater
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Designed to warm 3M Scotch-Weld Polyurethane Reactive (PUR) Adhesive prior to use, the 3M Scotch-Weld PUR Easy 250 Preheater keeps up to 4 PUR cartridges at optimum temperature for easy swap out.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Sealing Tape 8777
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Sealing Tape 8777 is a translucent tape with a proprietary film backing and high-tack acrylic adhesive available on a split liner. We designed this self-adhered tape for difficult-to-stick surfaces, including damp surfaces. This sealing tape has an adhesive that withstands heat and will not melt or stain in high temperatures.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Venture Tape™ Aluminum Foil Tape 1521CW
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Venture Tape Aluminum Foil Tape 1521CW is a high-strength, dead soft aluminum foil tape coated with a cold weather pressure sensitive acrylic adhesive. This tape excels in demanding temperature and humidity applications and is designed for vapor sealing applications on ductwork and exterior insulation materials.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ UHMW PE Film Tape 5421
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Used to protect surfaces from abrasion, 3M UHMW-PE Film Tape 5421 is a thin caliper general purpose polyethylene tape that creates a "slip plane" effect to allow contact without wear. This tape features a unique combination of properties that make it ideal for many tough impact wear or sliding applications. 3M UHMW-PE Film Tape 5421 is a thinner version of 3M UHMW-PE Film Tape 5423.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ VHB™ Flame Retardant Tape 5958FR
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dream, Design, Deliver with our 3M VHB Flame Retardant Tape 5958FR. It is a black, 0.040 in (1.0 mil) modified acrylic adhesive with a very conformable, foam core. The fast and easy to use permanent bonding method provides high strength, long-term durability and is flame retardant. It offers design flexibility with its viscoelasticity and powerful ability to bond to a variety of surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ VHB™ Tape 4618
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dream, Design, Deliver with our 3M VHB Tape 4618. It is a white, 0.025 in (0.6 mm), general purpose adhesive on the face side and multi-purpose adhesive on liner side of a conformable, acrylic foam core. It can replace rivets, welds and screws. It offers design flexibility with its viscoelasticity and powerful ability to bond to a variety of surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ VHB™ Tape 4622
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dream, Design, Deliver with our 3M VHB Tape 4622. It is a white, 0.045 in (1.1 mm), general purpose adhesive on the face side and multi-purpose adhesive on liner side of a conformable foam. It can replace rivets, welds and screws. It offers design flexibility with its viscoelasticity and powerful ability to bond to a variety of surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ VHB™ Tape 4611
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M VHB Tape 4611 is a dark gray, 0.045 in (1.1 mil), general purpose adhesive with firm foam and the added feature of high temperature resistance. This fast and easy to use permanent bonding method can replace rivets, welds and screws, providing high strength and long-term durability. It offers design flexibility with its viscoelasticity and powerful ability to bond to a variety of surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ VHB™ Tape 4646
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M VHB Tape 4646 is a dark gray, 0.025 in (0.6 mm), general purpose adhesive with firm foam and the added feature of high temperature resistance. Its acrylic foam core provides a good balance of strength and conformability. 3M VHB Tape GPH-160 has excellent temperature resistance, ideal for powder coat or liquid paint processes which undergo a heat bake cycle.
