coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® ATG Adhesive Transfer Tape 924
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch ATG Adhesive Transfer Tape 924 quickly and permanently bonds a wide variety of materials including uncoated and coated paper, card stock, paper board, matting, lightweight fabrics, foils, flexible plastics and foam board. Offering high adhesion and excellent UV resistance, it easily bonds to difficult, varied and textured surfaces, including areas with high humidity and sunlight.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® Filament Tape 893
coveo:metadata.sw_description: For securing boxes and pallets, bundling pipe or reinforcing large bulk containers, Scotch Filament Tape 893 is a high-strength, reliable and affordable solution for product and package. This filament-reinforced tape has a clear, polypropylene backing that resists abrasion, moisture, scuffing and breaks, even if nicked or punctured.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® ATG Adhesive Transfer Tape 969
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch ATG Adhesive Transfer Tape 969 features very high initial adhesion and good shear holding power for bonding most plastics and glossy coated materials. Reverse wound on 1-inch diameter core for use in Scotch ATG Applicators.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® Filament Tape 897
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Scotch Filament Tape 897 is a medium strength, general purpose, clear fiberglass-reinforced tape -with a synthetic rubber resin adhesive ideal for medium-duty strapping, bundling and reinforcing. Our synthetic rubber resin adhesive provides good adhesion to most surfaces, including a variety of plastics, carpets, natural fibers, and metals.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® Filament Tape 898
coveo:metadata.sw_description: With a polypropylene backing that resists abrasion, moisture, scuffing and breaks, try Scotch Filament Tape 898. This filament-reinforced tape is ideal for securing boxes, bundling pipe or reinforcing large bulk containers, Scotch Filament Tape 898 is a high-strength, reliable and affordable solution for product and package integrity.

coveo:metadata.title: Tartan™ Filament Tape 8934
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tartan Filament Tape 8934 is our general purpose clear fiberglass-reinforced tape with a synthetic rubber resin adhesive, ideal for light duty strapping, bundling and reinforcing. Our synthetic rubber resin adhesive provides good adhesion to most fiberboard surfaces, and a variety of plastics and metal surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ High Performance Masking Tape 2693
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M High Performance Masking Tape 2693 is a smooth, heavy-duty, mini-crepe paper masking tape well suited to most applications where a latex-free alternative is required. It is often used in sensitive environments like healthcare facilities.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ General Use Masking Tape 201+
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed 3M General Use Masking Tape 201+ to be a go-to tape that holds strongly in settings where surface temperatures can reach up to 200°F/93°C. This light tan crepe paper tape has a low unwind and sticks to many surfaces, making it an ideal everyday-use tape.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ High Temperature Paint Masking Film 7300
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M High Temperature Paint Masking Film 7300 is designed to protect in paint applications involving temps above 310°F or where bleed-through of solvents and paints may occur. This film is designed for soft flexing, provide good drape and conformability. It is excellent for two-tone, blackout and repair painting to match OEM finishes. An apron-taper best helps to dispense the film.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Masking Tape 2380
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Performance Masking Tape 2380 was designed for industrial use where the best possible paint line is desired and drying conditions range from air dry to oven bake. Our smooth, strong, mini-crepe paper masking tape holds fast, removes easily and will give you great performance for most paint masking applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Plus Duct Tape 8979N
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Performance Plus Duct Tape 8979N is a highly specialized duct tape ideally suited for demanding applications in the nuclear power plant, ship building, and steel fabrication industries. It is commonly used for sealing, holding, identification and protection. This tape resists wear, abrasion, moisture, and UV exposure for up to 12 months.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Plus Duct Tape 8979
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Constructed of polyethylene film laminated to cloth with a rubber adhesive, this tape resists curling and tears off the roll cleanly for easy application on rough surfaces. 3M Performance Plus Duct Tape 8979 has a unique construction that allows for applications indoors and outdoors. It is removable with little or no adhesive residue up to six months after application.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Yellow Masking Tape 301+
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed 3M Performance Yellow Masking Tape 301+ to deliver good paint lines where surface temperatures can reach up to 225°F/107°C. This yellow crepe paper tape is ideal for paint masking applications in specialty vehicle, aerospace, automotive and industrial markets where strong holding performance is required.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Specialty High Temperature Masking Tape 501+
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed 3M Specialty High Temperature Masking Tape 501+ to deliver clean paint lines where surface temperatures can reach up to 300°F/150°C. This tan crepe paper tape is ideal for critical paint masking applications in specialty vehicle, automotive and industrial markets where strong holding and high-temperature performance is required.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Specialty High Temperature Purple Masking Tape 501+
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed 3M Specialty High Temperature Purple Masking Tape 501+ to deliver clean paint lines where surface temperatures can reach up to 300°F/150°C degrees. This purple crepe paper tape is ideal for critical paint masking applications in specialty vehicle, automotive and industrial markets where strong holding and high temperature performance is required.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Value Masking Tape 101+
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Value Masking Tape 101+ is a cost-effective crepe paper tape that holds, bundles, seals and performs other non-critical taping jobs where a pressure sensitive tape is needed. This tape offers controlled unwind to prevent shredding or splintering and tears easily from the roll by hand.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® Box Sealing Tape 375
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch Box Sealing Tape 375 is a high-performance packing tape that securely closes a wide variety of heavy weight box materials, including recycled fiberboard. The polypropylene film backing is easy to unwind and resists abrasion, moisture and scuffing. The backing easily conforms around edges and on rough surfaces for a tight seal.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® Filament Tape Hand Dispenser H10
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch Filament Tape Hand Dispenser H10 is a portable, high-impact, durable hand-held unit designed to dispense 1/2 inch to 1 inch width tapes. This dispenser is specifically designed for box sealing applications using narrow width rolls of Scotch Filament Tapes.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® Fine Line Tape 218
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch Fine Line Tape 218 is a high-performance polypropylene plastic tape that has both a low profile and high adhesion for use in painting long straight lines and sweeping curves where a crisp, sharp paint line is desired. It is often used as a layout tape for high value multi-color and custom painted graphics.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® High Temperature Fine Line Tape 4737
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch High Temperature Fine Line Tape 4737 is a conformable tape used to achieve sharp paint lines and color separation for curves and straight lines. It has proven successful in high-temperature painting applications requiring a conformable tape. It is available in three options: opaque blue (4737S), translucent blue (4737T) and with a liner (4737TL, 4737SL).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Flap Discs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Cubitron II Flap Discs is engineered for a faster cut, longer disc life and a more uniform finish vs. conventional ceramic abrasives. Flexible flaps feature our Precision Shaped Grain (PSG) technology - super-sharp triangular grains, electrostatically oriented on a flexible backing for an extremely fast, even cut. Overlapping flaps provide cushion for grinding and blending with one disc.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® Ultimate Paint Edge Masking Tape 2460
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch Ultimate Paint Edge Masking Tape 2460 features unique acrylic adhesive technology for good, instant adhesion that is temperature-resistant and capable of withstanding paint bake operations of up to 300°F. This adhesive also peels off cleanly, without leaving residue. The ultra-thin backing of this masking tape produces a low paint ridge for sharp and smooth paint lines.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Hookit™ Clean Sanding Abrasive Discs 737U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Cubitron II Hookit Clean Sanding Abrasive Discs 737U combines the highest 3M technologies for automotive repair. Its long-lasting sharp triangular shaped grain and multi-hole pattern for superior dust extraction make the disc ideal for paint removal, rough body filler shaping, fine feather-edging or final prep before blending or priming. The Hookit system makes for quick disc change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Hookit™ Marine Sanding Abrasive Discs 737U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Cubitron II Hookit Marine Sanding Abrasive Discs 737U combines the highest 3M technology for marine repair. Its long-lasting triangular shaped grain and multi-hole pattern for superior dust extraction make the disc ideal for paint removal, rough body filler shaping, fine feather-edging or final prep before blending or priming. Our Hookit system makes for quick disc change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Hookit™ Clean Sanding Sheet Rolls 737U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Cubitron II Hookit Clean Sanding Sheet Rolls 737U combines the highest 3M technology for automotive repair. Its long-lasting triangular shaped grain and multi-hole pattern for superior dust extraction make it ideal for paint removal, rough body filler shaping, fine feather-edging or final prep before blending or priming. Our Hookit system makes for quick change-outs of abrasive sheets.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Hookit™ File Sheets 737U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Cubitron II Hookit File Sheets 737U combines the highest 3M technology for automotive repair. Its long-lasting triangular shaped grains make the sheet ideal for paint stripping, rough shaping of body filler and sanding plastic filler. Our Hookit system makes for quick change-outs of abrasive sheets.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fibre Disc Back-up Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Fibre Disc Backup Pad is built tough to support our 5" DA. fiber discs on right angle sanders. Compatible with a range of 3M face plates, this hard rubber disc pad maximizes your abrasive discs - it is designed to reduce the vibration and chunking that degrades their effectiveness. The pad fastens securely to grinding tools with a disc retainer nut (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Emery Cloth
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Emery Cloth is designed for metal sanding jobs that require durability, such as removing rust and corrosion from metal - ideal for auto repair. Its tough emery abrasive combines various mineral oxides and is mounted on durable cloth backing that resists shredding and tearing. All of it is resin cured for overall durability to last much longer than standard sandpaper.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Back-up Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Hookit Back-up Pad is available in soft, medium and hard foam densities for support during jobs from paint removal to fine finishing. Center-hole pads feature flat rigid centers and softer edges, providing added control. Our 6- and 7-in. pads feature several hole patterns to promote dust extraction. Our Hookit attachment system makes changing discs fast and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Foam Compounding Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Foam Compounding Pad is a great, fast-cutting foam pad designed for refining and removing sanding scratches and swirls. The convolute foam face conforms to curves and body lines to reduce chatter for improved finishes. It also holds compound to help reduce slinging and the hook-and-loop attachment makes for fast, easy attachment to rotary polishers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Blue Abrasive Discs 321U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Hookit Blue Abrasive Disc 321U delivers best-in-class performance at every stage of paint prep and body repair. Premium aluminum oxide mineral abrasive is blended with ceramic grain for a full range of automotive sanding applications. Our multi-hole discs feature a specially-designed pattern that reduces loading, extends disc life and aligns with most backup pads. Hookit attachment makes disc changes easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Moisture Resistant Protective Sheeting
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Moisture Resistant Protective Sheeting is designed to reduce moisture staining in higher-temp drying applications. It provides fast single-person application for reduced overspray-related rework. Film can be used in IR dryers at temps up to 248°F/120°C, helping eliminate dampness. Translucent film is easy to apply, reposition and cut. A light static cling keeps it in place without adhesives.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Blue Abrasive Sheet Rolls 321U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Hookit Blue Abrasive Sheet Rolls 321U delivers best-in-class performance at every stage of paint prep and body repair. Premium aluminum oxide mineral is blended with ceramic grain for a full range of automotive sanding jobs. A specially-designed multi-hole pattern captures dust, reduces loading and extends sheet life. Perforated Hookit sheets are easily sized to reduce product waste.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1 Foam Finishing Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Perfect-It 1 Foam Finishing Pad is a blue-colored, high-performance paint finishing pad designed to be used with Perfect-it 1 Finishing Material (sold separately) to remove Trizact abrasive scratches.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Pneumatic Applicator
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Pneumatic Guns for 2-Part Cartridges are designed for dispensing 3M 2-part adhesives and sealers and come in two sizes compatible with 200 mL or 400 mL cartridges. Ideal for large volume jobs, they dispense a range of two-component repair epoxies quickly and smoothly, saving time and reducing rework. The snap-in cartridge system eliminates premixing and maximizes material use.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1-Step Foam Finishing Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Perfect-It 1-Step Foam Finishing Pad essentially compounds and polishes in one step - eliminating the time and expense of compounding when used as part of the 3M Perfect-It 1-Step Paint Finishing system. Specially designed foam pads are available in 4", 6" and 8" diameters with Quick Connect attachment for precise centering or Hookit attachment for quick change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1-Step Finishing Material
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Perfect-It 1-Step Finishing Material essentially compounds and polishes in one step - eliminating the time and expense of compounding when used as part of the 3M Perfect-It 1-Step Paint Finishing System. Like all 3M Perfect-It compounds and polishes, it delivers a longer working time yet still reduces sling for easier cleanup.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Seam Sealer Tape
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We designed our 3M Seam Sealer Tape for auto body professionals to easily duplicate the factory look and function of sealers typical in automotive door jambs and trunk gutters. This rubber backed, 20 mil thick tape is very durable and doesn't require shaping or drying time like liquid sealers. Just apply and paint - the adhesive is activated by solvent in the paint system for a permanent bond.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Sanding Block Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Stikit Sanding Block Kit lets you keep comfort and convenience on hand for effective sanding. A range of 6 block sizes allows auto repair technicians to hand sand precisely where needed, with plenty of support even for hard-to-sand areas. These easy-to-use tools work with our 3M Stikit abrasive sheet rolls, featuring adhesive backing that applies firmly to the block during sanding.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Self-Stick Liquid Protection Fabric
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Self-Stick Liquid Protection Fabric is ideal for a wide range of temporary surface protection in industrial settings. Its liquid-proof layer protects work surfaces from water, oils, solvents and more. Its nonwoven surface traps dirt, dust and debris and prevents them from spreading through the facility. Its adhesive backing keeps it securely in place and removes without residue.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Tack Cloth
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Tack Cloth is ideal for critical cleanup and removal of dust, lint and other particles from auto body surfaces before painting. This cloth features a very light adhesive that draws dust and sanding particles into it, yet it does not leave drag marks on the surface or adhesive on the hands.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Trizact™ Hookit™ Clear Coat Sanding Abrasive Disc 471LA
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Trizact Hookit Clear Coat Sanding Abrasive Disc 471LA is ideal for spot repairs, including leveling dust nibs and orange peel, before sand scratch removal. Microreplicated 3-D mineral abrasive structures are distributed uniformly across the disc surface and wear evenly for consistent repair and longer disc life. Film-backed discs are part of the 3M Perfect-It Paint Finishing System.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ White Masking Paper
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M White Masking Paper is specially treated to resist heat from paint booths and penetration by paint solvents, urethanes, base coats and clear coats - ideal for collision repair. It is tightly bonded, virtually eliminating lint or fiber contamination that can occur using paper masking. And its thin but conformable construction makes it easy to handle, boosting shop efficiency.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® Slimline Apron Taper
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch Slimline Apron Taper is an upright, portable masking dispenser that dispenses paper and attaches tape. We built this taper with side hooks that are able to hold different tape widths for special application needs. This apron taper can be moved from job to job with one hand and there is no need for adjustment as it maintains the proper paper and tape alignment.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ Classic Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M E-A-R Classic earplugs set the standard in hearing protection as the world's first foam earplugs. Constructed from slow-recovery foam, these disposable earplugs are uniquely moisture-resistant.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-Rsoft™ FX Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M E-A-Rsoft FX earplugs feature a bell shape and super-soft, slow-recovery foam to effectively seal the ear canal and provide reliable hearing protection

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-Rsoft™ SuperFit™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M E-A-Rsoft foam earplugs seal the ear canal with soft, slow-recovery foam for excellent noise reduction and reliable hearing protection. Orange fitting ring provides a guideline for proper fitting and visual compliance check.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ E-A-Rsoft™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: These earplugs seal the ear canal with soft, slow-recovery foam for excellent noise reduction and reliable hearing protection.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ Classic™ Plus Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M E-A-R Classic earplugs set the standard in hearing protection as the world's first foam earplugs. Classic Plus earplugs are slightly longer than regular E-A-R Classic earplugs for higher noise reduction when fit deeply in the ear canal.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ Express™ Pod Plugs™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M E-A-R Express Pod Plugs push-to-fit earplugs feature advanced "no-roll", slow-recovery foam tips and assorted, paddle-style color grips. Unique grips allow easy fitting and help keep earplug tips clean even when your hands are dirty.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ Multi-Position Earmuffs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M earmuffs feature durable, lightweight construction of non-conductive, dielectric plastic that can be worn over-the-head, behind-the-neck or under-the-chin.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ Pistonz™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Pistonz push-to-fit earplugs are stylish hearing protection that feature soft foam tips with a metallic look and a convenient thumb-grip stem. No-roll foam makes fitting easy; simply push the earplug into the ear canal and twist to adjust the fit.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ Push-Ins™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M E-A-R Push-Ins push-to-fit foam earplugs provide extended hearing comfort, convenience and protection. Constructed of 3M E-A-Rform foam, these earplugs feature a no roll-down design and a blue stem for a quick and easy fit.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ Swerve Banded Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M E-A-R Swerve Banded Hearing Protector combines a cutting-edge band design with the effectiveness of E-A-R foam earplugs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ TaperFit™ 2 Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M E-A-R TaperFit 2 foam earplugs feature smooth foam that expands in the ear canal to help provide comfortable hearing protection.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ UltraFit™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M E-A-R UltraFit corded earplugs features a proprietary, premolded, triple-flange design that fits comfortably in most ear canals.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Multi Gas/Vapor Cartridge 6006
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved against certain organic vapors, acid gases, ammonia, methylamine or formaldehyde. Use with 3M Half and Full Facepieces 6000, 7000 and FF-400 Series with a bayonet-style filter/cartridge connection or 3M Scott AV-3000 HT and AV-3000 SureSeal facepieces with 3M Scott AV-632 Bayonet Adapter.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Multi Gas/Vapor Cartridge/Filter 60926
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved against certain organic vapors, acid gases and particulates. Use with 3M Half and Full Facepieces 6000, 7000 and FF-400 Series with a bayonet-style filter/cartridge connection or 3M Scott AV-3000 HT and AV-3000 SureSeal facepieces with 3M Scott AV-632 Bayonet Adapter.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ No-Touch™ Push-to-Fit Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M No-Touch push-to-fit foam earplugs create a hygienic, noise-reducing seal in the ear canal with soft foam, a smooth tapered shape and paddle stems. Push-to-fit design makes fitting hearing protection easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Organic Vapor Cartridge/Filter 60921
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved against certain organic vapors and particulates. Use with 3M Half and Full Facepieces 6000, 7000 and FF-400 Series with a bayonet-style filter/cartridge connection or 3M Scott AV-3000 HT and AV-3000 SureSeal facepieces with 3M Scott AV-632 Bayonet Adapter.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Organic Vapor Cartridge 6001
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved against certain organic vapors. Use with 3M Half and Full Facepieces 6000, 7000 and FF-400 Series with a bayonet-style filter/cartridge connection or 3M Scott AV-3000 HT and AV-3000 SureSeal facepieces with 3M Scott AV-632 Bayonet Adapter.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Organic Vapor Service Life Indicator Cartridge 6001i
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Includes the 3M Service Life Indicator, an end-of-service-life indicator (ESLI) that can help users determine when to change cartridges in appropriate environments. See User Instructions to determine if the indicator is appropriate for your work environment. NIOSH approved against certain organic vapors. Use with 3M Half and Full Facepieces 6000, 6500, 7500, 7800 and FF-400 Series or 3M Scott AV-3000 HT and AV-3000 SureSeal facepieces with 3M Scott AV-632 Bayonet Adapter.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Organic Vapor/Acid Gas Cartridge/Filter 60923
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved against certain organic vapors, acid gases and particulates. Use with 3M Half and Full Facepieces 6000, 7000 and FF-400 Series with a bayonet-style filter/cartridge connection or 3M Scott AV-3000 HT and AV-3000 SureSeal facepieces with 3M Scott AV-632 Bayonet Adapter.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter 2071
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved for environments containing certain oil and non-oil based particles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Organic Vapor/Acid Gas Cartridge/Filter 60928
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved for certain organic vapors, acid gases and particulates. 3M recommended for use against radioiodine or methyl bromide. Use with 3M Half and Full Facepieces 6000, 7000 and FF-400 Series with a bayonet-style filter/cartridge connection or 3M Scott AV-3000 HT and AV-3000 SureSeal facepieces with 3M Scott AV-632 Bayonet Adapter.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter 2078
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved for environments containing certain oil and non-oil based particles. 3M recommended for relief against nuisance levels of organic vapor/acid gases and for ozone protection up to 10X OSHA PEL.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter 2091
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved for environments containing certain oil and non-oil based particles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter 2096
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved for environments containing certain oil and non-oil based particles. 3M recommended for relief against nuisance levels of acid gases.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter 2097
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved for environments containing certain oil and non-oil based particles. 3M recommended for nuisance level organic vapor relief and for ozone protection up to 10X OSHA PEL.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter 5P71
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved for environments containing certain oil and non-oil based particles. Use with 3M Respirators 5000 Series or 3M Cartridges 6000 Series or 3M Filter Adapter 603, and 3M Filter Retainer 501.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter 7093
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved for environments containing certain oil and non-oil based particles. Use with 3M Respirators 5000 Series or 3M Cartridges 6000 Series with 3M Adapter 502, 3M Facepieces 6000 Series, or 3M Facepieces 7000 Series with a bayonet-style filter/cartridge connection or 3M Scott AV-3000 HT and AV-3000 SureSeal facepieces with 3M Scott AV-632 Bayonet Adapter.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter 5N11
coveo:metadata.sw_description: NIOSH approved for environments containing certain non-oil based particles. Use with 3M Respirators 5000 Series or 3M Cartridges 6000 Series or 3M Filter Adapter 603, and 3M Filter Retainer 501.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8200
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This economical disposable N95 particulate respirator is designed to help provide reliable worker respiratory protection against certain non oil based particles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8233
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This disposable N100 particulate respirator is designed to help provide comfortable, reliable worker respiratory protection against certain non oil based particles. Features 3M Cool Flow Valve, foam faceseal, adjustable straps and individual packaging.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8214
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This disposable N95 particulate welding respirator with carbon layer helps provide respiratory protection where metal fumes may be present including those with ozone* and nuisance level organic vapors**. Features foam faceseal and 3M Cool Flow Valve.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8210
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This classic disposable N95 particulate respirator is designed to help provide comfortable, reliable worker respiratory protection against certain non oil based particles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8240
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This economical R95 disposable particulate respirator is designed to help provide comfortable, reliable worker respiratory protection against certain oil and non oil based particles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8246
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This disposable R95 particulate respirator helps provide reliable respiratory protection against certain oil and non oil based particles. Constructed with a carbon filter layer for nuisance levels of acid gases*.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8247
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This disposable R95 particulate respirator helps provide reliable respiratory protection against certain oil and non oil based particles. Constructed with a carbon filter layer for nuisance levels of organic vapors*.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8271
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This disposable P95 particulate respirator features 3M proprietary advanced electret filter media, foam faceseal and 3M Cool Flow Valve to help provide comfortable worker respiratory protection against certain oil and non oil based particles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8293
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This disposable P100 particulate respirator helps provide comfortable, reliable worker respiratory protection for certain oil and non oil based particles. Features 3M Cool Flow Valve, foam faceseal, adjustable straps and individual packaging.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PELTOR™ X1 Earmuffs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: X Series earmuffs are 3M's latest advancement in hearing conservation. New technologies in comfort, design and protection all come together in this groundbreaking earmuff line.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8577
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This disposable P95 particulate respirator helps provide respiratory protection against certain oil and non oil based particles. The respirator features a carbon layer to remove nuisance levels* of organic vapors. It features 3M Cool Flow Valve.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PELTOR™ X5 Earmuffs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: X Series earmuffs are 3M's latest advancement in hearing conservation. New technologies in comfort, design and protection all come together in this groundbreaking earmuff line.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ 100 QR Series Welding Helmets
coveo:metadata.sw_description: With hard hat, rail attachment, and auto-darkening filters, the 3M Speedglas 100 QR Welding Helmet can be helpful for workers who are looking for head protection, as well as protection against the intense light of MIG, TIG, and stick applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ 100 Series Welding Helmet
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Speedglas 100 Series Welding Helmet helps protect welders from flying sparks and airborne debris, and its auto-darkening filters guard against the high-intensity light of MIG, TIG, and stick welding. With an optional hard-hat adapter, this helmet is a great choice for welders starting off their careers, tradesmen, and DIYers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M SecureFit 200 Series Safety Glasses
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M SecureFit Safety Glasses 200 Series offers lightweight comfort at an affordable price. Featuring 3M Pressure Diffusion Temple Technology, 3M's innovative temple design features slotted ribs that provide comfortable pressure equalization, allowing the temples to flex and self-adjust to the size and shape of the wearer's head.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ 9100 FX Air Series Welding Helmets
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 9100 FX-Air Welding Shield is designed to be used with 3M Air Delivery Units

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ 9100 FX-Air Upgrade Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Speedglas Welding Helmet 9100 FX-Air Upgrade Kit allows users to upgrade their existing 3M Adflo Powered Air Respirator or 3M Versaflo Supplied Air Regulator System.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ 9100 FX Series Welding Helmets
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Speedglas 9100 FX Welding Helmet features a flip-up auto-darkening filter (ADF) design. It incorporates a secondary clear faceshield that's ideal for grinding and set-up work, while the ADF helps protect against the intense light of MIG, TIG, and stick applications. The integrated hard hat provides additional head protection, while side windows in the welding helmet give each welder a wider viewing field to see more of their work area.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ 9100 QR Series Welding Helmets
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Speedglas Welding Helmet 9100 QR is a replaceable spare part for use if the original welding helmet is in need of replacement.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ 9100 Series Auto-Darkening Welding Filters
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Speedglas Auto Darkening Filter 9100XX is intended for use with 3M Speedglas Welding Helmet Series 9100. Designed to help protect your eyes and face from radiation, heat and sparks, the 3M Speedglas Auto Darkening Filter 9100XX provides a precise view of your work.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ Welding Helmet 9100
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Protecting your eyes and face from radiation, heat and sparks-while providing a precise view of your work-makes your Speedglas welding helmet 9100 one of your most important welding tools.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ FlexView Protection Plate
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Replacement protection plate for 3M FlexView Systems. Clear polycarbonate.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ SL Welding Helmets
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Be the featherweight champ with the 3M Speedglas SL. At only 12.6 oz. (including filter), it's 25% lighter than our current auto darkening welding helmets. New head suspension increases adjustability.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Speedglas™ 9100 FX-Air Wide-View Grinding Visor
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Replacement wide-view clear grinding visor for the Speedglas 9100 FX-Air welding helmet. Viewing area of 8 in x 4.25 in (200 mm x 110 mm)

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Supplied Air Hoses & Hose Assemblies
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This hose is 50 feet long and has a 3/8 inch inner diameter. It's equipped with MPT fittings at both ends and accepts 1/4 inch FPT fittings. You may not combine 25 or 50 foot lengths of the 3M Supplied Air Hose W-9435.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo™ Painter's Supplied Air Respirator Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Designed to help provide a convenient respiratory protection system for your painters, the 3M Versaflo Painter's Supplied Air Respirator (SAR) Kit includes a lightweight faceshield, breathing tube, and cooling valve. Combine this personal protective equipment with a 3M supplied air hose and an air source for help with respiratory protection on the job.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Tri-Flange™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: These durable, reusable cloth corded earplugs are easy to use again and again, reducing waste.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo™ TR-300 Series PAPR Assemblies
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The TR-300 PAPR is a light weight, easy-to-use PAPR for protection against particulates and certain nuisance odors.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo™ TR-300 Series PAPR Kits
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Whether your workers are in pharmaceutical manufacturing or in healthcare, 3M has a Powered Air Purifying Respirator (PAPR) System to help protect them on the job. Each one of our 3M Versaflo TR-300+ Series Ready-to-use Kits comes equipped with everything your workers needs to get started, including job-specific headgear and accessories.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo™ TR-600 Series PAPR Assemblies
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The flexible system you build for your workers' needs. Can be used in a wide variety of applications, leveraging an extensive range of NIOSH-approved filters and cartridges. Also is compatible with a variety of headgear.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo™ TR-600 & TR-800 Series PAPR Cartridges
coveo:metadata.sw_description: These particulate filters/cartridges may be suitable for operations where the primary hazard is particulate and/or certain gases and vapors, such as in pharmaceutical manufacturing, mold remediation, painting operations and etc. Various protection types available.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo™ Powered Air Purifying Respirator Painters Kit TR-800
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Whether you're mixing and granulating compounds in a pharmaceutical facility or working with combustible gases in the oil and gas industry, 3M Versaflo TR-800 Powered Air Purifying Respirator Kits are built for environments where intrinsically safe (IS) equipment is essential. Each one of these PAPR kits come equipped with everything your team needs to get started.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Virtua™ Protective Eyewear
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Virtua protective eyewear line merges outstanding unisex style, protection and affordability, all while offering wearers an open, unobstructed viewing range and three size options to fit a variety of facial profiles. Designed for indoor or outdoor use, Virtua protective eyewear is a valuable choice in vision safety.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Virtua™ CCS Series Protective Eyewear
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Designed to keep eyewear and earplugs attached, untangled and ready to use, 3M Virtua CCS Protective Eyewear offers both protection and affordability. The optional foam gasket attachment helps limit eye exposure to dirt and debris while providing added comfort and cushioning.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Virtua™ AP Protective Eyewear
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Virtua™ AP Protective Eyewear is an economy line of safety glasses that offer style, protection and affordability. Providing a wide viewing area, the wraparound design combines with the integrated side shields to help keep eyes protected.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Electrical Insulating Sealers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Electrical Insulating Sealers 1601-C (clear) and 1602-R (red) are electrical grade, fast drying sealers and insulators. They come in a pressurized can and help to protect surfaces from weather, moisture, corrosion, oil, alkalis and acids.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Clean-Walk Framed Mat 5840
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Clean Walk Framed Mat 5840 is a white pad with a multiple layer sticky mat with individually tabbed layers on a white portable frame.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Clean-Walk Replacement Pad 5842
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Clean Walk Replacement Pad 5842 is a white multiple layer sticky mat with individually tabbed layers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Clean-Walk Mat 5830 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Clean Walk Mat 5830 Series is a multiple layer sticky mat with individually tabbed layers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Safety-Walk™ Coarse Tapes and Treads 700 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Heavy duty industrial application slip-resistant tape.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Safety-Walk™ Slip-Resistant Conformable Tapes and Treads 500 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Ideal for use on diamond grade safety plates, steps and other irregular surfaces. Mineral coated, slip resistant with aluminum foil backing. Conforms to irregular surfaces and around edges.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Safety-Walk™ Slip-Resistant Fine Resilient Tapes and Treads 200 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: High friction, fine resilient textured, slip resistant material. Reverse side coated with pressure sensitive adhesive protected by a removable liner. For wet, barefoot traffic areas.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Safety-Walk™ Slip-Resistant General Purpose Tapes and Treads 600 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This mineral coated, slip resistant material features a highly durable surface. Low profile design helps reduce trip hazards.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotchgard™ Paint Protection Film Pro Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotchgard Paint Protection Film Pro Series delivers superior protection to automotive surfaces against scratches, chips and weathering. Our Pro Series film features a self-healing formula that enables minor scratches to disappear by themselves. 3M clear coat technology provides exceptional stain, weather and abrasion resistance, helping to preserve the car's showroom quality finish for years.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Gravity HVLP Atomizing Head Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Gravity HVLP Atomizing Heads are designed to deliver premium spray performance for coatings including paints, clear coats and topcoats. Replaceable nozzles are built exclusively for gravity feed applications with the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun System and 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System, offering like-new spray performance with the change of each nozzle.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Safety-Walk™ Slip-Resistant Medium Resilient Tapes and Treads 300 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: A resilient, non mineral, slip resistant material. Soft surface is suitable for bare feet.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Gravity HVLP Atomizing Head Variety Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Gravity HVLP Atomizing Heads Variety Refill Kit includes nozzles in six sizes ranging from 1.2 to 2.0. Replaceable nozzles are built exclusively for gravity feed applications with the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun System and 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System. Designed to deliver premium spray performance for coatings, including paints, clear coats and topcoats.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Industrial Spray Gun System
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Lightweight and easy to use, the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun was built for the industrial painter. Made from impact-resistant composite, it is one of the lightest spray guns in the industry, yet durable enough for demanding conditions. Its versatile design allows spraying from a pressurized source or a gravity cup. Replaceable nozzles from 1.1 to 2.0 allow you to spray a wide range of coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Pressure HVLP Atomizing Head Variety Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Pressure HVLP Atomizing Heads are designed to deliver premium spray performance for coatings including, including stains, primers, base coats, topcoats, clear coats and adhesives. Replaceable nozzles are built exclusively for pressure-feed applications using the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun, offering like-new spray performance with the change of each nozzle.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Pressure HVLP Atomizing Head Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Pressure HVLP Atomizing Heads are designed to deliver excellent spray performance for coatings including stains, primers, base coats, topcoats, clear coats and adhesives. Replaceable nozzles are built exclusively for pressure-feed applications using the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun, offering like-new spray performance with the change of each nozzle.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Ball Valve
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Ball Valve is an accessory for the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun System configured as a pressure feed sprayer. The valve gives the spray gun operator the ability to stop the flow of paint from the pressure source (pot or pump) at the spray gun end of the supply hose. Recommended for use when the painter does not have easy access to the pressure source. Light and easy to use.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun System with PPS™ 2.0
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun is engineered for performance. The versatile selection of replaceable nozzles offer like-new spray performance every time. The lightweight, impact resistant gun body features a newly designed locking collar that allows for quick nozzle changes for an easy switch between paints or coatings and cleanup. Nozzles connect directly to 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Lightweight and easy to use, the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun was built for the modern painter. Capable of spraying a wide range of coatings from either a pressure-fed source or attached gravity cup, its impact-resistant composite body makes it one of the lightest spray guns available, yet it is durable enough for demanding industrial and automotive conditions.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Locking Collar
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The unique 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Locking Collar helps ensure a solid connection between the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun and 3M™ Performance Atomizing Heads. The locking collar is easy to use, allowing for quick nozzle changes while switching between paints and coatings or for cleanup at the end of a job. The easy-grip tabs make it easier to turn the locking collar.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Whip Pin
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Whip Pin is a replacement attachment pin for the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Pressure Whip Hose. The clevis pins are used to secure the whip hose to the body of the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun. The connection helps give the painter additional control and helps prevent the atomizing head from twisting and unwanted stress.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Pressure Whip
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Pressure Whip Hose connects to the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun for use in pressure feed applications. Provides a fast connection between the atomizing head and the pressurized paint supply hose. Securely fastens to the spray gun base for better balance and hose control. Can be used with optional ball valve to control paint from the pressure line.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Needle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Needle is designed specifically for 3M™ Performance Spray Gun. The stainless steel construction is engineered for a leakproof seal when the trigger is released and precise flow control when the trigger is pulled. Use this replacement needle when the existing spray gun needle is damaged, bent, the gun leaks through its nozzle, or as routine preventative maintenance.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Rebuild Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Rebuilt Kit provides the replacement parts needed for rebuilding the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun. Includes exterior replacement parts as well as all required interior seals, springs, screws and parts. Instruction manual provides specific details on how to rebuild.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Clean Sanding Disc Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit Clean Sanding Pad backs up abrasive sheets for use on 3M™ Orbital Sanders, both central-vacuum-ready and self-generating-vacuum models. This foam-construction Clean Sanding Pad features a 3M™ patented, multi-hole pattern designed to evacuate dust and increase abrasive life for better performance and longer abrasive life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Quick Grip Filler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Quick Grip Filler is an extra fast, easily sandable body filler that adheres rapidly to most substrates including galvanized steel, aluminum, E-coat and many more. This creamy, easy-to-spread filler is vacuum processed to reduce pinholes and sands to a fine featheredge without loading abrasives. It cures in 15 minutes at 75°F, and sands to a stain-resistant, tack-free finish.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 6-Pack Starter Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 6-Pack Starter Kit is a simple, convenient way to get started with the PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System. Kits are available in Midi (13.5 oz, 400 mL) and Standard (22 oz, 650 mL) sizes, excellent for most mid-range repairs. Kit contains 6 liners, 6 lids with ¼-turn locking system and built-in full diameter 200 micron filters, a reusable hard cup and 16 sealing plugs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8511
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8511, N95 is a disposable particulate respirator that is designed to help provide reliable respiratory protection of at least 95 percent filtration efficiency against certain non oil based particles. The respirator is designed for use for particles such as those from grinding, sanding, sweeping, sawing, bagging, or other dusty operations. This respirator can also help reduce inhalation exposures to certain airborne biological particles (examples: mold, Bacillus anthracis, Mycobacterium tuberculosis), but cannot eliminate the risk of contracting infection, illness, or disease. Soft inner material provides added comfort while the cup shape design makes the respirator spacious and durable. Braided headbands and an adjustable M noseclip helps provide a custom and secure seal. The respirator incorporates 3M's proprietary technology with advanced electrostatically charged microfiber filter media designed for ease of breathing. This respirator is compatible with a variety of protective eyewear and hearing protection. Fitted with a 3M Cool Flow™ Exhalation Valve, this respirator is ideally suited for work situations involving heat, humidity, or long periods of wear. The proprietary 3M Cool Flow valve is designed to release hot, humid exhaled breath quickly, helping to prevent an unpleasant build up of heat inside the facepiece a significant cause of discomfort to respirator wearers. The Cool Flow valve's efficiency in keeping breathing cool and comfortable has been demonstrated through testing*: the atmosphere inside a respirator with a Cool Flow valve is on average 7.5°F cooler than the similar product without the valve. This makes Cool Flow valve respirators ideal for long periods of wear, especially where conditions are hot, humid or physically demanding. *Testing conducted in a 3M laboratory. Testing protocol, data generation and conclusions were reviewed and approved by an expert from The University of Minnesota

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-Rsoft™ Yellow Neons™ Blasts™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ E-A-Rsoft™ Yellow Neon Blasts™ Earplugs feature a natural cylindrical shape and smooth texture for a comfortable fit. Featuring a 32 NRR for work in noisy areas. Bright yellow color is designed to help make them easier to spot for compliance verification.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Elite Orbital Sanders
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Elite Orbital Sanders deliver professional performance for flat finishing and sealer sanding operations, hour after hour in high-production industrial environments. Options are available in non-vacuum, central vacuum, and self-generated vacuum models.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ GoggleGear™ Safety Goggles 6000 Series

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Sticky Steps® Mat with Frame

coveo:metadata.title: Dynatron™ Dyna-Glass Short Strand
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dynatron™ Dyna-Glass Short Strand reinforced body filler creates waterproof repairs that are twice the strength of ordinary body fillers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Short Strand Fiberglass Reinforced Filler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Short Strand Reinforced Filler is reinforced with short strand fiberglass to create water resistant repairs that are twice the strength of ordinary body fillers. It is a great solution for repairing holes and rust on metal and fiberglass.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Disc Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Hookit™ Disc Pad securely holds a 3M™ Hookit sanding or finishing disc or 3M™ Finesse-it™ buffing pad for use with a hand-held sanding tool such as a rotary, orbital, or random orbital sander. The 45 degree tapered edge provides flexibility and allows the sanded area to be feather-edged or more easily blended.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fastbond™ Contact Adhesive 2000NF
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Fastbond Contact Adhesive 2000NF is a water dispersed, high solid, activated adhesive that gives you immediate handling strength without drying for most applications. Our low odor adhesive effectively bonds most flexible and rigid foams, plastic, laminate, wood, plywood and more to meet a wide range of requirements.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fastbond™ Contact Adhesive 30NF
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Fastbond Contact Adhesive 30NF is a low-odor, water-based, adhesive designed to have high strength, high coverage, long bonding range and good heat resistance. This classic adhesive has proven to bond combinations of most foamed plastics, plastic laminate, wood, plywood, wood veneer and canvas.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Type H/O Pressure Cup
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Type H/O Pressure Cup is a pressurized (H/O) hard cup and collar set that supports and holds 3M™ PPS™ flexible liner used in the 3M™ PPS™ (Legacy) paint preparation system. This product is intended for use in place of metal cups on most pressure spray guns. Available sizes include Mini - 6 oz. and Large - 28 oz. cups.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fastbond™ Foam Adhesive 100NF
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Fastbond Foam Adhesive 100NF was designed to be an extremely versatile, heat-resistant adhesive that bonds a wide range of lightweight materials. Its postforming, permanent bond provides fast results. The spray formula has a pebble spray pattern, is fire-resistant in its wet state, is easy to dispense and, when not being sprayed, can be applied directly by using a brush or roller.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fastbond™ Insulation Adhesive 49
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Fastbond Insulation Adhesive 49 is a fast-drying adhesive that bonds a range fabrics and insulation materials to a range of substrates. Our permanent bond provides fast results to keep projects moving ahead. This adhesive's formula is easy to dispense and apply directly onto surfaces and materials where needed, with no soak-in or yellowing over time.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fastbond™ Pressure Sensitive Adhesive 4224NF
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Fastbond Pressure Sensitive Adhesive 422NF is a low-odor, water-based, adhesive designed to have a permanently sticky, reliable bond with high coverage and a long bonding range. This classic adhesive allows for quick installation of a wide range of commonplace flooring, including vinyl flooring and various flooring tiles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hi-Strength 94 ET Spray Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hi-Strength 94 ET Spray Adhesive creates an aggressive post formable bond for attaching decorative laminate, metal and some rubber substrates. This high strength adhesive is typically used in woodworking and specialty vehicle applications, especially where VOCs are a concern. The adhesive can be sprayed, rolled or brushed onto surfaces to reduce overspray and adhesive waste.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Foam Fast 74 Spray Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Foam Fast 74 Spray Adhesive is a fast-drying spray adhesive that bonds foam and fabric to a wide range of substrates. Its permanent bond provides fast results to keep projects moving ahead. The non-yellowing formula dispenses easily in a lace-spray pattern and applies directly onto surfaces and materials where needed.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Foam Fast 74 CA Spray Adhesive - Low VOC <25%
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Foam Fast 74 CA Spray Adhesive - Low VOC <25% is a fast-drying spray adhesive that bonds foam and fabric to a wide range of substrates. The permanent bond provides fast results to keep projects moving ahead, with a non-yellowing formula that dispenses easily in a lace-spray pattern and applies directly onto surfaces and materials where needed.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hi-Strength Laminating Adhesive 92
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hi-Strength Laminating Adhesive 92 is a high-tack, industrial-grade spray adhesive that offers a strong hold. This high-performance laminating adhesive is resistant to high temperatures, providing durability and resilience for applications involving large surfaces. Formulated as a fast-tack adhesive, our 3M Hi-Strength Laminating Adhesive 92 delivers fast results for immediate handling.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hi-Strength Postforming 94 CA Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hi-Strength Postforming Adhesive 94 CA is a strong adhesive that bonds a range of large surfaces and is perfect for large-scale laminations. This adhesive's formula is easy to dispense and apply directly onto surfaces, with no soak-in or yellowing over time.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ HoldFast 70 Spray Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M HoldFast 70 Cylinder Spray Adhesive is our extremely versatile, fast-tacking industrial grade spray adhesive with a unique wide-web spray pattern well suited for bonding a variety of construction materials. It requires a short dry time yet provides long open time to perfectly position your materials. It is an effective adhesive for waterproofing and protecting from moisture.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hot Melt Adhesive 3731
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hot Melt Adhesive 3731 is a 100% solids, high heat resistant thermoplastic adhesive that liquefies to bonds to a variety of substrates, including polyethylene, polypropylene and other plastics.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hot Melt Adhesive 3747
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hot Melt Adhesive 3747 provides a tough, reliable bond for a wide variety of applications. Formulated to have moderate heat resistance, our Hot Melt Adhesive 3747 offers you a bond that can withstand elevated temperatures without lifting or deformation, delivering long-term durability and exceptional performance.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hot Melt Adhesive 3762
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hot Melt Adhesive 3762 is a 100% solids, fast-setting hot melt adhesive designed for packaging and shipping applications. It is ideal for bonding corrugated fiberboard cartons, wood, particle board, chipboard and foam.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hot Melt Adhesive 3789
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hot Melt Adhesive 3789 produces high strength, fuel- and oil-resistant bond on high performance metals, plastics, vinyl, wood and other surfaces. This hot melt offers a longer open time, extreme heat resistance and is available in a variety of sizes to meet your specific production needs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hot Melt Adhesive 3792
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hot Melt Adhesive 3792 is a clear, multipurpose adhesive for effectively bonding wood, lightweight metals and some plastics in furniture, upholstery and woodworking applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Neoprene High Performance Contact Adhesive 1357
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Neoprene High Performance Contact Adhesive 1357 is a versatile, solvent based adhesive. It offers high immediate handling strength and good heat resistance, and is commonly used for bonding most metals and plastics. It is also suitable for large surface panel or composite lamination.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Neoprene High Performance Rubber and Gasket Adhesive 1300
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Neoprene High Performance Rubber and Gasket Adhesive 1300 is a versatile, solvent based adhesive. It offers high immediate strength and good heat resistance, and is commonly used for bonding most rubber and gasket materials. It is also suitable for large area rubber sheeting applications, bumpers and more.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Nitrile High Performance Plastic Adhesive 1099
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Nitrile High Performance Plastic Adhesive 1099 dries quickly with an open time of approximately 40 minutes. Its assembled bonds are proven to be strong while resisting weathering as well as damage from water, oil and fuel. Additionally, it bonds well to plastics and vinyl, providing long-term adhesion as well as good resistance to plasticizer migration.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Polystyrene Insulation 78 ET Cylinder Spray Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Polystyrene Insulation 78 ET Cylinder Spray Adhesive is our high strength, industrial grade spray adhesive with an extended bond time of up to one hour. It is effective for bonding most types of insulation such as fiberglass and expanded polystyrene foam (EPS) onto numerous kinds of materials including plastics, metals, wood, paper substrates and more.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Nitrile High Performance Rubber and Gasket Adhesive 847

It offers both good oil resistance and good heat resistance, and is commonly used for bonding most rubber and gasket materials.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ General Trim Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M General Trim Adhesive bonds automotive materials such as carpeting, vinyl, fabrics, and plastics to metal and other hard, impervious surfaces. Our high-strength adhesive offers good heat and water resistance.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Polystyrene Insulation Adhesive 78

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Weld™ Structural Plastic Adhesive DP8010NS
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Scotch-Weld Structural Plastic Adhesive DP8010NS is a non-sag, two-part acrylic adhesive specially formulated to bond many low surface energy plastics, including many grades of polypropylene, polyethylene, and thermoplastic elastomers (TPEs) without special surface preparation.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Super 77™ Multipurpose Spray Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We invented 3M Super 77 Multipurpose Spray Adhesive to be an extremely versatile, fast-drying spray adhesive that bonds a wide range of lightweight materials. Our permanent bond provides fast results to keep projects moving ahead. The photo-safe spray formula is easy to dispense and apply directly onto surfaces and materials where needed, with no soak-in or yellowing over time.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork® Industrial Low-Lint Cleaning Cloth
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tork® Industrial Low-Lint Cleaning Cloth is excellent for industrial cleaning applications that are particle sensitive. This cloth can be used in the Tork® Folded Wiper/Cloth Dispenser that protects the refills from dirt and offers an one-at-a time dispensing to reduce consumption and waste. Best if used for working with sensitive applications like surface preparation before painting due to low-lint properties.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork Wall Dispenser
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Tork® Wall stand in Performance Design is developed for efficiency and reliability with its easy load features and the possibility to take either paper needed with only one hand. Tork Performance is the next generation of dispensers for professional wiping.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork® Heavy Duty Paper Wipers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tork® heavy-duty paper wipers are a great shop towel. Their durability and high-performance characteristics make them a perfect choice for a wide variety of uses, from professional shops and garages to cleaning tools in do-it-yourselfer workshops and garages.

coveo:metadata.title: New PIG Floor Sweep
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Drop a few handfuls to control loose dirt and dust during sweeping.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Blue Abrasive Disc Roll 321U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Stikit™ Blue Abrasive Disc Rolls delivers best-in-class performance at every stage of paint preparation and body repair. Premium aluminum oxide mineral is blended with ceramic grain for a full range of automotive sanding applications. An anti-loading coating reduces loading from dust and extends disc life. Stikit™ adhesive attachment makes changing discs quick and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Hand Pad 7448 PRO
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We developed Scotch-Brite 7448 PRO Hand Pad to combine durability for long life, flexibility for reaching tight areas, and to be used in place of steel wool for conditioning metal surfaces and paint prep in less time than conventional non-woven abrasive products. The tightly graded abrasive particles in our new pad provide a consistent, uniform scratch throughout life of the hand pad.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Hand Pad 7447 PRO
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite 7447 PRO Hand Pad combines flexibility with effective cutting action and precise hand control to help you accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results, use after use. The tightly graded abrasive particles in this new pad provide a consistent, uniform scratch throughout life of the hand pad.

coveo:metadata.title: DuPont™ Tyvek® Protective Coverall with Hood and Boots
coveo:metadata.sw_description: DuPont™ Tyvek® Coveralls with Hood & Boots block liquids and airborne particles, yet are breathable for all day comfort. The low-static material is durable and protects even when abraded. Keep debris off your final product. The low-linting fabric is ideal for paint applications. Don't bring the mess home - keep dust, spray and splashes off your clothing and skin with Trimaco DuPont Tyvek coveralls.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch® High Performance Masking Tape
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Proven to Deliver Super-Sharp Paint Lines

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Half Facepiece Reusable Respirator 6000 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ 6000 Series reusable respirators are made from lightweight materials, and the adjustable features help provide a secure fit. The ergonomic placement of 3M™ filters and cartridges helps improve balance and visibility. The 6000 series is compatible with a wide variety of NIOSH-approved 3M respirator cartridges and filters to help protect your workforce from certain particulates, gases and vapors. When used with 3M™ respirator filters and cartridges, this respirator may help provide respiratory protection at concentrations up to ten times the OSHA Permissible Exposure Limit (PEL).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Filter 2091
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Particulate Filters 2000 Series are made with electrostatic media to enhance the capture of airborne particles and reduce breathing resistance. These particulate filters are flame resistant and easy to install. Plus, 3M™ Particulate Filters 2000 Series are compatible with 3M™ 6000 Series Half Facepieces, 6500/6500QL Series, 7500 Series, 6000 Series Full Facepieces, FF-400 Series, 7800 Series and 3M™ Scott™ AV-3000 HT and AV-3000 SureSeal Facepieces with AV-632 Bayonet Adapter, thus helping to reduce inventory needs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hi-Strength 90 Spray Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Hi-Strength 90 Spray Adhesive is an extremely versatile, fast-drying spray adhesive that bonds strongly to a wide range of materials. Our permanent bond provides fast results to keep projects moving ahead. The spray formula is easy to dispense, offering a variable-width spray pattern, and applies directly onto surfaces and materials where needed.

coveo:metadata.title: Datacolor ColorReader Pro
coveo:metadata.sw_description: An ultra-portable, Bluetooth® connected color selection device, ColorReaderPRO provides industry-leading color matching performance.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ GoggleGear™ 500 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ GoggleGear™ 500 Series features a low-profile design with an adjustable strap, indirect ventilation and 3M™ Scotchgard™ Protector Anti-Fog/Anti-Scratch Coating.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Full Facepiece Reusable Respirator 6900 Large
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Lightweight well-balanced design and silicone faceseal for enhanced comfort, durability and ease of cleaning.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M Full Face Reusable Respirator 6000 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Paint Project Full Face Reusable Respirator helps provide respiratory protection against certain paint sprays, solvents, and vapors with the convenience of an all-in-one kit. It is designed for professionals. The balanced, four-strap design provides lasting comfort and full face and eye protection. The swept-back design of the 3M™ Organic Vapor Cartridges allows a wide view field. When handling potentially harmful chemicals, protect yourself with 3M™ Paint Project Full Face Reusable Respirator.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ UltraFit™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ E-A-R™ UltraFit™ Earplugs are made with a triple-flange design to help contour to the different shapes and sizes of ear canals. This helps create a noise-blocking seal. Workers can insert the triple flanged ear tips easily into their ears by holding the stem and pushing the ear tips into the ears. Pliable material can be washed and reused, cutting down costs and extending the hearing protector's life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-R™ Classic™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ E-A-R™ Classic™ Earplugs have set the industry standard for noise reduction as the world's first foam earplugs. These earplugs are made of a proprietary soft energy-absorbing slow-recovery foam that's designed to conform to the shape of the ear canal to help provide hearing protection.

coveo:metadata.title: Impact of Process
