coveo:metadata.title: Sherwin-Williams Automotive Finishes SEMA 2019 Recap
coveo:metadata.sw_description: SEMA 2019 was a huge success for Sherwin-Williams Automotive Finishes. We unveiled a wicked '51 Mercury built by Jesse James of West Coast Choppers that is finished in our Ultra 9K Waterborne Basecoat, a '61 Cadillac with a mind-blowing Matrix Edge paint job by Count's Kustoms, hosted a number of celebrity appearances and signings including Martin Bros. Customs and Nichols Paint & Fab.

coveo:metadata.title: Custom Chopper Painted by Travis "Tuki" Hess at SEMA 2019
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Travis "Tuki" Hess painted this custom chopper with House Of Kolor kandies and a silver base. He finished it off with Sherwin-Williams Automotive Finishes CC 950. You can see this baby up close and personal at SEMA 2019 North Hall, Booth No. 10839.

coveo:metadata.title: Jesse James of West Coast Choppers Uses Ultra 9K
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Jesse James from West Coast Choppers finished his wicked '51 Mercury in our best basecoat ever -- Ultra 9K™. Find out what he loves most about this waterborne system.

coveo:metadata.title: Joe Martin Shares his Panel for SEMA 2019
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Joe Martin of Martin Bros Customs discusses his thought and process behind his panel. It's one of 35 that were auctioned off during SEMA 2019 to benefit the newly established Blazing Trails Scholarship Fund.

coveo:metadata.title: Tony Goodrich Shares his Build at SEMA 2018
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tony Goodrich, owner of Tony's Rod and Custom shares his 1968 Chevy Camaro at SEMA 2018.

coveo:metadata.title: Dave Eckert Shares his 1949 Hudson at SEMA 2018
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dave Eckert of Eckert's Rod & Custom talks about how he brought a 1949 Hudson into 2018 utilizing our new Ultra 9K Waterborne Basecoat System and CC200 clearcoat.

coveo:metadata.title: New Waterbased System - Ultra 9K
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Ultra 9K Waterbased System is our best basecoat ever. The system delivers on everything from hiding, cycle times and finish to color with tools including a spectrophotometer, global color box and online software.

coveo:metadata.title: Joe Martin and Javier 'Shorty' Ponce at SEMA 2018
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Joe Martin and Javier 'Shorty' Ponce discuss the benefits of fan decks at SEMA 2018.

coveo:metadata.title: Tour One of Our Training Centers in Grand Prairie, TX
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Sherwin-Williams Training Center located in Grand Prairie, TX has been a host to painters from all segments of the industry—painters looking to improve their craft. Collision-repair specialists, color-match experts, custom painters, and airbrush artists have all benefited from Sherwin-Williams training, regardless of the VOC restrictions in their home towns.

coveo:metadata.title: NEW! Ultra BC8™ Solvent System
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Outcome-driven and supported by world-class global tools and services. Ultra BC8™ is designed for nothing but color precision.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra 9K™ - Mazda 46V Soul Red Crystal 3-Stage Application Walkthrough
coveo:metadata.sw_description: In this video, we will walk you through the application process for Mazda Red Soul Crystal 46V formula using our Ultra 9K™ waterborne basecoat system.

coveo:metadata.title: LJI Ultra 9K™ Testimonial
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The family-run LJI Collision Center in suburban Cleveland made the switch to Ultra 9K™ and all of the benefits they’ve seen at their two locations. Designed to drive productivity and efficiency in the shop, Ultra 9K comes with an all-new color retrieval experience (Color Access), a spectrophotometer and global color box-making even the most difficult color match easy.

coveo:metadata.title: Monroeville Dodge Ultra BC8™ Testimonial
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The team at Monroeville Dodge Ram in Monroeville, Pennsylvania talks about the benefits of Ultra BC8™ and why they made the switch. Ultra BC8 is all about color--supported by our world-class global color tools and support including color retrieval software, a spectrophotometer, color box, and information maps (books). Paired with Sherwin-Williams' trusted primer surfacers and high-production and show-quality clears, Ultra BC8 is nothing less than driven.

coveo:metadata.title: Blazing Trails Scholarship Winners Announcement
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Blazing Trails in partnership with Sherwin-Williams® and Anest Iwata is proud to announce some of our Blazing Trails scholarship recipients! These Trail Blazers are getting set up to go into the automotive refinishes industry with not just the financial backing but the right equipment to get the job done!!

coveo:metadata.title: Sunfire PRO™ Refinish System Application - Metal Part Repair
coveo:metadata.sw_description: In this video, we show you the correct steps when using our Sunfire PRO™ Refinish System for a metal part repair.

coveo:metadata.title: Video Gallery for Sherwin-Williams Automotive Finishes
coveo:metadata.sw_description: View Sherwin-Williams Automotive Finishes Video Gallery.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra 9K® 3-Stage White Pearl
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Watch for step by step instructions to apply a three-stage white pearl using the Ultra 9K™ waterborne basecoat system.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra BC8™ Blend Area Refinishing
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Follow along as our technical team guides you through blend area refinishing using our Ultra BC8™ refinish system.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra 9K® Blend Area Refinishing
coveo:metadata.sw_description: In this application video, we cover the blend area refinishing technique, step by step, using Ultra 9K®, our premium waterborne basecoat system.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra BC8™ 3-Stage White Pearl Application
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Step by step, in this application video, we walk through the proper application of a tri-stage pearl using the Ultra BC8™ solventborne system.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra 7000® Blend Area Refinishing
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Learn the proper technique for blend area refinishing using the Ultra 7000® premium solventborne system. For more information, contact our training and technical team, and always refer to the Product Data Sheet(s).

coveo:metadata.title: Collision Core™ Production
coveo:metadata.sw_description: See how Woodcock Auto Body in Washingtonville, New York is using Collision Core Production body shop scheduling and production software to keep techs on task and give management time back to focus on the bigger picture.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra 9K® Behind the Scenes
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Watch to see behind the scenes footage from a recent photo shoot to capture our waterborne basecoat system, Ultra 9K™, in the shop.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra 7000® 3-Stage White Pearl
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Using our Ultra 7000™ premium solvent system, our training and technical teams shows you how to achieve a three-stage white pearl.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra BC8 Painter Testimonial
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Woodcock Auto Body chose our Ultra BC8™ premium solvent paint system for its superior eas of use and unmatched technical support.

coveo:metadata.title: Tour the Dallas Training Center
coveo:metadata.sw_description: At our training centers, our technical team provides comprehensive training covering everything from the refinishing process to color adjustment. We train and certify paint techs in the proper use and application of our refinish systems and products to deliver on the Sherwin-Williams® repair promise.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra System Undercoats and Clears
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Brian Bates, Lead Paint Tech for Woodcock Auto Body talks about his appreciation for our Ultra System™ Undercoats and Clears.

coveo:metadata.title: A Painter’s Perspective of Collision Core™ Production & Ultra BC8™
coveo:metadata.sw_description: “Learning the App couldn’t have been more simple,” says Brian Bates, Lead Paint Tech for Woodcock Auto Body, when discussing our new Collision Core™ Production application.

coveo:metadata.title: Paint Materials Reimbursemensts
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Listen in to Mike Anderson, from Collision Advice, as he breaks down how to best handle reimbursements on paint materials.

coveo:metadata.title: Faith Quality Auto Body Makes the Switch to Ultra 9K® Waterborne Refinish System
coveo:metadata.sw_description: After years of relying on Sherwin-Williams products for their refinishing needs, Faith Quality Auto Body didn't think twice about making the switch to our Ultra 9K® Waterborne Refinish System. Hear from the management team about Ultra 9K's impact on their business.

coveo:metadata.title: Paint & Materials Costs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams® Business Consultant Tom Hoerner shares his experience (and best practices) for paint and material costs.

coveo:metadata.title: Fred Beans Conversion Testimonial
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Hear from the team at Fred Beans about how impressed they were with the Sherwin-Williams conversion process of their multiple shop locations. From planning to setup to training, the Sherwin-Williams team got the Fred Beans sites up and running quickly.

coveo:metadata.title: Roccos Collision Center Conversion Testimonial
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams exceeded Rocco's Collision expectations when they completed eight shop conversions in a single day. Watch as the team from Rocco's talks about the smooth transition and no loss of production as they switched to Sherwin-Williams.

coveo:metadata.title: Coatings Add Value to Your Collision Shop
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The team at Rocco’s Collision shares their experiences on how Sherwin-Williams supported them during the busiest and highest gross year in the company’s history.

coveo:metadata.title: Why Sherwin - Fred Beans
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Hear how the team at Carstar Fred Beans chose Sherwin-Williams as a paint partner due to their unwavering commitment to providing best-in-class service and support.

coveo:metadata.title: Sherwin Coatings Add Efficiency and Speed
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The shop team at Fred Beans discusses their ability to get more cars quickly and efficiently through the shop with the Sherwin-Williams Ultra 9K® paint system.

coveo:metadata.title: Ultra 9K® Gets the Job Done Right the First Time
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The painters at Rocco's Collision value getting the job done right the first time. Hear how the efficiency of the Ultra 9K® paint system eliminates the need for re-works.

coveo:metadata.title: BodyShop Business Episode 2: Collision Core™ Overview
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Working smarter—not harder—is how today’s best shops stay ahead. In Episode 2 of Paint, Productivity & Profit, Global Marketing Manager for Collision Core Troy Stone talks with BodyShop Business Editor Jason Stahl about the advanced digital tools out there that are helping shops boost efficiency and performance. Watch to learn how the Collision Core™ Suite helps cut waste, optimize labor and materials and make real-time decisions.

coveo:metadata.title: See Collision Core™ at Work: Tools Overview & Customer Success
coveo:metadata.sw_description: See Collision Core™ at Work through an animated video designed to demonstrate how the suite of Collision Core tools work together as a cohesive system and emphasize both functionality and user experience. And hear firsthand how Collision Core is impacting body shops like Starnes Collision.

coveo:metadata.title: NEW! Conversion Testimonial (Heritage Collision)
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Check out the transformative impact of Sherwin-Williams’ partnership with a growing, family-run multi-shop operator.

coveo:metadata.title: Starnes Collision: A Seamless Sherwin‑Williams Conversion
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Starnes Collision Center (Charlotte, NC) converted to Sherwin‑Williams in a single, seamless day—freshly painted rooms, on‑site support and a team that kept production moving. Fast “hot‑shot” deliveries and Collision Core’s digital tools now help Starnes capture reimbursements and save hours. Watch how trust and responsiveness created a true partnership.

coveo:metadata.title: Why Us | Automotive Finishes
coveo:metadata.sw_description: At Sherwin-Williams Automotive Finishes, we deliver high-performance products and reliable support that helps our customers achieve more, go further and finish every job with confidence.

coveo:metadata.title: Sustainability
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We are committed to bringing products to market that minimize our footprint and yours—reducing waste and emissions.

coveo:metadata.title: Automotive Finish Stores
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We have more than 180 company-owned stores in the top 55 metropolitan markets to provide our customers—you—with the best, most responsive service, ongoing support and technical training.

coveo:metadata.title: Automotive Finishes History
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We have a rich history in refinishing, dating all the way back to the late 1800s when were among the first to bring coatings to markets specific to transportation.

coveo:metadata.title: Innovation
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We are redefining the industry with innovative, results-driven color systems, "powerhouse" primer surfacers/sealers and clears, and intelligent and intuitive business solutions.

coveo:metadata.title: Strategic Partnerships
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sherwin-Williams Automotive Finishes partners with industry leaders to advance innovation and sustainability, driving the future of automotive coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: Limited Lifetime Warranty Certified Refinish Facility
coveo:metadata.sw_description: We stand behind the performance of our coatings, and we stand behind our network of Certified Refinish Facilities.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Rubbing Compound
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Perfect-It Rubbing Compound combines strength and finesse, removing fine scratches and defects.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Automotive Masking Tape 2308
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Automotive Masking Tape, a natural colored crepe paper masking tape, is designed specifically for automotive collision repair applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ All Purpose Cleaner and Degreaser
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M All Purpose Cleaner and Degreaser quickly and easily cuts through dirt and grime to clean exterior and interior surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Quick Fix Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Quick Fix Adhesive bonds rubber, plastic and metal almost instantly. This cyanoacrylate adhesive is the perfect answer when you need a quick repair with secure holding power. This versatile glue excels at bonding rubber weatherstripping, vinyl, metal, glass, side moldings, emblems, trim pieces and most plastics.

coveo:metadata.title: Genesis® 2.1 VOC DTM Urethane High Solids Urethane Primer-Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Direct-to-metal urethane primer

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 401Q
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 401Q is designed for sanding applications that require a fine grit and a light touch, such as auto body wet sanding and paint finishing. It combines a durable, waterproof A-weight paper backing and 3M™'s fast-cutting silicon carbide mineral for consistent scratch patterns, making for easier buffing. And a range of grades up to 3000 grit allows for superior results.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 413Q
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 413Q is best suited for metal sanding and finishing.

coveo:metadata.title: HP Process™ Clearcoat HPC21
coveo:metadata.sw_description: A versatile clearcoat designed to achieve a range of speed applications and repairs--from single to multi-panel.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Rubbing Compound
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Rubbing Compound quickly removes sand scratches, oxidation, coarse swirl marks and water spots. This liquid compound leaves minimal swirl marks and is safe for clear coats, lacquer and enamel paint finishes. This car rubbing compound makes dull and tired looking auto body finishes look new and glossy once again.

coveo:metadata.title: Genesis® 2.1 VOC Epoxy Primer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: A 2.1 lbs/gal VOC gray epoxy primer with high-solids, direct to metal adhesion properties, and great overall performance.
coveo:metadata.sw_industry: Refinish; Transportation; General Finishing; Heavy Equipment

coveo:metadata.title: HPC15 - HP Process Clearcoat
coveo:metadata.sw_description: A production driven clear for same-day delivery jobs.

coveo:metadata.title: Genesis® G4 National Rule Premium Basecoat System
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Two-component urethane system

coveo:metadata.title: Genesis® M G2 Low VOC Polyurethane
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Two-component acrylic polyurethane topcoat
coveo:metadata.sw_industry: Fleet Refinishing; Exterior Building Products; Transportation; General Finishing; Heavy Equipment

coveo:metadata.title: Genesis® LV Single Stage System
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Two-component polyurethane

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Hand Pad 7447
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ General Purpose Hand Pad 7447 combines flexibility with effective cutting action and precise hand control to accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results, use after use. Very fine grade aluminum oxide abrasives cut fast and fine, leaving a smooth, finished surface. Suitable for use on a wide variety of materials and for many different tasks.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Durable Flex Belt
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Durable Flex Belt is engineered to perform tough detail work such as deburring, blending, and finishing, on a variety of metals.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II File Belts 786F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Cubitron II File Belts 786F is a 3M best-in-class abrasive belt, designed for use with the 3M File Belt Sander, for tasks like grinding out rivets and removing spot welds.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Abrasive File Belt
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Green Corps Sanding Abrasive File Belt removes spot weld and hem flanges as well as grinds in tight areas for fast and efficient removal of paint, corrosion and rust. Aluminum oxide abrasive delivers a fast cut and long life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Hookit™ Clean Sanding Abrasive Discs 737U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Hookit™ Clean Sanding Abrasive Discs 737U combines the highest 3M technology for automotive repair.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Roloc™ Fibre Discs 786C
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Roloc Fibre Discs 786C is built for grinding, weld blending, deburring, and other tough metal finishing jobs. 3M™ Precision Shaped Grain - a tough, hard, sharp ceramic abrasive - is resin-bonded to a stiff fiber backing. This disc lasts significantly longer than conventional ceramic grain discs, delivering a lower cost per grind with fewer disc changes.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Fibre Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Green Corps Fibre Disc is designed for grinding door skins, MIG welds and other applications on metal, plastic or fiberglass.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Finishing Film Abrasive Disc 260L
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Film Disc 260L is ideal for auto body applications including blending, scuffing, paint prep and removing paint defects.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Roloc™ Abrasive Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Roloc Green Corps Abrasive Disc is a coarse grinding disc for removing paint, rust and welds in collision repair.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Gold Abrasive Disc 216U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Gold Disc 216U is precision-coated for long life and exceptionally smooth finishing to auto body sanding projects.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Purple Finishing Film Abrasive Disc 260L
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Purple Finishing Film Abrasive Disc 260L features an updated coating that levels surface defects on clear coat and greatly reduces pigtails.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Brite™ Roloc Clean and Strip Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Ideally suited for rust, coating and weld discoloration removal, 3M™'s Scotch-Brite™ Roloc™ Clean and Strip Disc is a long-lasting abrasive that combines silicon carbide mineral with non-woven nylon fibers. This unique disc can aggressively clean without significantly altering the base material.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Red Abrasive Disc 316U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Red Abrasive Disc 316U is an economical disc that delivers reliable performance.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Abrasive Disc Roll 236U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Disc Roll 236U features a tear-off disc format in a single roll, making them exceptionally fast and easy to use. Aluminum oxide mineral abrasive delivers an aggressive cut. Anti-loading coating and available 7-hole pattern help clear dust from the disc surface for longer life. The Stikit™ adhesive attachment makes changing the discs quick and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Disc Roll 246U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Green Disc Roll contains durable, fast-cutting abrasive discs for aggressive collision repair jobs. Discs feature fast-cutting aluminum oxide abrasive built on D-weight paper backing.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Sanding Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Sanding Block is a professional grade tool that helps you achieve your best, fastest sanding work in auto body and other jobs. The pliable rubber block is designed to comfortably fit your hand and to keep sandpaper flat against automotive surfaces, helping ensure uniform sanding performance. Sanding blocks feature internal attachment pins to hold sandpaper firmly in place on the block.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Trizact™ Hookit™ Clear Coat Sanding Abrasive Disc 471LA
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Incorporates Trizact technology for uniform and consistent finish. Use damp to level minor dust nibs and for light sanding of mismatched orange peel on all automotive paints.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Softback Sanding Sponge
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Softback Sanding Sponge sands hard-to-reach areas on cars, trucks and vans such as around headlight openings, door handles, door jambs and other locations.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Soft Hand Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hookit Soft Hand Block helps level repair areas with greater ease.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Soft Hand Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Hookit Soft Hand Block attaches to corresponding Hookit abrasive sheets to give users a more nimble, precise way to tackle sanding jobs. This can be used by professionals or individuals looking to increase the speed and ease of jobs on flat surfaces or contours.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Paint Prep Scuff Hand Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Ultra Fine Hand Pad 7448 combines durability for long life, flexibility for reaching tight areas, and can be used in place of steel wool for conditioning metal surfaces and paint prep. Unlike fine steel wool, Scotch-Brite pads will not shred during use, rust after use, or leave fine metal splinters.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Clear Blend Prep Scuff
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ Clear Blend Prep Scuff was designed to help you prep color blend areas. It's the third pad in a three-part Scuffing System. When used together, our Scuffing System helps operators achieve optimum color prep adhesion.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Abrasive Hand Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Stikit™ Abrasive Hand Pad is a favorite among auto body technicians. Firm yet conformable and lightweight, this 2-3/4 x 6-inch pad makes corner and contour sanding easier. Use it with all grades of 6-inch 3M™ Stikit™ Discs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Soft Hand Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Soft Hand Block is ideal for paint prep including leveling and block sanding around contours. Its soft but tough foam construction makes it easy to grip and to maintain a good "feel" for the primed surface, helping ensure consistent abrasive contact. Stikit sheet rolls or abrasive sheets adhere firmly to the vinyl face with no slipping, yet release easily to save time.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Hand Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Designed for 3M Stikit Sheets and Rolls.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Wetordry™ Sponge Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Wetordry Sponge Pads are excellent for making hand sanding easier and more efficient in collision repair.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Hookit™ Clean Sanding Sheet Rolls 737U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Cubitron II Hookit Clean Sanding Sheet Rolls 737U combines the highest 3M technology for automotive repair.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Gold Abrasive Sheet 236U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Gold Sheet 236U is built for long life during auto body hand sanding projects requiring coarser grit abrasives. Open coat aluminum oxide abrasive and durable C-weight film backing provide a long-lasting cut and excellent loading resistance for rough featheredging or shaping plastic filler and putty. Our Hookit™ attachment system saves time and maximizes abrasive life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Hookit™ File Sheets 737U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Cubitron™ II Hookit™ File Sheets 737U combines the highest 3M technology for automotive repair. Its long-lasting triangular shaped grains make the sheet ideal for paint stripping, rough shaping of body filler and sanding plastic filler. The Hookit system makes for quick change-outs of abrasive sheets.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Gold Abrasive Sheet 216U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Gold Paper Sheet 216U are designed with an open coat aluminum oxide abrasive in sheets of various sizes, grits, and grades.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Red Abrasive Sheet Roll 316U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Stikit Red Abrasive Sheet Roll 316U delivers exceptional performance at a very high value in collision repair.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Abrasive Sheet Rolls 216U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Use 3M Stikit Gold Abrasive Sheet Roll, 236U, for shaping plastic filler, removing paint around damaged areas and scratch refinement of bare metal.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ No Cleanup Applicator Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M No Cleanup Applicator Gun is a high-performance applicator gun designed for use with 3M No Cleanup products (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Windo-Weld™ Round Ribbon Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Windo-Weld Round Ribbon Sealer is designed as one roll of sealer with setting blocks.

coveo:metadata.title: Highland Masking Tape 2727
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Highland Masking Tape 2727 is a high-density, tear-resistant automotive masking tape that provides excellent adhesion.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Nameplate Repair Tape
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Nameplate Repair Tape 06385 makes it easy to attach emblems and nameplates to vehicles with professional looking results.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Super Fast Repair Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Super Fast Repair Adhesive is a high performance, two-component, semi-rigid, urethane adhesive.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch Fine Line Striping Tape
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch Fine Line Striping Tape saves time and maintains fine lines for precision auto body paint striping.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Brushable Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Brushable Seam Sealer is ideal for recreating the appearance of OEM brush seals in collision repair.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ SMC/Fiberglass Repair Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M SMC/Fiberglass Repair Adhesives are two-part urethanes or two-part epoxies used to bond backup strips to SMC (sheet molded compound), FRP (traditional fiberglass) and primed metal.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ TPO Plastic Parts Repair
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M TPO Plastic Parts Repair is a two-part urethane for small-sized repairs and backside reinforcement of two-sided damage on plastic components made from thermoplastic polyolefins (TPO) and ethylene propylene plastics.

coveo:metadata.title: Innovative Truck Bed Dolly
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This versatile truck bed repair stand fits any size bed.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Universal Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Universal Adhesive is a two-part, urethane adhesive designed to bond metal, glass and plastic substrates to each other and themselves.

coveo:metadata.title: C Series Parts Cart
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
Save valuable floor space in your collision services shop with the Innovative Parts Cart-C Series.

This large storage cart features an open design that allows for easy loading and unloading of parts. This highly mobile cart reduces the amount of handling required for auto body parts, minimizing the risk of damage or misplacement. Now parts can be directly unloaded from the delivery truck and wheeled to your workstation. The cart's four support arms are perfect for holding bumpers and valences.

The Innovative Parts Cart pairs unprecedented mobility with stability - the industrial-grade caster wheels have a total-lock feature that prevents any movement when locked. This parts cart also has easily adjustable shelf brackets that can accommodate almost any sized car part. Made with a damage-resistant powder-coat finish.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dirt Trap Protection Material
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Dirt Trap Nonwoven overspray and its bright white color creates better visibility for technicians and a more pleasant shop appearance for collision repair customers. Low tack adhesive backing keeps it secure, smooth and wrinkle free.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ High-Performance Welding Drape
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M High-Performance Welding Drape is a unique fabric that provides protection from welding spatter and grinding sparks. This fire-resistant drape withstands extreme heat, sparks and spatter without burning through.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Welding and Spark Deflection Paper
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Welding and Spark Deflection Paper helps protect vertical surfaces from damage caused by welding spatter and grinding sparks. The flame-retardant paper comes with adhesive backing for easy application to vertical surfaces. The adhesive backing allows for easy repositioning of the spark deflection paper as needs change at a work site.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ No Cleanup Replacement Nozzle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M No Cleanup Replacement Nozzles are high-performance disposable siphon-feed tubes to be used with the 3M No Cleanup Applicator Gun and Coatings (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Solvent Spray Nozzle Trigger Head
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Solvent Spray Nozzle Trigger Head helps you apply solvent or water-based detailing chemicals with greater control and convenience.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Spray Trigger Nozzle Head
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Spray Trigger Nozzle Head is an easy-to-use nozzle head designed for use with 3M™ Detailing Spray Bottle (Part Number: 37716) and cleaning products.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Professional Caulking Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Professional Caulking Gun is a high-performance rod-driven applicator gun for dispensing single-component 3M caulks, sealants and adhesives in collision repair.

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE Plastic Spreaders
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Precise edge provides a smooth application

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch Performance Green Masking Tape 233+
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch Performance Green Masking Tape 233+ delivers consistently superior performance on moldings, plastic, glass, metal, rubber and paint.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Rigid Pillar Foam
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Rigid Pillar Foam is a two part urethane which foams in place to fill posts, pillars, and automotive body cavities with exceptional ease and consistent quality. This foam is easily to apply with a range of manual and pneumatic 3M applicators.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Vinyl Tape 471+
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Designed for fine line and critical paint masking, our 3M Vinyl Tape 471+ is a conformable tape with a semi-translucent backing.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Polyolefin Adhesion Promoter
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Polyolefin Adhesion Promoter is a specially formulated adhesion promoter for use when repairing low surface energy plastics such as thermopolyolefin (TPO).

coveo:metadata.title: Bulldog Adhesion Promoter
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Bulldog® Adhesion Promoter is designed to promote paint adhesion to all automotive surfaces, even problem plastics. It works equally well on all flexible or rigid plastics, fiberglass, aluminum, glass, chrome, vinyl, galvanized metal and painted surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Roloc™ Bristle Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite Roloc Bristle Disc provides more surface contact than wire brushes and retain abrasive properties throughout the life of the disc.

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE™ Commercial Grade PSA Abrasive Disc/Roll
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Available in multiple sizes and in grits from P40 to P800

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Weld Thru II Coating
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Weld-Thru II is a convenient aerosol coating designed to prevent corrosion between welded metal surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Roloc™ Surface Conditioning Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Scotch-Brite Roloc Surface Conditioning Disc combines durable, non-woven disc with the efficient 3M Roloc quick-change attachment system for an effective disc that cleans, finishes, blends, and deburrs.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite Durable Flex Hand Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ Durable Flex Hand Pad combines ultra flexibility with effective cutting action and precise hand control to accomplish tough cleaning jobs or produce fine finishing results.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Spray Trim Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Spray Trim Adhesive securely attaches lightweight trim materials such as upholstery cloth and trunk liners to a variety of surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ General Trim Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ General Trim Adhesive bonds automotive materials such as carpeting, vinyl, fabrics, and plastics to metal and other hard, impervious surfaces. This high-strength adhesive offers good heat and water resistance.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Super Trim Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Trim Adhesive securely bonds vinyl, heavyweight liners and hood silencer pads where high strength and heat resistance are needed.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Strip-Calk
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Strip-Calk is a soft butyl rubber caulking material that quickly and permanently fills all types of seams, joints and openings - long-lasting auto body maintenance and repair in much less time.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork® Basic Paper Wiper
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tork® Basic Paper Wiper is a multipurpose wiper designed for light wiping tasks. The Tork® Paper Wiper is a good choice when economy matters most.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork® Advanced Soft Centerfeed Hand Towel
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tork Advanced Soft Centerfeed Towels offer one-at-a-time service, and reduces waste.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork® Heavy-Duty Paper Wiper
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tork® Heavy-Duty Paper Wiper is Tork's toughest multipurpose paper wiper.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork® Industrial Paper Wiper
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tork® Industrial Paper Wipers are a multipurpose wipers that are ideal for janitorial, industrial, and hand wiping. This wiper can be used in either the Tork® Floor or Wall Stand dispensers, which are designed for safety, efficiency and reliability.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Overspray Protective Sheeting
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Overspray Protective Sheeting is a paintable, high density and tear-resistant translucent film for critical edge masking as well as for paint overspray.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Overspray Masking Liquid Dry
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Overspray Masking Liquid-Dry (OML-D) is a water-based sprayable liquid that protects against automotive paint and primer overspray without added time for bulk tape masking. It dries to a clear, non-tacky film that bonds lightly, protecting vehicle surfaces and trapping dust and dirt under the film. It s safe to use on all thoroughly cured painted surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perforated Trim Masking Tape
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Perforated Trim Masking Tape features a rigid band along one edge that slips gently behind moldings, lifting them slightly from the body.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Soft Edge Foam Masking Tape
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Soft Edge Foam Masking Tape protects door jambs, hoods or any area of a vehicle that needs to be sealed while being painted.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Smooth Transition Tape
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Smooth Transition Tape is a fast, simple way to virtually eliminate rework caused by hard paint lines.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™Automotive Refinish Masking Tape 388N
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Automotive Refinish Masking Tape 388N is a yellow crepe-paper tape designed specifically for the critical paint masking processes used in the collision repair industry.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dynamic Mixing System Nozzle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Dynamic Mixing System Nozzle is integral to fast, accurate mixing of two-part body repair products.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Panel Bonding Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Panel Bonding Adhesive is a cost-effective two-part epoxy adhesive for bonding replacement body panels. From its fast, convenient cartridge system the adhesive seals and bonds steel, aluminum, SMC, and FRP securely in a single operation.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Static Mixing Nozzle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Nozzles for 200 mL Cartridges efficiently mix a variety of 3M two-component products such as adhesives, sealers and foams.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-it™ Quick Connect Adaptor
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Perfect-It Quick Connect Adapter makes it easy to connect or disconnect double-sided buffing pads on rotary polishers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ One Step Cleaner Wax
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Removes most fine scratches, light oxidation, swirl marks, water spots, and minor stains.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hand Glaze
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Hand Glaze provides a deep finish that restores the OEM appearance of a vehicle.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scratch Remover
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Scratch Remover offers an ideal way to repair simple damage such as course-to-fine scratches, swirl marks, or paint imperfections with no hassle and no waiting.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Super Duty Rubbing Compound
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Super Duty Rubbing Compound is a top tier product that removes 1000 and finer sand scratches on all types of paint surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Machine Polish
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Machine Polish effectively removes compound swirl marks and minor surface defects to restore the beauty of automotive finishes.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Synthetic Wax Protectant
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Performance Finish Synthetic Wax bonds to the painted surface to form a layer of protection for your car's paint.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Quick Wax
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Quick Wax recaptures that "just waxed" look, either for touch ups between washes or streak-free drying after a wash.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Booth Coating
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Booth Coating is a water-based solution for protecting paint booth walls from paint overspray.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Flexible Package Applicator Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M's Flexible Package Applicator Gun is used to accurately dispense materials during the repair of interior and exterior seams and joints.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dent Finishing Glaze for DMS
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Dent Finishing Glaze is a 2-part polyester glaze with excellent flowability, ideal for filling minor imperfections in sheet metal and as a "skin coat" over body fillers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Heavy Drip-Chek™ Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Heavy Drip-Chek Sealer is a heavy-based sealer specifically designed for filling exterior auto body definition seams including roof drip rails on older vehicles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ All-Around Autobody Sealant
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M All-Around Autobody Sealant creates quick-drying seal on most interior and exterior automotive body joints and seams. Our medium-bodied, water-based seam sealer applies easily and adheres well to properly prepared primer and paint.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fast 'N Firm Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Fast 'N Firm Seam Sealer is a fast setting seam sealer designed for sealing exterior joints and seams.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Heavy-Bodied Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Heavy-Bodied Seam Sealer is a two-part epoxy seam sealer for all general purpose automotive sealing. It cures quickly to a tough, strong bead for lasting seam sealing protection and is used on door skins, floor pans, trunk floors, roof seams, and many other applications. The self-mixing system ensures a proper mix ratio every time - delivering a consistent cure rate and strength.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Clear Super Silicone Seal
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Clear Super Silicone Seal is a paste-like, one-component clear material that cures to a tough, rubbery solid when exposed to moisture in the air.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ MSP Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ MSP Seam Sealer is a high quality, heavy-bodied, general purpose, moisture-curing seam sealer for interior and exterior body joints. The sealer adheres well to properly prepared primer, paint, and bare metal surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Ultrapro Autobody Sealant
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Ultrapro Autobody Sealant is a heavy-bodied, solvent-based, seam sealer that adheres to painted metal, glass and aluminum.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Car Wash Soap
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Car Wash Soap safely removes dirt and grime without removing wax protection. Our soap quickly and easily cuts through residue to make vehicles look clean once again. But it won't harm the protective layer of wax that shield polishes, keeping car sparkling and shiny out on the road. A quick cleaning with our soap will restore pride of ownership.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Self-Leveling Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Self-Leveling Seam Sealer is a two-part epoxy designed for roof ditches (door skin hem flanges) and rear body panels, including tail light areas, wheel well flanges, etc. This seam sealer offers a work time of approximately 8 minutes and can be painted in 15 minutes. Quick curing properties enhance automotive body shop productivity.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ MSP Sprayable Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M MSP Sprayable Seam Sealer is a gray high-performance, general-purpose seam sealer that can be caulked or sprayed. Our convenient, easy-to-apply sealer adheres well to all primed surfaces, except acrylic lacquer.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dust Control Spray
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Dust Control Spray is a water-based formula that attracts and traps dust and dirt commonly found in paint booths and body shops.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Glass Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Glass Cleaner restores clarity and puts the sparkle back into automotive glass. Its special formula resists streaking on all glass surfaces, including windows, windshields, mirrors and side glass. It is also gentle and safe to use on plastic, chrome and metal. Aerosol can makes glass cleaner convenient to apply.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ High Power Brake Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M High Power Brake Cleaner now removes oil up to 2x - 8x faster, meaning technicians can use up to 50% - 90% less brake cleaner.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ General Purpose Adhesive Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M General Purpose Adhesive Cleaner removes adhesive residue with ease.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Interior Dressing
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Interior Dressing is a ready-to-use dressing that highlights the vinyl, leather, plastic and rubber surfaces inside your customers' vehicles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ EZ Sand Multi Purpose Repair Material
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M EZ Sand Multi Purpose Repair Material is a ready-to-use 2-part epoxy finishing adhesive material that dries to a flexible hardness, ideal for repairing plastic parts such as bumper covers and body panels.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Leather and Vinyl Restorer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Leather and Vinyl Restorer deep cleans dirt and grime from all vinyl, leather, rubber and plastic surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Press-In-Place Emblem Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Press-In-Place Emblem Adhesive offers a simple no-fuss, no-mess way to attach automotive emblems.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Feathering Disc Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Feathering Disc Adhesive is formulated to hold A-weight sandpaper discs firmly to disc back-up pads during featheredging, yet allow for easy removal without delamination.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Rigid Parts Repair
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Rigid Parts Repair is a two-part epoxy designed for use as a filler and an adhesive.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8211
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8211, N95 is a disposable particulate respirator that is designed to help provide reliable respiratory protection of at least 95 percent filtration efficiency against certain non-oil-based particles. The respirator is designed for use for particles such as those from grinding, sanding, sweeping, sawing, bagging, or other dusty operations. A foam face seal and soft inner material provide added comfort while the cup-shaped design makes the respirator spacious and durable. Braided headbands and an adjustable M Noseclip adjust easily for fewer pressure points and greater comfort. The respirator incorporates 3M™'s proprietary technology with advanced electrostatically charged microfiber filter media designed for ease of breathing. This respirator is compatible with a variety of protective eyewear and hearing protection.

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE™ 2K Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 2K Non-Sag White, Heavy Body Black, Self-Leveling Clear and Bare Metal (Brushable) Beige

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 07048
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
Designed for use in grinding, sanding, and buffing applications. Lightweight, two-strap filtering facepiece respirator with an adjustable nose clip and new braided head straps, this respirator helps provide excellent protection.

Workplace applications include grinding, sanding, and buffing. This respirator features 3M™'s Advanced Electret Media (AEM) and an adjustable nose clip to help provide a custom fit and secure seal. If respirator becomes damaged, soiled, or breathing becomes difficult, leave the contaminated area immediately and dispose of the respirator.

coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our Hookit Clean Sanding Disc Pad Kit features a durable foam Hookit disc back-up pad with 5/16-24 internal threads, and includes five adapters so the pad can be quickly and easily attached to different tools.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Roloc™+ Holder
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Roloc + Holder is a rugged, plastic holder that provides support for Roloc products including discs and combi wheels.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Clean Sanding Painter's Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Hookit Clean Sanding Painter's Back-up Pad is excellent for auto body painting jobs such as following contours and sanding close to edges, while maximizing dust extraction.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Clean Sanding Abrasive Disc Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Hookit Clean Sanding Abrasive Disc Pad combines some of our most advanced technologies to handle even aggressive auto body sanding jobs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Soft Interface Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our soft density foam 3M Hookit Soft Interface Pad adds cushion and conformability to our Hookit back-up pads for auto body sanding applications requiring precision across uneven surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Half Round Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Hookit Half Round Pad is built for hand sanding where round abrasive discs can't reach.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Back-Up Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Perfect-It Back-up Pad allows for easy attachment, quick removal and accurate centering of compounding or polishing pads.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Air File Shoe
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Stikit™ Air File Shoe provides support for 3M™ Stikit™ abrasive sheets and rolls. This accessory features a leading tuck-in front slot for easy insertion and quick removal applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Straightline Air File Shoe
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Hookit Straightline Air File Shoe features a 2-3/4" x 16" size, which fits any standard "Straightline" air file sander with two bolts.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit Abrasive Disc Back-up Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our 3M Stikit Abrasive Disc Back-up Pads perform across a large variety of auto body sanding jobs from low-speed polishing and grinding to shaping plastic filler.

coveo:metadata.title: Astro Finishing Palm Sander
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Astro Onyx 6" Finishing Palm Sander with 6" PU PSA Backing Pad

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Wetordry™ Rubber Squeegee
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Wetordry Rubber Squeegee is made from flexible, sturdy rubber, ideal for removing sludge created when sanding or for applying glazing putty and plastic filler to repair surfaces.

coveo:metadata.title: Innovative Wall Superstorage
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Innovative Wall Superstorage creates extra storage or work areas. High-carbon, heat-treated steel shelf brackets for years of trouble-free use.

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE™ Disposable Mixing Sheets
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Available in standard and premium paper

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE™ Buffing Apron
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3-pocket blue denim

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE® Contour Spreaders
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Available in 3 in. x 2 in. size

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ EX Ultrafine Machine Polish
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Perfect-It™ EX Ultrafine Machine Polish quickly and completely removes ultrafine swirl marks, even on difficult dark-colored vehicles. It stays wet longer, letting you use less material for a refined finish. Yet it also holds better on the pad for reduced sling and faster cleanup. You get polished surfaces without machine polish swirl marks - all at lower material costs and process times.

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE® GreenSHIELD Masking Paper
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Available in 6 in., 12 in., 18 in., and 36 in. widths

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE® Cream Hardener (BPO)
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Available in 2.75 oz. tube, blue

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Purple Clean Sanding Abrasive Disc 334U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Purple Clean Sanding Abrasive Disc 334U combines excellent dust removal and fast cutting, long lasting abrasive for higher productivity and lower cycle times. A spiral pattern clears dust from the surface and reduces loading for longer disc life - up to 3 times longer than traditional auto body abrasive discs. The 3M™ Hookit™ attachment system makes disc change-outs fast and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Trizact™ Hookit™ Foam Disc 443SA
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Trizact™ Hookit™ Foam Abrasive Disc removes fine sand scratches on painted surfaces to reduce the amount of time spent compounding. Three-dimensional mineral abrasive structures are distributed uniformly across the disc surface and wear evenly for consistent finishes, longer disc life and reduced material costs. Foam backed discs are part of the 3M™ Perfect-It™ Paint Finishing System.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Disc 251U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Disc 251U strips paint from metal as well as shapes and sands plastic filler. Green Corps™ abrasives are built on E weight backing to make them extremely durable for sanding paint, metal or fiberglass. Ceramic aluminum oxide mineral blend delivers a fast cut and long life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Urethane Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Urethane Seam Sealer is a high solids seam sealer ideal for sealing automotive and RV seams and joints. It adheres well to bare metal, primed metal and painted surfaces, and if desired can be smoothed to a featheredge and/or brushed. Tack free and paintable after 30-45 minutes, this urethane formula is permanently flexible and offers superior performance to solvent-based sealers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Abrasive Disc Roll 216U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Disc Roll 216U features aluminum oxide mineral abrasive for a sharp cut and uniform finish during collision repair. These tear-off discs are packed into a single roll and feature Stikit™ adhesive attachment, making them exceptionally fast and easy to use. Load-resistant coating and available 7-hole pattern help clear dust from the disc surface for longer life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Abrasive Sheet Roll 236U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Sheet Roll 236U features continuous lengths of C-weight paper, easily cut to size to greatly reduce product waste. Aluminum oxide mineral abrasive delivers an aggressive cut and uniform finish during collision repair. These sheet rolls feature Stikit™ adhesive backing, making them exceptionally fast and easy to attach and remove using power or hand sanding equipment.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Disc 246U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Disc 246U shapes plastic filler, removes paint around damaged areas and refines scratches on bare metal. Green Corps™ abrasives are built on D weight backing to make them extremely durable for sanding paint, metal, or fiberglass. Ceramic aluminum oxide mineral blend delivers a fast cut and long life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Trizact™ Hookit™ Blending Abrasive Disc 443SA
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Trizact™ Hookit™ Blending Abrasive Disc 443SA is a foam abrasive disc for scuff sanding blend panels, texture matching orange peel and removing fine grade sand scratches prior to paint blending on adjacent panels. Microreplicated 3-D mineral abrasive structures wear evenly for consistent application and longer disc life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Red Abrasive Disc 316U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Stikit™ Red Abrasive Disc 316U is an economical disc that delivers reliable performance. It features aluminum oxide mineral abrasive on A-weight or durable D-weight paper backing depending on grade. These discs are ideal for standard jobs such as filler shaping, featheredging, paint prep and finish. The 3M™ Stikit™ attachment makes disc change-outs fast and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Red Abrasive Sheet 316U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Hookit™ Red Abrasive Sheet 316U is an economical option for sanding and shaping a variety of substrates common to automotive repair jobs. This abrasive product is ideal for professional auto body mechanics and car owners.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Foam Compounding Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Perfect-It™ Foam Compounding Pads are 3M™'s highest-performing foam compounding pads for refining sand scratches, slow-speed polishing, denibbing and more. Foam face pattern provides more surface contact, holds compound better and reduces slinging. Doubled-sided pads work with 3M™ Quick Connect Adaptors on rotary polishers; double-side pads work with the Hookit™ system for easy change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Scotch-Brite™ Hand Pad 7448
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Scotch-Brite™ Ultra Fine Hand Pad 7448 combines durability for long life, flexibility for reaching tight areas, and can be used in place of steel wool for conditioning metal surfaces and paint prep. Unlike fine steel wool, Scotch-Brite pads will not shred during use, rust after use, or leave fine metal splinters.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Hookit™ Abrasive Disc 751U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Green Corps™ Hookit™ Abrasive Disc 751U are made with a ceramic and aluminum oxide blend that offers excellent cut rate and life. These discs are built on D and E weight paper backing and feature an open coat construction that reduces loading on fresh filler. Our 3M™ Hookit™ design allows for quick and convenient changes when discs become worn.

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE® Linear Plastic Sheeting
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Available in 12 ft. width

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Abrasive Disc Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Hookit™ Abrasive Disc Pad brings new levels of efficiency and performance to a broad range of auto body projects. Specific pads are tapered for sanding projects on flat surfaces or contours, low speed or high. Disc pads feature the Hookit™ attachment system for use with a range of Hookit™ abrasive discs, affording quick change-outs and longer life of disc pads and discs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Foam Compounding Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Foam Compounding Pad is a great, fast-cutting foam pad designed for refining and removing sanding scratches and swirls. The convolute foam face conforms to curves and body lines to reduce chatter for improved finishes. It also holds compound to help reduce slinging and the hook-and-loop attachment makes for fast, easy attachment to rotary polishers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Soft Edge Foam Masking Tape PLUS
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Soft Edge Foam Masking Tape PLUS makes jamb masking quick, easy and effective. Use this 21 mm width foam tape for jamb masking and other areas that need to be sealed during painting. This tape is the easy way to produce professional-looking paint transition lines.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Platinum Plus Glaze
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Platinum Plus Glaze is a two-part premium self leveling finishing glaze that can repair minor imperfections on properly prepared substrates such as galvanized steel, steel, aluminum, fiberglass, wood, SMC, E-coat, OEM topcoats, cured/sanded epoxy, and urethane primers. This finishing glaze cuts the sanding time to as little as 15 minutes.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 07185/8511
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Designed for use in grinding, sanding and buffing applications. Lightweight, two strap filtering facepiece respirators with exhalation valve for cool comfort and an adjustable nose clip, the 07185 helps provide excellent protection.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork Low-Lint Cleaning Cloth
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tork Low-Lint Cleaning Cloth is a soft yet durable wiper and is perfect for surface preparation and cleaning . This cloth can be used in the Tork Folded Wiper/Cloth Dispenser that protects the refills from dirt and offers an one-at-a time dispensing to reduce consumption and waste.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Blue Abrasive Sheet Rolls 321U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Blue Abrasive Sheet Rolls 321U delivers best-in-class performance at every stage of paint prep and body repair. Premium aluminum oxide mineral is blended with ceramic grain for a full range of automotive sanding jobs. A specially-designed multi-hole pattern captures dust, reduces loading and extends sheet life. Perforated Hookit™ sheets are easily sized to reduce product waste.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Blue Abrasive Discs 321U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Blue Abrasive Disc 321U delivers best-in-class performance at every stage of paint prep and body repair. Premium aluminum oxide mineral abrasive is blended with ceramic grain for a full range of automotive sanding applications. The multi-hole discs feature a specially-designed pattern that reduces loading, extends disc life and aligns with most backup pads. Hookit™ attachment makes disc changes easy.

W7B3000 can be applied over any Genesis® or AIC™ primer or single stage topcoat and is ideal for Agriculture and Construction Equipment (ACE), Ground Support Equipment, OE Truck Manufacturers, Trailers, and other Industrial markets where an anti-slip coating is required or desired.

For Industrial Shop Application Only.

coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System is the next generation, highest performing disposable spray cup system for mixing/measuring, filtering, spraying in any direction (360° spray rotation) and protecting coatings not in use. Each lid and liner kit contains 50 disposable lids with integrated collars and full diameter filters, 50 disposable liners, 1 reusable hard cup and 32 sealing plugs.
