coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE™ Disposable N95 Particulate Respirator with Exhalation Valve
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Designed to be used for sanding, grinding, and buffing applications

coveo:metadata.title: Klean-Strip Aircraft Non-Methylene Chloride Paint Remover
coveo:metadata.sw_description: This professional grade paint stripper is specifically designed to remove 2K automotive coatings including tough epoxies and urethanes. It effectively removes finishes from metal, aluminum and most plastic surfaces. This product strips to bare metal within 45 minutes and is effective on acrylics, lacquers, polyurethanes, baked enamels and epoxies.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Lids
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Lids are designed for the next generation 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System. A ¼-turn locking system replaces our traditional PPS collar, letting you attach the lid to the hard cup with a quick twist. A domed design allows up to 3 oz of fluid below the filter, reducing inconsistent spray and sputter. Full-diameter filters and a wider fluid spout improve flow and filtration.

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE™ Buffing Pad Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Includes three (3) buffing pads and one (1) backing pad

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Sanding Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Hookit™ Sanding Block helps make sanding easier in difficult locations. Use this accessory item with our Hookit abrasive products to achieve more consistent, uniform sanding results. This sanding block when used in combination with Hookit abrasives is ideal for sanding filler, primer and other substrates.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Plastic Sheeting
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Wide plastic sheeting engineered with static cling, 3M™ Plastic Sheeting enables one person to quickly and efficiently mask a vehicle. The clear, high density film provides effective paint protection and is tear-resistant yet easy to cut around the work area. Specially treated for high paint adhesion, the sheeting effectively captures paint overspray to prevent contaminating the repair.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ EX Machine Polish
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Perfect-It™ EX Machine Polish is the highest-performing machine polish 3M™ has ever introduced for removing compound swirl marks in collision repair. It stays wet longer, letting you use less polish for the same refined finish. Yet it also holds better on the pad for reduced sling and easier cleanup. You get smooth, polished surfaces without compound swirl marks - faster, and at less cost.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Acryl Putty
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Acryl Putty restores smooth surfaces by filling small pinholes, scratches, stone chips, and other minor blemishes in automotive and marine finishes. This acrylic putty offers easy sanding, smooth spreading, and low shrinkage.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Abrasive Disc 216U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Disc 216U is precision-coated for long life and exceptionally smooth auto body finishing. It features light A-weight paper backing with sharp, durable aluminum oxide abrasive - a fast, aggressive cut, yet a uniform finish, ideal for featheredging, primer sanding and scuffing. The disc roll features easy tear-off Stikit™ discs with adhesive backing for fast, easy change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Mix Ratio Inserts
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Mix Ratio Inserts help mix paint according to manufacturer guidelines for the 3M™ PPS™ (Legacy) paint preparation system. Mix ratio inserts are available for various cup sizes and manufacturers. 3M™ PPS™ is a complete painting system that allows the painter to measure, mix, filter and spray paint materials.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Auto Bedding and Glazing Compound
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Auto Bedding and Glazing Compound is a flexible sealer designed specifically for creating a watertight seal between windshield rubber gaskets and auto bodies. This synthetic rubber-based sealer remains permanently soft, making it suitable as a bedding and a supplementary adhesive sealer for auto glass. It also resists sagging for use in vertical and overhead auto seals.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Abrasive Fibre Discs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™'s Cubitron™ II Abrasive Fibre Discs is built for faster cutting of welds as well as grinding, weld blending, deburring and other tough metal finishing jobs. 3M™ Precision Shaped Grain - a tough, sharp ceramic abrasive - is resin-bonded to a stiff fiber backing. This disc lasts significantly longer than conventional ceramic grain discs, delivering a lower cost per grind with fewer disc changes.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Flexible Abrasive Hand Sheet 270J
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Flexible Abrasive Hand Sheet 270J features a very thin, extremely flexible film backing that conforms effortlessly to tools and contoured surfaces. A softer, closer "feel" helps you minimize burn-through for longer sheet life and to achieve more refined finishes. Hookit™ sheets can be quickly wrapped around accessory pads or attached to tools for total versatility.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Purple Clean Sanding Sheet Roll
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Purple Clean Sanding Abrasive Sheet Roll 334U combines excellent dust removal, easy snap-off sheet sizing and our fast cutting, long lasting abrasive for higher productivity and lower cycle times. A chevron hole pattern keeps particulates off of the sheet face, and our Kiss-cut Underscore Technology lets technicians easily convert the roll into multiple sheet configurations.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Manual Gun for 2 part cartridges
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Standard, Performance and Premium Manual Applicators provide fully portable application of 2-part adhesives for auto maintenance and repair jobs. Designed for use with 3M cartridges as small as 37.5 mL, these applicators dispense correctly mixed two-part bonding agents with no measuring - maximum efficiency on individual repair orders or where very little space or equipment is available.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Duramix Factory-Match Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Factory-Match Seam Sealer uses two part urethane technology to provide a tough flexible material for the sealing of joints on primed or painted substrates such as steel or aluminum enclosures. This material provides excellent flexibility and elongation properties along with a medium/high viscosity and produces a slight flow-out after application.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cavity Wax Plus
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Cavity Wax Plus is a non-hardening, self-healing corrosion protection coating for internal auto body panels and structural enclosures, as well as new replacement parts. It is designed to cover and seal internal joints, hem flanges and other areas where OEM e-coat may be compromised. It will not chip, peel or crack. Use the 3M™ Cavity Wax Plus Wand Kit for 360° coverage.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun for 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun for 3M™ PPS Series 2.0 combines the simplicity and easy maintenance of our Accuspray™ spray gun with the material-saving, rapid clean-up convenience of PPS™ Series 2.0, our next generation, highest performing disposable spray cup system. Replaceable atomizing heads afford the performance of a new gun, on demand and at a fraction of the cost.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ General Purpose Adhesive Remover
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ General Purpose Adhesive Remover is ideal for maintaining painted finishes during and after vehicle collision repair. A solvent-based formula dissolves adhesives without damaging painted surfaces. Available as an aerosol spray, this adhesive remover lets you remove adhesive residue without scraping tools or abrasives.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ EX AC Rubbing Compound
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Perfect-It™ EX AC Rubbing Compound is the best-performing 3M™ rubbing compound for removing P1200+ sand scratches and surface defects before polishing, even on the latest clear coats. It is formulated to perform in all conditions, including high heat and humidity, without sticking to panels or leaving film residue. It delivers a longer working time, yet still reduces sling for easier cleanup.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Red Finishing Film Abrasive Disc 260L
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Stikit™ Red Finishing Film Abrasive Disc 260L is a high-value abrasive disc that delivers best-in-class finishing performance in collision repair. It features aluminum oxide, 3M™'s longest-lasting, fastest-cutting abrasive, on a durable, flexible film backing - ideal for paint prep and removing runs before compounding. Stikit™ attachment features adhesive backing for fast, easy change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Red Finishing Film Abrasive Disc 260L
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Red Finishing Film Abrasive Disc 260L is an economical disc that delivers reliable finishing performance in collision repair. It features aluminum oxide, a dependable, reliable abrasive, on a durable film backing. Several versions feature seven-hole design for dust evacuation. And our 3M™ Hookit™ attachment system makes disc change-outs fast and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 213Q
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Wetordry™ Abrasive Sheet 213Q is an abrasive sanding paper constructed on a light, A-weight paper backing and features a waterproof resin bonding to help prevent heat buildup. The aluminum oxide abrasive and waterproof backing make this paper an ideal product for sanding applications such as paint prep, sanding, sealer sanding, and solid surface finishing.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Black Super Silicone Seal
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
3M™ Black Super Silicone Seal is formulated for fast and effective repairs. It cures to a tough, rubbery solid when exposed to moisture in the air. This paste-like, one-component silicone rubber adheres to clean metal, glass, wood, ceramic, natural and synthetic fiber, painted surfaces and some plastics.

NOTE: May cause crazing or hazing on optically clear plastics. May cause softening or weakening of plastic parts. Will cause accelerated rusting (oxidation) on bare metal surfaces. Test for compatibility with materials being repaired to determine whether product is suitable for use and method of application.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Green Corps™ Abrasive Disc 255U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Hookit™ Green Corps™ Abrasive Disc 255U strips paint from metal as well as shapes and sands plastic filler. Green Corps™ abrasives are built on E-weight backing to make them extremely durable for sanding paint, metal, or fiberglass. The abrasive disc features an anti-loading stearate coating. Aluminum oxide abrasive delivers a fast cut and long life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Gold Abrasive Disc 236U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Gold Disc 236U is precision-coated for long life during auto body sanding projects requiring moderately coarse grit abrasives. Open coat aluminum oxide abrasive and C-weight paper backing provide durability and a long-lasting cut for rough feather-edging or shaping plastic filler and putty. Load-resistant coating and available 6-hole pattern provide superior dust resistance.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Red Abrasive Sheet 316U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Stikit™ Red Abrasive Sheet 316U delivers best-in-class performance at a very high value in collision repair. It features aluminum oxide, a long-lasting, fast-cutting abrasive, on A-weight or durable D-weight paper backing. These sheet rolls are ideal for projects from filler shaping to featheredging to paint prep and finish. 3M™ Stikit™ attachment makes disc change-outs fast and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Gold Abrasive Sheet 288U
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
3M™ Hookit™ Gold Abrasive Sheet Roll 288U is a paper-backed abrasive designed for use in collision repair. It can be sized for a range of hand blockes, files and sanders. Its durable construction and anti-loading coating help reduce loading for longer sheet life and provide a smooth consistent finish.

Use the 3M™ Hookit™ Gold Abrasive Sheet Roll 288U for sanding on collision repair substrates like paint, primer, metal and composites. It is a paper-backed sheet roll with high-quality minerals for a long lasting cut and has a load-resistance coating to help reduce clogging and extend abrasive life . The Hookit™ system features hook-and-loop attachment for easy, reusable application, fitting standard hand blocks and orbital sanders. With 3M™ Gold Abrasive Sheet Roll 288U, you can achieve a uniform consistent finish, making it a valuable addition to any repair toolkit.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Disc 252U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Disc 252U strips paint to bare metal as well as shapes and sands plastic filler. Green Corps™ abrasives are built with E weight backing to make them extremely durable for sanding paint, metal or fiberglass. Ceramic aluminum oxide mineral blend delivers a fast cut and long life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Sheet 251U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Sheet 251U shapes plastic filler and strips paint to bare metal. Green Corps™ abrasives are built on E weight backing to make them extremely durable for sanding paint, metal or fiberglass. Abrasive sheets feature an anti-loading stearate coating. Ceramic aluminum oxide mineral blend delivers a fast cut and long life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Sheet 246U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ File Sheet 246U is built for tough sanding jobs in collision repair. Coarse grade ceramic and aluminum oxide blend is resin bonded to durable D-weight paper backing for heat resistance, with open coat construction that reduces loading. File sheets are ideal for shaping plastic filler and putty, paint removal and scratch refinement on bare metal.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Flap Discs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Cubitron™ II Flap Discs are engineered for a faster cut, longer disc life and a more uniform finish vs. conventional ceramic abrasives. Flexible flaps feature Precision Shaped Grain (PSG) technology - super-sharp triangular grains, electrostatically oriented on a flexible backing for an extremely fast, even cut. Overlapping flaps provide cushion for grinding and blending with one disc.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Film Abrasive Disc Roll 255L
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Stikit™ Gold Film Abrasive Disc Roll 255L features a single roll tear-off disc format and Stikit™ adhesive attachment, making it fast and easy to use. Aluminum oxide mineral abrasive with film backing balances aggressive cut with a consistent finish. Anti-loading coating and available 7-hole pattern help clear dust from the disc surface for longer life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Precision Masking Tape
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Precision Masking Tape is excellent for critical edge paint performance, helping auto body painters produce sharp paint lines using solvent and waterborne paint systems. Its ultra thin paper backing helps produce very low paint edges, yet it's strong enough to pull through layers of color and clear coat. The tape is ideal for two-tone separation, bumper black out areas and back masking.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Rubber Sanding Block
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Rubber Sanding Block provides a firm attachment for sanding jobs that demand a hands on approach. The tough rubber material evenly applies pressure to the sanding surface, while the rounded design provides a comfortable grip to help reduce user fatigue.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Black Super Weatherstrip Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Black Super Weatherstrip Adhesive is designed specifically to bond rubber gaskets and weatherstripping to metal surfaces. This flexible, high-strength adhesive helps ensure a tight waterproof seal on car doors, trunks, sun roofs and more. It cures fast and works right out of the tube, holding rubber weatherstripping in place and resisting heat, vibration, oils and detergents.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Channel Bonding and Sidelite Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Channel Bonding and Sidelite Adhesive securely bonds glass in both stationary and movable applications on automobiles. This high-performance, two-component black epoxy adhesive is both flexible and durable when bonding impervious surfaces such as glass to metal or plastic. This adhesive is black in color.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cut-Off Wheel Tools for Body Repair
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Cut-Off Wheel Tool for Body Repair is designed for cutting quickly and smoothly through aluminum, high strength steel, and other tough substrates in collision repair. It features a .70 HP motor in a tough composite housing that makes the tool very lightweight (less than 2 lbs.) and maneuverable. It is designed to optimize the performance of 3-inch 3M™ Cubitron™ II Cut-Off Wheels.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Complete Fuel System Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Complete Fuel System Cleaner is a high-quality fuel tank additive that effectively cleans fuel injectors, intake valves, and combustion chambers - removing carbon, gum, resin, and varnish deposits to help improve fuel economy and restore power.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Clean Sand Painter's Pad with Hookit™
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Clean Sand Painter's Pad with Hookit™ allows sanding in a dust-controlled environment when using 5-inch 3M Clean Sand abrasives or other 6-hole or 5-inch dust-free abrasive products. The 31-hole pad pattern is a proprietary 3M design that helps maximize dust extraction for a cleaner work surface.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dust Free Hose Extension Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Dust Free Hose Extension Kit lets operators expand their capabilities in effective sanding while keeping dust under control. This kit features a durable whip hose and adapters that convert large-hose dust control systems down to a standard 1" outside diameter vacuum hose, perfect for 3M™ Sanding Blocks and other 3M™ Dust Free tools. The hose provides a range of 20' for added versatility.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Low Linting Wool Compounding Pad 4 Inch
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Low Lint Wool Compounding Pad features 100% wool for a fast cut that quickly refines abrasive sand scratches on automotive painted surfaces. This pad leaves virtually no lint residue which can lead to a more efficient clean-up and less rework. Single-sided pads feature insets for easy centering on rotary polishers and Hookit™ hook-and-loop attachment for quick change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1-Step Foam Finishing Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1-Step Foam Finishing Pad essentially compounds and polishes in one step - eliminating the time and expense of compounding when used as part of the 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1-Step Paint Finishing system. Specially designed foam pads are available in 4", 6" and 8" diameters with Quick Connect attachment for precise centering or Hookit™ attachment for quick change-outs. Designed specifically for use with the 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1-Step Paint Finishing System, our 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1-Step Foam Finishing Pad compounds and polishes in one step - you can achieve a high-gloss finish without the time and expense of traditional compounding.

coveo:metadata.title: The 3M™ Perfect-It™ Foam Polishing Pad 4 Inch
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Perfect-It™ Foam Polishing Pad helps refine compounding swirls on automotive paint finishes. Single-sided pad features a 4-in. diameter for control and access in small areas or tight spaces. A specially designed foam pad face holds polish and helps prevent slinging. Pads feature insets for easy centering on rotary polishers, and Hookit™ hook-and-loop attachment for easy pad change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ DA Glazing Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Perfect-It™ DA Glazing Pad is specifically designed for applying glazes and other auto body finishes using D/A sanders and polishers. Convoluted foam face provides more cushion than flat foam and distributes pressure evenly across curved surfaces and body lines for consistent application. Long, soft "fingers" in the foam spread the glaze. Hookit™ attachment makes changeouts fast and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Abrasive Hand Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M Hand Pad allows you to use our Hookit discs with the precise control that only hand sanding can offer. Featuring our Hookit attachment system, abrasive discs can be easily swapped without coming loose during sanding, finishing or other hands-on applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Disc 255U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Green Corps™ Stikit™ Abrasive Disc 255U strips paint from metal as well as shapes and sands plastic filler. Green Corps™ abrasives are built on E-weight backing to make them extremely durable for sanding paint, metal or fiberglass. Abrasive disc features an anti-loading stearate coating. Aluminum oxide abrasive delivers a fast cut and long life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Purple Abrasive Disc 740I
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Stikit™ Purple Abrasive Disc 740I features durable E-weight paper and a fast cutting, long lasting abrasive for high productivity and low cycle times. Coarse grade aluminum oxide mineral abrasive is ideal for aggressive jobs like stripping paint to bare metal, shaping and sanding plastic filler and more. This abrasive disc features Stikit™ attachment for easy change-outs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Paint Defect Removal Abrasive Circle Sheet
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Paint Defect Removal Abrasive Circle Sheet is a small, durable abrasive for removing paint nibs and other defects by hand, without having to sand, compound and polish entire panels. Featuring 3M's fast-cutting, long-lasting aluminum oxide abrasive, the thin film-backed 32 mm circle fits onto specially-designed hand sanding cylinders for fast, efficient hand sanding right in your fingertips.

coveo:metadata.title: New Pig Grippy Floor Protection Mat
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The New Pig Grippy Floor Protection Mat prevents slips, trips and falls and creates a safe walking surface with the adhesive-backed commercial floor mat. Perfect for entrances and aisle-ways in retail, manufacturing, education, healthcare, hospitality and office environments.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ File Belt Sander Contact Arm Assemblies
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ File Belt Sander Contact Arm Assemblies is an efficient way to maintain your sanding and grinding capabilities, without spending on additional sanders. Each contact arm assembly arrives ready to install onto your 3M™ File Belt Sander (PN 33573 and 33575).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Metal Restorer and Polish
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Metal Restorer and Polish restores the sparkle and shine on metals throughout boats. This polish rejuvenates the beauty of metals by removing surface rust, oxidation, corrosion and tarnish. This easy-to-use paste brings back the original luster to make metals look new again.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Green Corps™ Abrasive Sheet 246U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Green Corps™ File Sheets 246U feature an aluminum oxide abrasive designed for increased abrasive life and a faster cut rate. They are built on D weight paper backing and feature an open coat construction that reduces loading on fresh filler. They are ideal for shaping plastic filler and putty, sanding clear coats, removing paint, and scratch refinement on metal, plastic, and fiberglass.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ File Belt Sander Contact Wheel Replacements
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ File Belt Sander Contact Wheel Replacements contains everything you need to easily replace the contact wheel on your 3M™ File Belt Sander and help keep it operating at peak performance. Each contact wheel replacement kit contains a durable contact wheel and an installation screw. The contact wheel and the screw are designed specifically for 3M™ File Belt Sanders (PN 33573 and 33575).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Super Red Putty
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Super Red Putty is a 1K glazing putty that is easy to spread and self-levels for repairing minor surface imperfections such as scratches, pinholes and stone chips. Our nitrocellulose-base putty offers a generous working time of approximately 3 minutes, yet dries quickly enough to be ready for sanding in about 30 minutes.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Lid & Liner Dispenser
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Lid & Liner Dispenser is a wall-mountable unit that makes supplies such as lids and liners for the 3M™ PPS™ (legacy) paint preparation system readily available. This storage accessory conveniently dispenses supplies one at a time, while keeping the remaining supply clean and safe from contamination.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Grippy Adhesive-Backed Floor Mat - 36"x100'
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Adhesive-backed floor mat stays exactly where you put it with no shifting, bunching up or ripples that cause slips and trips.

coveo:metadata.title: New Pig Aerosol Can Recycler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Puncture your aerosol cans for easy, legal recycling to avoid the hassle, regulation and expense of hazardous waste handling.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 12-Pack Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 12-Pack Refill Kit is a simple, cost-effective way to keep the PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System stocked and ready. Kits are available in Midi (13.5 oz, 400 mL) and Standard (22 oz, 650 mL) sizes, excellent for most mid-range repairs. Kit contains 12 PPS™ Series 2.0 Lids with ¼-turn locking systems and full diameter 200 micron filters, 12 disposable liners and 16 sealing plugs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Orbital Air File Shoe
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Orbital Air File Shoe allows you to use 3M abrasive sheets with a full range of orbital air file sanders. It features a hole configuration that helps channel dust away from the sheet surface for longer abrasive life. This file shoe also lets you instantly upgrade to the Hookit™ hook-and-loop attachment system for quick, easy changeouts when using Hookit™ abrasive sheets.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Blue Abrasive Sheet Rolls 321U
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Stikit™ Blue Abrasive Sheet Rolls delivers best-in-class performance at every stage of paint preparation and body repair. Premium aluminum oxide mineral is blended with ceramic grain for a full range of automotive sanding applications. Anti-loading coating reduces loading from dust and extends sheet life. Roll easily tears to make sizing the sheets fast and easy for reduced product waste.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Painter's Abrasive Disc Back-up Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Painter's Abrasive Disc Back-up Pad is specifically designed for auto body painting jobs requiring support and control. This soft density foam pad affords excellent conformability when sanding around contours, and a 15° bevel provides a defined edge for added control and a good "feel" for the surface. Hookit™ attachment makes disc change-outs fast and easy, maximizing disc life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Mar-Hyde™ Single Stage Self-Etching Primer Aerosol
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Mar-Hyde™ Single Stage Self-Etching Primer Aerosol is a ready-to-use pretreatment and primer that provides a stable surface for primers and topcoats even in hard-to-sand areas. The pretreatment also provides excellent corrosion protection on auto body panels when used in conjunction with automotive paint systems.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Reinforced Filler for DMS
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Reinforced Filler for DMS is a two-component, resin-rich filler that offers easier mixing and dispensing through the 3M™ Dynamic Mixing System. The system efficiently mixes the filler and hardener so that it is ready to use immediately upon being dispensed, saving automotive technicians time and effort by eliminating hand mixing.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Sealing Plugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Sealing Plugs are designed specifically for the 3M™ PPS™ 2.0 Spray Cup System. Sealing plugs fit into PPS™ Series 2.0 Lids of all sizes, and feature a wide, flat design that creates a stable base for supporting lid and cup assemblies when turned upside down. This lets you keep the lid filters wet, preserving them during temporary sealing and protection of paint and coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Magnetic Roll Holder
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Keep your PIG Mat within an arm's reach for easy access and hassle-free dispensing. The PIG Magnetic Roll Holder attaches to any metal surface to keep mat off the floor and close at hand.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 H/O Pressure Cup
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System is our next generation, highest-performing 3M™ Paint Preparation System (PPS) on the disposable spray cup market. This product contains a pressurized hard cup, collar, shroud, and hose, and enables the user to efficiently spray thick, high viscosity liquids.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Liners
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Liners come in cases containing 100 liners each for use with the 3M™ PPS™ paint preparation system. Liners are available for a range of jobs large and small. PPS™ is an all-in-one system that allows painters to mix/measure, filter, spray and temporarily seal and protect coating materials.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Adapter
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Adapter provides four points of connection from lid-to-gun and converts typical spray guns into ones that work with the 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System. Specifically designed adapters allow painters to use PPS™ with virtually any spray gun model. To use this adapter, remove the existing spray gun cup. Then simply thread the correct PPS™ Adapter into the spray gun.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Cartridge Applicator Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Cartridge Applicator Gun 08992 is designed to smoothly dispense a range of 3M™ seam sealers and adhesives from 1/10 gallon cartridges. This lightweight applicator gun allows operators to easily dispense a range of single component products.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Detailing Diluter
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Detailing Diluter automatically mixes 3M™ detailing products to correct ratios. 3M™ offers different models of detailing diluters for mixing many of 3M™'s water-based detailing products. Choose the model that is best for your application.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Disposable Plastic Seat Covers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Disposable Plastic Seat Covers protect customer vehicles and help your business shine. Durable grip plastic seat covers resist dirt, grease, and dust that can drift into a vehicle or transfer from a technician's clothing during repairs. The dispenser box makes them easy to use and replace on the fly. Temporary slip-on covers fit even high-backed bucket and bench seats.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Chrome and Metal Polish
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Chrome and Metal Polish renew the shine and sparkle of metals by removing surface rust, stains, oxidation, waterspots, corrosion and tarnish. This easy-to-use polish brings the beauty back to chrome, stainless steel, brass, bronze, copper and other automotive metals. Use this polish to restore the original gloss and luster of metals on automobiles.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Paint Finishing Pad Kit 4 Inch
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
The 3M™ Perfect-It™ Paint Finishing Pad Kit includes every pad you need for compounding, polishing and finishing in collision repair. This kit contains Perfect-It™ foam pads for compounding, polishing and ultrafine polishing, as well as a 100% low-lint wool compounding pad. All pads feature Hookit™ attachment and are designed for use with Perfect-It™ compounds and polishes.

This collection of compounding, polishing and finishing pads combines features that save time and money and improve your results at each critical stage of collision repair. In one convenient kit, you get:
  • (1) 3M™ Perfect-It™ Foam Compounding Pad

  • (1) 3M™ Perfect-It™ Low Lint Wool Compounding Pad

  • (1) 3M™ Perfect-It™ Foam Polishing Pad

  • (1) 3M™ Perfect-It™ Ultrafine Foam Polishing Pad

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Soft Abrasive Disc Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Soft Abrasive Disc Pad is ideal for use with fine grade abrasives and for sanding primer on conformable surfaces. This 1" soft foam pad features a 45° beveled edge, providing support and control for technicians using fine grit 8" 3M Hookit™ discs (sold separately) on low-speed polishers or grinders. The Hookit™ hook-and-loop attachment system makes changing discs fast and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Particulate Respirator 8576
coveo:metadata.sw_description:
This disposable P95 particulate respirator helps provide reliable respiratory protection against certain oil and non-oil-based particles. The respirator features a carbon layer to remove nuisance levels of acid gases.

The respirator incorporates 3M™'s proprietary technology with advanced electrostatically charged microfiber filter media designed for ease of breathing. Braided headbands are designed to help enhance comfort and increase wearability. Recommended applications may include glass etching, chemical processing, paper processing, aluminum smelting, and brewing operations in which particles and nuisance levels of acid gases such as sulphur dioxide, hydrogen fluoride, and/or chlorine may be present. Additional applications include grinding, sanding, sweeping, bagging, and other dusty/oily operations.
Note: This respirator is not intended to act as a face shield or to give benefits beyond helping to improve respiratory protection. Fitted with a 3M™ Cool Flow™ Exhalation Valve, this respirator is suited for work situations involving heat, humidity, or long periods of wear. The proprietary 3M™ Cool Flow valve is designed to release hot, humid exhaled breath quickly, helping to prevent an unpleasant build-up of heat inside the facepiece a significant cause of discomfort to respirator wearers. This particulate respirator is a NIOSH (National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health) approved P95 respirator for environments containing certain oil and non-oil-based particles and provides 95% filter efficiency.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ Spray Gun Holder
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ Spray Gun Holder works with the 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 and 3M™ PPS™ (Legacy) paint preparation system. Holders are available in single gun, double gun and quad gun designs. 3M™ PPS™ is a complete painting system that allows the painter to measure, mix, filter, spray and temporarily store paint materials.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ PPS™ SUN GUN™ II Accessories
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ PPS™ SUN GUN™ II Accessories are components and replacement parts for the 3M™ PPS™ SUN GUN™ II, a device used to provide a light source that replicates natural sunlight. This tool allows technicians to better match paint colors, identify pre-painting defects such as pin holes and scratches and locate post-painting defects such as swirls marks, burn through, sand scratches and dirt nibs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo™ Peel-Off Visor Cover M-925 Standard Visor
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Used with the 3M™ Versaflo™ M 925 Standard Visor. The M 926 Visor Cover fits over the standard visor and protects it from scratching or overspray of paint and chemicals.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Abrasive Organizer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Abrasive Organizer helps automotive repair professionals keep 3M™ abrasives and other sanding supplies clean, organized and always within reach. Made from sturdy 24-gauge steel, this cabinet features swinging doors that close in the center and a locking clasp for your own secure padlock. One fixed shelf and three adjustable shelves provide flexibility for individual shop applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1 Foam Finishing Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1 Foam Finishing Pad is a blue-colored, high-performance paint finishing pad designed to be used with Perfect-it™ 1 Finishing Material (sold separately) to remove Trizact™ abrasive scratches.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Spray Silicone Lubricant
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Silicone Lubricant eliminates rubber squeaks, prevents sticking and seals out moisture. This lubricant contains no petroleum oils to stain fabrics. Formulated for extreme conditions, it will not freeze at -28°F nor degrade at 350°F. Silicone lubricant is available in both wet and dry formulas.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ SUN GUN™ II Light Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ SUN GUN™ II Light Kit provides a light source that replicates natural sunlight, allowing technicians to better match paint colors. The 3M™ SUN GUN™ II can also help identify pre-painting defects such as pin holes and scratches as well as post-painting defects such as swirls marks, burn through, sand scratches and dirt nibs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fibre Disc Back-up Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Fibre Disc Backup Pad is built tough to support 5" DA. fiber discs on right angle sanders. Compatible with a range of 3M™ face plates, this hard rubber disc pad maximizes your abrasive discs - it is designed to reduce the vibration and chunking that degrades their effectiveness. The pad fastens securely to grinding tools with a disc retainer nut (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ C.A.R.T.S
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ C.A.R.T.S. helps boost shop efficiency by storing, organizing and transporting shop supplies with greater ease. The 3-shelf automotive shop cart features durable metal construction to handle the rigors of a typical shop. An epoxy powder coating helps protect the cart from the effects of corrosion. Some assembly is required.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Detail Compound 308
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Detail Compound 308 removes heavy oxidation, coarse scratches, and stains. This compound produces a medium gloss, fine swirl mark finish on all types of automotive paints.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Denibbing Polish
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Denibbing Polish removes 1500 sand scratches during the 3M™ Perfect-It™ Denibbing Process. This high-performing formula is a great denibbing tool, helping minimize the time and effort it takes to refinish paint jobs and remove sand scratches or swirl marks from previously compounded areas.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite SE Surface Conditioning Belt
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ SE Surface Conditioning Belt was built to last, resisting both wear and sharp edges when used for cleaning, blending, deburring and finishing on a variety of metals.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch-Brite™ Clean and Finish Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch-Brite™ Clean and Finish Discs combine conformable material and abrasive mineral to effectively blend, clean, and polish surfaces on a wide variety materials such as aluminum, stainless steel, plastics, wood, and fiberglass; producing a clean, consistent finish without undercutting or damaging the base material.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Copper Anti-Seize Brake Lube
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Copper Anti-Seize Brake Lube is a metal-to-metal lubricant for brake systems, spark plugs, oxygen sensors, and more. This blend of particle-sized metals in a semi-synthetic grease is engineered to withstand extreme pressures and intermittent temperatures up to 2000 degrees F, maintaining free movement between metals. It is also very effective on bolts, and where metal parts rub together.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Multi-Purpose Duct Tape 3900
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Constructed of polyethylene film laminated to cloth with a rubber adhesive, this durable tape resists curling and tears off the roll cleanly for easy application in MRO/construction. Our Multi-Purpose Duct Tape 3900 has a unique construction that allows for permanent and temporary applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Ratchet Headgear H8A
coveo:metadata.sw_description: A combination headgear and faceshield safety system. Includes H8A ratchet headgear and WP96 polycarbonate faceshield. Adjustable ratchet suspension. Molded faceshield provides impact protection. Requires protective eyewear, sold separately.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Adflo Particulate Filters
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Replacement high-efficiency particulate filter for 3M™ Adflo Powered Air Purifying Respirator (PAPR) .

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Versaflo Organic Vapor/HEPA Cartridge TR-600 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The TR-6510N is a filter is a combination High Efficiency (HE) particulate filter and Organic Vapor (OV) cartridge for use with TR-600 series PAPRs. 3M recommends the use of the TR-6500FC filter cover to help protect the filter from physcial damage.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Clear Polycarbonate Faceshield WP96
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Clear Polycarbonate Faceshield WP96, Face Protection 82701, uses the 3M Easy-Change™ system to mount quickly and easily to 3M headgear (sold separately).

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ File Belt Sanders for Body Repair
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ File Belt Sanders for Body Repair features the technology and versatility of 3M™ metalworking belt sanders in a size that's ideal for automotive collision repair. This narrow-profile tool is excellent for cutting in tight areas, including cutting, dressing and refining spot welds as well as blending and finishing. This file belt sander is designed for use with 3M™ Cubitron™ II abrasives.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Sound Deadening Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Sound Deadening Pad makes riding in a vehicle more pleasant by suppressing road noise, sound system vibrations, rattles and other distracting noises. Sound deadening pads are conformable, self-adhesive sheets that can be easily custom cut and applied to vehicle floor pans, engine compartments, hoods, deck-lids, inside doors and on body panels.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Disposable Paper Mixing Board
coveo:metadata.sw_description: A clean, non-porous surface is the solution for mixing body filler.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Interior Protection Automotive Floor Mat
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Protects a customer's vehicle during the automotive repair process.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Inspection Spray
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Inspection Spray is used to inspect automotive surfaces for lingering sand scratches after buffing.

coveo:metadata.title: FASTLINE™ Guide Coat
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Helps identify unevenly primed surfaces

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Gasket Prep and Parts Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Gasket Prep and Parts Cleaner degreases surfaces prior to applying gasket adhesives or sealants.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ High Power Spray Gun Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M High Power Spray Gun Cleaner is a low VOC aerosol specifically formulated for removing waterborne and solvent-based coatings from metals, plastic and composite surfaces. This spray gun cleaner meets SCAQMD Rule 1171 requirements.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fuel Injector Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Fuel Injector Cleaner is a quality fuel tank additive that cleans fuel injectors, removing gum, resin and varnish deposits to help improve fuel economy and restore power. Fuel injector cleaner may help to eliminate stalling, hesitation and poor performance due to dirty fuel injectors.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1-Step Finishing Material
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Perfect-It™ 1-Step Finishing Material essentially compounds and polishes in one step.

coveo:metadata.title: Dynatron White Cream Hardener
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Dynatron™ White Cream Hardener is a hardening agent designed to work with their 2-part 3M™, Dynatron™ and Bondo™ fillers, putties and glazes.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Orbital Air File Shoe D/F
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Orbital Air File Shoe D/F allows you to use 3M™ abrasive sheets with a full range of orbital air file sanders. It features an enhanced hole configuration that helps channel dust away from sheet surfaces for a longer abrasive life. The file shoe also lets you instantly upgrade to the Hookit™ hook-and-loop attachment system for quick, easy changeouts when using Hookit™ abrasive sheets.

coveo:metadata.title: Dynatron Dyna-Hair Long Strand
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dynatron™ Dyna-Hair® Long Strand body filler repairs splits, cracks and holes in all kinds of surfaces, including wood, fiberglass, aluminum and bare or galvanized steel.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun System with PPS™ Series 2.0
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun System with PPS™ Series 2.0 combines the simplicity and easy maintenance of our Accuspray™ spray gun with the material-saving, rapid clean-up convenience of PPS™ Series 2.0.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Flexible Abrasive Interface Foam Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Hookit Flexible Abrasive Interface Foam Pad contains one rectangular interface foam pad with hook-in attachment on one side and loop-in attachment on the other. This foam pad is commonly used with 3M™ Orbital Sander, part number 20331, and the 3M™ Hookit™ Flexible Abrasive Hand Sheets for sanding primer, blending, and paint finishing.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dynatron® Auto Seam Sealer Caulk
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Dynatron® Auto Seam Sealer Caulk is a fast-skinning, permanently elastic, non-sagging formulation that is brushable and paintable. Our sealer provides excellent adhesion to bare metal or painted surfaces and is a non-staining, all-purpose autobody joint and seam sealer. Dynatron™ Auto Seam Sealer Caulk lay down well on both bare metal and painted surfaces. Our sealer offers high adhesion and has a thick consistency that makes it less likely to drip, sag or run out of the gap being sealed. It dries quickly with little shrinkage. Our sealer creates a water-tight repair that stay in place without cracking. Recommended applications include fresh welds, floor seams, trunk seams, drip rails, voids and gaps.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Purple Abrasive Disc 740I
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Coarse grade aluminum oxide mineral abrasive is ideal for aggressive jobs including stripping paint to bare metal, shaping and sanding plastic filler and more.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Heavy-Duty Shop Bags
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Durable, oversized shop bags are ideal for auto repair shop waste disposal needs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Interior Protection Automotive Seat Cover
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Durable, temporary plastic seat covers resist dirt, grease and dust that can drift or be tracked onto a vehicle's seat cushions during repairs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ S.M.A.R.T. Bumper Stand
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ S.M.A.R.T. Bumper Stand securely holds plastic bumper fascias or bumper covers in place while being repaired and painted.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Accuspray™ ONE Spray Gun System with Standard PPS™
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Accuspray™ Spray Gun System with Standard PPS™ combines the simplicity and easy maintenance of Accuspray™ spray guns and with the material-saving, rapid clean-up convenience of PPS™. Replaceable atomizing heads afford the performance of a new gun, on demand and at a fraction of the cost.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Gravity HVLP Atomizing Head Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Gravity HVLP Atomizing Heads are designed to deliver premium spray performance for coatings including paints, clear coats and topcoats. Replaceable nozzles are built exclusively for gravity feed applications with the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun System and 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System, offering like-new spray performance with the change of each nozzle.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Gravity HVLP Atomizing Head Variety Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Gravity HVLP Atomizing Heads Variety Refill Kit includes nozzles in six sizes ranging from 1.2 to 2.0. Replaceable nozzles are built exclusively for gravity feed applications with the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun System and 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System. Designed to deliver premium spray performance for coatings, including paints, clear coats and topcoats.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Accuspray™ Fluid Needle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Accuspray™ Fluid Needle is designed specifically for the Accuspray™ spray gun and helps keep it operating like new.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Industrial Spray Gun System
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Lightweight and easy to use, the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun was built for the industrial painter. Made from impact-resistant composite, it is one of the lightest spray guns in the industry, yet durable enough for demanding conditions. Its versatile design allows spraying from a pressurized source or a gravity cup. Replaceable nozzles from 1.1 to 2.0 allow you to spray a wide range of coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Lightweight and easy to use, the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun was built for the modern painter. Capable of spraying a wide range of coatings from either a pressure-fed source or attached gravity cup, its impact-resistant composite body makes it one of the lightest spray guns available, yet it is durable enough for demanding industrial and automotive conditions.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Pressure HVLP Atomizing Head Variety Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Pressure HVLP Atomizing Heads are designed to deliver premium spray performance for coatings including, including stains, primers, base coats, topcoats, clear coats and adhesives. Replaceable nozzles are built exclusively for pressure-feed applications using the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun, offering like-new spray performance with the change of each nozzle.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Pressure HVLP Atomizing Head Refill Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Pressure HVLP Atomizing Heads are designed to deliver excellent spray performance for coatings including stains, primers, base coats, topcoats, clear coats and adhesives. Replaceable nozzles are built exclusively for pressure-feed applications using the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun, offering like-new spray performance with the change of each nozzle.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun System with PPS™ 2.0
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun is engineered for performance. The versatile selection of replaceable nozzles offer like-new spray performance every time. The lightweight, impact resistant gun body features a newly designed locking collar that allows for quick nozzle changes for an easy switch between paints or coatings and cleanup. Nozzles connect directly to 3M™ PPS™ Series 2.0 Spray Cup System.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Ball Valve
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Ball Valve is an accessory for the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun System configured as a pressure feed sprayer. The valve gives the spray gun operator the ability to stop the flow of paint from the pressure source (pot or pump) at the spray gun end of the supply hose. Recommended for use when the painter does not have easy access to the pressure source. Light and easy to use.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Locking Collar
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The unique 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Locking Collar helps ensure a solid connection between the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun and 3M™ Performance Atomizing Heads. The locking collar is easy to use, allowing for quick nozzle changes while switching between paints and coatings or for cleanup at the end of a job. The easy-grip tabs make it easier to turn the locking collar.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Pressure Whip
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Pressure Whip Hose connects to the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun for use in pressure feed applications. Provides a fast connection between the atomizing head and the pressurized paint supply hose. Securely fastens to the spray gun base for better balance and hose control. Can be used with optional ball valve to control paint from the pressure line.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Whip Pin
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Whip Pin is a replacement attachment pin for the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Pressure Whip Hose. The clevis pins are used to secure the whip hose to the body of the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun. The connection helps give the painter additional control and helps prevent the atomizing head from twisting and unwanted stress.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Needle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Needle is designed specifically for 3M™ Performance Spray Gun. The stainless steel construction is engineered for a leakproof seal when the trigger is released and precise flow control when the trigger is pulled. Use this replacement needle when the existing spray gun needle is damaged, bent, the gun leaks through its nozzle, or as routine preventative maintenance.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Rebuild Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Performance Spray Gun Rebuilt Kit provides the replacement parts needed for rebuilding the 3M™ Performance Spray Gun. Includes exterior replacement parts as well as all required interior seals, springs, screws and parts. Instruction manual provides specific details on how to rebuild.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Stikit™ Soft Abrasive Disc Back-up Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Engineered for sanding large areas of paint down to metal with coarse grade abrasives, the 8˝ 3M™ Stikit™ Soft Abrasive Disc Back-up Pad adds cushion and conformability to 3M™ Stikit™ sanding discs. Ideal for auto and marine body sanding applications, the pad's soft density foam with a 45° tapered edge closely conforms to contours and curves to deliver a uniform finish and minimize rework.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Replacement Applicator Plunger
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Replacement Applicator Plunger meets 3M™ standards as a replacement part for our applicator gun. Our 3M™ approved replacement plunger will maintain optimal performance standards in our applicator guns.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Fiberglass Matting Adhesive
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Fiberglass Matting Adhesive is a low viscosity two-part urethane used to saturate fiberglass cloth or mat when preparing backup patches. This adhesive may also be used for filling cracks, channels and areas restricting the application of an adhesive bead.

coveo:metadata.title: Astro Pneumatic Tool 50SL Color Match Light
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Rechargeable handheld color match light

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ All Purpose Fast Cure Filler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ All Purpose Fast Cure Filler helps increase productivity while ensuring body repair quality with an extra creamy, easily spreading consistency. This filler is part of the 3M™ Dynamic Mixing System (DMS), which mixes two-component products directly in the nozzle for a perfect ratio every time. DMS products boost productivity and reduce product waste for auto body shops.

coveo:metadata.title: Astro Nylon Bed Brush
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Astro Pneumatic 4546 6" Nylon Bed Brush has a special design that helps prevent clogging and loading. It is constructed of non-oxidizing materials which will not react with metal and includes non-sparking material which create a safer brush than conventional wire brushes. This brush lasts up to 6 times longer than conventional wire brushes under normal circumstances and has a standard 5/8" thread with a maximum of 6500rpm.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Intake System Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Intake System Cleaner removes soot, carbon and other deposits from vehicle intakes that are harmful to engine performance. Use of this cleaner is an important part of regular vehicle intake system maintenance that can create more responsive acceleration and improved fuel economy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Quick Grip Filler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Quick Grip Filler is an extra fast, easily sandable body filler that adheres rapidly to most substrates including galvanized steel, aluminum, E-coat and many more. This creamy, easy-to-spread filler is vacuum processed to reduce pinholes and sands to a fine featheredge without loading abrasives. It cures in 15 minutes at 75°F, and sands to a stain-resistant, tack-free finish.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Throttle Plate and Carb Cleaner
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Throttle Plate and Carb Cleaner removes dirt, residue and deposits that can adversely affect the performance of throttles and carburetors. Our cleaner lubricates throttle bodies and carburetor assemblies to help restore maximum operating efficiency. We formulated this cleaner so that it is safe for coated throttle plates.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Flex Pack Nozzle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Flex Pack Nozzle is a key component for accurately applying 3M 1-part urethane adhesives and seam sealers in collision repair. Tapered design allows users to cut the ends for the closest possible bead shapes and heights to meet strength requirements or match OEM. The nozzle is designed for 3M Flex Pack materials, and works with the Flex Pack Applicator Gun PN08398.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Milled Fiberglass Body Filler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Milled Fiberglass Body Filler features short-strand chopped and milled fiberglass, making it an excellent reinforcement for repairing holes, cracks and tears in fiberglass as well as metal and SMC. Ideal for automotive and marine repair, this waterproof fiberglass body filler features a 2-part high-resin formula that delivers smooth spreading, excellent sag resistance and bond gapping.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Moisture Resistant Protective Sheeting
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Moisture Resistant Protective Sheeting is designed to reduce moisture staining in higher-temp drying applications. It provides fast single-person application for reduced overspray-related rework. Film can be used in IR dryers at temps up to 248°F/120°C, helping eliminate dampness. Translucent film is easy to apply, reposition and cut. A light static cling keeps it in place without adhesives.

coveo:metadata.title: Dynatron Dyna-Pro Paintable Rubberized Undercoating
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dynatron™ Dyna-Pro® Paintable Rubberized Undercoating forms a durable barrier against weather, chipping, salt spray and rust - almost like applying a layer of rubber to vulnerable auto undercarriages. Fast-drying flexible coating combines easy brush or spray-on application with superior sealing and corrosion resistance, and accepts standard refinish auto paint systems to help match any OEM color.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Threaded Cartridge Nozzle
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Threaded Cartridge Nozzle is a key piece for applying 3M™ 1-part adhesives and seam sealers in collision repair. Its tapered design allows you to apply close bead shapes and heights to meet strength requirements or match OEM. The nozzle is designed for use with 3M™ single component cartridges and the 3M™ Single Component Cartridge Applicator Gun PN 08990.

coveo:metadata.title: Mar-Hyde Black Satin Automotive Trim Coating
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Mar-Hyde™ Black Satin Automotive Trim Coating delivers extremely durable coated protection to metal and plastic surfaces. This coating is ideal for exterior auto trim - it adheres to surfaces including aluminum, steel, stainless steel and plastic and resists weathering. Black aerosol coating applies smoothly and instantly adds a sharp look to vehicles.

coveo:metadata.title: Mar-Hyde 4.4 Ultimate 2K High Speed Primer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Mar Hyde™ 4.4 Ultimate 2K High Speed Primer Surfacer adds smoothness and efficiency to your collision repair paint jobs. It creates a high build film that fills in sand scratches and other impurities in most any vehicle substrate that forms a smooth surface for paint topcoats. It also dries very fast, reducing the cure time to 1 hr for faster shop throughput.

coveo:metadata.title: Mar-Hyde™ Wet Look Hardener
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Mar-Hyde™ Wet Look Hardener is a high solids hardener that produces a super high-gloss finish. 3M™ formulated this hardener to provide exterior protection and durability for painted surfaces of automobiles. This product converts acrylic enamel into a urethane for a solid finish.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Orbital File Shoe Base Plate
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Orbital File Shoe Base Plate features a 2-3/4" x 10" size for fast, easy attachment to Hutchins models 3800, 3804, and 4932 and other 10" orbital air file sanders with dust vacuum systems. This base plate readily accepts adhesive for use with a full range of 3M™ abrasive sheets and features a hole configuration that helps channel dust away from the sheet surface for longer abrasive life.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Hard E-Coat Abrasive Disc
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Hookit™ Hard E-Coat Abrasive Disc is built for effectively sanding hard e-coats in collision repair. Tough, durable discs feature a diamond grade mineral blend for scuff sanding e-coat primers and hard substrates on OEM auto panels. Technicians get a consistent matte finish for better paint adhesion. Hookit™ attachment makes changeouts fast and easy.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Pistol Grip Disc Sanders for Body Repair
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Pistol Grip Disc Sander for Body Repair is designed specifically for grinding and surface preparation processes in collision repair. Powerful and fast, this .45 horsepower disc sander operates at up to 18,000 RPM, ideal for paint stripping and weld cleanup. Molded pistol-grip handle and weight of less than 1-1/2 lbs, excellent for tight spaces. It works with 2- and 3-inch 3M™ Roloc™ discs.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Spray Lube
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Spray Lube is a translucent, thick, high-performance lubricant designed for vehicles that are used frequently, carry heavy loads and are exposed to extreme environments. It can provide long-term lubrication to difficult-to-access parts of your vehicle. Ideal for hinges, latches, window regulator tracks, seat tracks, cables and other under-the-hood and around the vehicle applications.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Elite Orbital Sanders
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Elite Orbital Sanders deliver professional performance for flat finishing and sealer sanding operations, hour after hour in high-production industrial environments. Options are available in non-vacuum, central vacuum, and self-generated vacuum models.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Automotive Adhesion Promoter, Sponge Applicator Packet
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Adhesion Promoter 06396 is a convenient liquid primer for enhancing the adhesion of 3M™ Acrylic Foam Tapes in automotive applications. This adhesion promoter works with most LSE plastics used for interior and exterior automotive trim and parts. Fast-drying fluid is available in .85 oz. (2.5 cc) sponge applicator packets, each covering up to 150 sq. in.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Finesse-it™ Foam Buffing Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Finesse-it™ Foam Buffing Pads are designed for use with our specially developed 3M™ Finesse-it™ polishes to achieve satin, semi-gloss or high gloss finishes on automotive, marine, aerospace and wood coatings.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ E-A-Rsoft™ Yellow Neons™ Blasts™ Earplugs
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ E-A-Rsoft™ Yellow Neon Blasts™ Earplugs feature a natural cylindrical shape and smooth texture for a comfortable fit. Featuring a 32 NRR for work in noisy areas. Bright yellow color is designed to help make them easier to spot for compliance verification.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ GoggleGear™ Safety Goggles 6000 Series
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ GoggleGear™ 6000 Series is a larger-profile goggle design that features models with 3M™ Scotchgard™ Anti-Fog Coating, or Traditional Anti-Fog & Anti-Scratch coating. All models come with indirect venting to help reduce fo

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Sealers, Coatings, and Adhesives Organizer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Sealers, Coatings and Adhesives Organizer is a sturdy metal cabinet with shelves inside, making it the ideal place to store sealers, coatings and other materials needed by automotive body shop workers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Headlight Lens Restoration Kit
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Perfect-It™ Headlight Lens Restoration Kit is a full system of products assembled specifically for removing dullness and haze from plastic automotive lenses. Instead of replacing lenses, you can simply remove surface imperfections to restore clarity in 15 minutes or less. The kit contains sanding and polishing tools, 3" Trizact™ abrasive discs, and Perfect-It™ rubbing compound and polish.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Quick Headlight Clear Coat Wipes
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Quick Headlight Clear Coat Wipes are a fast, easy solution for adding a clear coating to slightly-yellowed headlights and other plastic lenses, improving and extending their clarity. Each box contains 2 coated wipes along with a Trizact™ abrasive disc. Use the disc to lightly clean the surface, wipe on the coating and let it dry for clarity that lasts much longer than methods without wipes.

coveo:metadata.title: New Pig Spill Kits
coveo:metadata.sw_description: When you don't need a UN Rated container, this hi-viz, low-cost PIG Spill Kit is perfect for everyday spill response.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Masking Film Dispenser
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Masking Film Dispenser is a simple, convenient way to keep masking films, overspray protection and other plastic sheeting at your fingertips to keep the shop - and the work you do - clean and professional. The heavy-duty portable frame rolls easily and keeps 36" sheet rolls locked into place, ready for roll-out. Double steel spring brakes keep the unit stable during sheeting application.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch Apron Taper
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Scotch® Apron Taper dispenses masking paper and masking tape together to reduce shop waste, save time and improve results. Technicians simply dispense masking paper with masking tape already applied along its edge, ready to use. The apron taper doesn't require mounting and keeps masking paper and tape rolls (sold separately) within reach and ready for use.

coveo:metadata.title: Scotch Cart Masker
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Scotch® Cart Masker helps automotive body technicians transport needed masking supplies and dispense masking paper up to 18 inches. This cart features two levels of masking paper dispensers and large, deep storage trays on the top and bottom.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Roloc™ Brake Rotor Surface Conditioning Disc Refill Pack
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Roloc™ Brake Rotor Surface Conditioning Disc Refill Pack contains 12 abrasive discs designed specifically to create non-directional scratch patterns on brake rotor surfaces after turning. It is a cost-effective way to supplement the brake rotor surface conditioning disc starter pack, featuring a disc pad for fast adaptation to power tools and Roloc attachment for fast disc changeouts.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Tape and Residue Remover
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Tape and Residue Remover lets you efficiently remove tape and tape residue left during the collision repair panel masking process. The remover is very easy to use: simply spread it over the residue, wait and wipe off. It cleanly removes residue as well as entire polyurethane protective tapes, neoprene rubber and more. No scraping is required, so painted surfaces stay scratch-free.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Universal Light-Weight Absorbent Mat Roll
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Genuine PIG® Mat is the better way to soak up drips, spills and splatters and spend more time repairing vehicles. Easier to use than floor sweep so it reduces cleanup time. And with no damaging dust and grit to track around, the shop stays cleaner!

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Foam Hand Sanding Set
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Hookit™ Foam Hand Sanding Set is ideal for hand sanding applications, including primer sanding, blend preparation and paint finishing. These pads are designed to be used as accessories for our Hookit™ abrasive products.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Universal Medium-Weight Absorbent Mat Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Genuine PIG® Mat is the better way to soak up drips, spills and splatters, and spend more time repairing vehicles. Easier to use than floor sweep so it reduces cleanup time. And with no damaging dust and grit to track around, the shop stays cleaner!

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Universal Light-Weight Absorbent Mat Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Genuine PIG® Mat is the better way to soak up drips, spills and splatters and spend more time repairing vehicles. Easier to use than floor sweep, so it reduces cleanup time. And with no damaging dust and grit to track around, the shop stays cleaner!

coveo:metadata.title: New Pig Installation Board and Safety Knife
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Installing your PIG Grippy Mat in retail, grocery or commercial environments is a breeze with these tools.

coveo:metadata.title: New Pig Justrite Uninsulated Bonding/Grounding Wires
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Economical wires provide secure grounding for storage and transfer of flammables.

coveo:metadata.title: Pig Blue Absorbent Mat Pad in Dispenser Box
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our best value mat catches common industrial liquids and delivers more absorbency per pad at the so you use less, leave them down longer, reduce waste and save money; comes in a convenient dispenser box.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Blue Absorbent Sock
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our heaviest absorbent sock is filled with vermiculite to form a barrier and prevent spills from spreading.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Latching Drum Lid
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Keep your drums and hazardous waste storage containers securely closed and locked to comply with regs! Our latching lid opens and closes with one hand - without the nut and bolt ring hassles.

coveo:metadata.title: Fine Screen for PIG Drum Funnel
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Add one of our drum screens to a funnel for draining or filtering.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Absorbent Mat Roll
coveo:metadata.sw_description: PIG Mat lasts 2x longer than ordinary mats for fewer change-outs. Absorbs everything. Works everywhere.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Traffic Mat® Heavy-Duty Absorbent Rug
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Our most durable absorbent mat for areas with heavy foot, cart, or forklift traffic in a heavy-duty version to absorb twice as much!

coveo:metadata.title: PIG® Burpless® Steel Drum Funnel DRM1125
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Patented Burpless design delivers fast, no-splash pouring and one-handed access for easy reg compliance.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Elephant Absorbent Mat Pad in Dispenser Box
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Absorbent mat with zigzag stitching for extreme durability and toughness.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Spill Kit in 65-Gallon Overpack Salvage Drum
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Strong enough to earn a UN rating for shipping spill cleanup waste.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Sump Skimmer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Sized to pull oil out of your sumps, tanks, and bilges.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Heavy-Duty 2-Drum Poly Spill Containment Pallet
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The strongest pallets you can buy won't buckle or bow, even under the heaviest loads! Guaranteed for life.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Rip-&-Fit® Absorbent Mat Roll in Dispenser Box
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Extra perforations let you customize PIG Mat to the shape you need. Just "rip" it along the easy-tear perfs and "fit" it into place. Dispenser box is easy to store.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Silicone Paste
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Use 3M™ Silicone Paste for the many areas of your vehicle that require long-term protection from the harsh conditions of environmental exposure. This non-hardening, water-resistant paste can be applied heavily to help seal out contaminants and weather. It can also be spread thin for nearly invisible lubrication and protection.

coveo:metadata.title: Dynatron Cranker Dispenser
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dynatron™ Cranker Mechanical Dispenser is a manual dispensing unit that allows for body filler to be dispensed at a controlled rate. No air is required for dispenser to operate.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dispenser Valve
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Dispenser Valve is a plastic butterfly valve that makes dispensing 3M™ Body Filler products cleaner, simpler and more efficient. The easy to use valve securely attaches to a 3- gallon mechanical pail, allowing operators to monitor and control filler output - without the mess.

coveo:metadata.title: Dynatron Dispenser Kit

High-carbon, heat-treated brackets support each shelf up to 125 pounds. Multiple parts carts can also be nested and easily stored, saving you space. There's no need to flip or reverse the shelf for nesting multiple units.

This easy-to-load cart has three points of access and one-inch side rails that prevent parts from falling off. You can also hang hoods, fenders, and core supports almost anywhere on the cart with its six high-performance cart hooks.

The Innovative Painters' Prep Cart with Masker keeps your supplies handy and eliminates the need to waste time looking for supplies. Enjoy process controls that improve the efficiency and quality of your work, time after time. This parts cart also comes with tags to help facilitate an easy-to-use barcode system. That way you can keep your inventory under control and reduce the need for unnecessary orders.Rolls right into your work area for greater efficiency. Keeps supplies handy and techs on the jobMaterials and supplies in full view from any angle. Facilitates an easy-to-use barcode system; tags provided.
