coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dynatron™ Dyna-Glass Short Strand reinforced body filler creates waterproof repairs that are twice the strength of ordinary body fillers.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Disposable Plastic Wheel Maskers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Disposable Plastic Wheel Maskers are an inexpensive way to protect wheels and tires from overspray while painting. The maskers easily slip over tires and wheels to keep them free of overspray.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Short Strand Fiberglass Reinforced Filler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Short Strand Reinforced Filler is reinforced with short strand fiberglass to create water resistant repairs that are twice the strength of ordinary body fillers. It is a great solution for repairing holes and rust on metal and fiberglass.

coveo:metadata.title: Dynatron Blue Cream Hardener
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dynatron™ Blue Cream Hardener mixes with 2-part fillers, putties and glazes to create high-quality, long-lasting repairs. When filler and hardener are mixed, a chemical reaction occurs to create a mixture that will deliver a strong, lasting repair. This hardener is smooth and easy to mix with filler.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Platinum™ Lightweight Body Filler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Platinum™ is a premium, professional lightweight body filler, that offers excellent surface adhesion to properly prepared steel, galvanized steel, aluminum, E-coat, sheet molded compound (SMC) and fiberglass reinforced polyester (FRP), concrete and wood substrates. 3M™ Platinum™ is formulated with Stain-free/Tack free resin and is compatible with most base coat/clear coat and waterborne paint systems.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Smoothie
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Smoothie® is specially formulated to work with the latest paint systems in collision repair for eliminating fisheyes in the painting process. This full-strength paint additive benefits from decades of development to improve the performance of the paint and the entire system, from improved outflow to better leveling and more effective coverage of mars.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Hookit™ Disc Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Hookit™ Disc Pad securely holds a 3M™ Hookit sanding or finishing disc or 3M™ Finesse-it™ buffing pad for use with a hand-held sanding tool such as a rotary, orbital, or random orbital sander. The 45 degree tapered edge provides flexibility and allows the sanded area to be feather-edged or more easily blended.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Low Linting Wool Compounding Pad
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Perfect-It™ Low-linting Wool Compounding Pad aggressively removes P1200 or finer sand scratches from clearcoat and leaves a finer finish than most 100% wool pads without the linting mess. This high performance wool pad is crucial in Step 1 of the Perfect-it™ Paint Finishing System to produce showroom grade finishes with deep color and rich gloss.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Adhesive Remover
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Adhesive Remover lets you quickly remove adhesive, attachment tape, tar, and wax from your vehicle's painted surfaces without harmful scraping tools or abrasives. This easy-to-use blend of solvents won't harm most automotive paint surfaces and also works on glass or vinyl. It can also be used during body repair. Instructions for removing bumper stickers are included.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Controlled-Flow Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Controlled-Flow Seam Sealer offers considerable strength, flexes under torsional stress from vibration, and withstands extreme weather. The urethane formula contains no solvents and will not shrink or crack. These characteristics make it an ideal choice for automotive applications where motion and exposure to weather are a constant factor.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Bare-Metal Seam Sealer
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Bare-Metal Seam Sealer is a tough, flexible sealing material formulated for sealing bare metal joints, such as steel or aluminum, as well as primed or painted metal in collision repair. Two part, self mixing epoxy sealer can be easily caulked, tooled or brushed into seams and cures in as little as 15 minutes. It features a neutral beige color.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Impact Resistant Structural Adhesive (IRSA)
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Impact Resistant Structural Adhesive (IRSA) is formulated for true automotive OEM specified structural bonding applications, excellent for collision absorption in steel structures and advanced lightweight aluminum alloys. This two part epoxy adhesive delivers extended worktimes - up to 1 hour - and can be rapidly heat cured. The adhesive changes from silver to purple as the adhesive cures.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Engine and Tire Dressing
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M Engine and Tire Dressing uniformly coats and shines engine hoses, tires, plastics and moldings to renew a fresh, clean and deep-colored appearance. This water-based silicone emulsion concentrate will not harm rubber parts used in vehicles.

coveo:metadata.title: Mar-Hyde One-Step Rust Converter
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Mar-Hyde™ One-Step Rust Converter Primer Sealer permanently converts rust into a hard, black primer sealer ready for topcoats. Water-based latex containing rust modifiers is easily applied directly over tightly bonded or flash rust on iron or steel. The solution creates a chemical reaction which converts rust, eliminating extra time for sanding and priming metal surfaces in collision repair.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Rocker Protector Pouch
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Rocker Protector Pouch is a resilient under-the-paint protective coating designed to help protect rocker panels and stone-throw areas of automobiles.The specially-engineered formula matches a wide variety of textures on factory-applied coatings. Use this pouch with 3M™ Accuspray™ Spray Gun Kit HGP (sold separately) to access hard-to-reach areas and ensure uniform application.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dirt Trap Material Floor Applicator
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The 3M™ Dirt Trap Nonwoven Protection Material Floor Applicator is an upright metal dispenser with a foam roller for applying 3M™ Dirt Trap Protection Material to floor areas. With a long handle and a design that allows it to be pushed or pulled across the floor, the applicator makes it fast and easy to apply protective material to spray booths, paint bays, and other key collision repair shop spaces.

coveo:metadata.title: Dynatron™ Dynalite™ Body Filler
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Dynatron™ Dynalite™ has long been the auto repair professional's choice for lightweight body filler. This polyester resin-based material features a light, smooth texture ideal for mixing and spreading. It cures quickly and affords good featheredge for reduced finishing and sanding work. This body filler is compatible with nearly any automotive paint finish system.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dirt Trap Clear Film Dispenser
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Dirt Trap Clear Film Dispenser conveniently stores and dispenses 3M™ Dirt Trap Clear Film. This dispenser comes with high-strength magnets that secure the unit on vertical metal surfaces while the clear film is dispensed and applied. Use this accessory with 18-inch wide rolls of clear film to protect lights and windows from overspray.

coveo:metadata.title: PIG Absorbent Mat Pad in Dispenser Box
coveo:metadata.sw_description: PIG Mat lasts 2x longer than ordinary mats for fewer change-outs. Absorbs everything. Works everywhere.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork® Industrial Low-Lint Cleaning Cloth
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tork® Industrial Low-Lint Cleaning Cloth is excellent for industrial cleaning applications that are particle sensitive. This cloth can be used in the Tork® Folded Wiper/Cloth Dispenser that protects the refills from dirt and offers an one-at-a time dispensing to reduce consumption and waste. Best if used for working with sensitive applications like surface preparation before painting due to low-lint properties.

coveo:metadata.title: 3M™ Dirt Trap Protection Material Dispensers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: 3M™ Dirt Trap Nonwoven Protection Material Dispensers conveniently store and dispense 3M™ Dirt Trap Nonwoven Protection Material. Choose the 3M™ Dirt Trap Material Dispenser, PN36862 or 3M™ Dirt Trap Material Floor Applicator Dispenser, PN 36864 for smooth, roll-out access to protection material for application to paint booth walls and floors.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork® Heavy Duty Paper Wipers
coveo:metadata.sw_description: Tork® heavy-duty paper wipers are a great shop towel. Their durability and high-performance characteristics make them a perfect choice for a wide variety of uses, from professional shops and garages to cleaning tools in do-it-yourselfer workshops and garages.

coveo:metadata.title: Tork Wall Dispenser
coveo:metadata.sw_description: The Tork® Wall stand in Performance Design is developed for efficiency and reliability with its easy load features and the possibility to take either paper needed with only one hand. Tork Performance is the next generation of dispensers for professional wiping.

coveo:metadata.title: New PIG Floor Sweep

coveo:metadata.title: Genesis LV

These sealers can be combined to offer a gray scale color combination for any topcoat color. For optimum coverage of the topcoat, the following sealer colors are recommended with the corresponding color of topcoat:
